column3: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

column2: sahas aThaareh kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||
column3: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

column2: lekhaa hoi ta likheeaai lekhai hoi vinaas ||
column3: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

column2: naanak vaddaa aakheeaai aape jaanai aap ||22||
column3: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

column2: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paieeaa ||
column3: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

column2: nadheeaa atai vaeh paveh samu(n)dh na jaane'eeh ||
column3: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

column2: samu(n)dh saeh sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||
column3: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

column2: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh ||23||
column3: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

column2: a(n)t na sifatee kahan na a(n)t ||
column3: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

column2: a(n)t na karanai dhen na a(n)t ||
column3: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

column2: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||
column3: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

column2: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||
column3: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?

column2: a(n)t na jaapai keetaa aakaar ||
column3: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.

column2: a(n)t na jaapai paaraavaar ||
column3: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.

column2: a(n)t kaaran kete bilalaeh ||
column3: Many struggle to know His limits,

column2: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaeh ||
column3: but His limits cannot be found.

column2: eh a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
column3: No one can know these limits.

column2: bahutaa kaheeaai bahutaa hoi ||
column3: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.

column2: vaddaa saahib uoochaa thaau ||
column3: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.

column2: uooche upar uoochaa naau ||
column3: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.

column2: evadd uoochaa hovai koi ||
column3: Only one as Great and as High as God

column2: tis uooche kau jaanai soi ||
column3: can know His Lofty and Exalted State.

column2: jevadd aap jaanai aap aap ||
column3: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.

column2: naanak nadharee karamee dhaat ||24||
column3: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||

column2: bahutaa karam likhiaa naa jai ||
column3: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.

column2: vaddaa dhaataa til na tamai ||
column3: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.

column2: kete ma(n)geh jodh apaar ||
column3: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.

column2: ketiaa ganat nahee veechaar ||
column3: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.

column2: kete khap tuTeh vekaar ||
column3: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.

column2: kete lai lai mukar paeh ||
column3: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.

column2: kete moorakh khaahee khaeh ||
column3: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.

column2: ketiaa dhookh bhookh sadh maar ||
column3: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.

column2: eh bh dhaat teree dhaataar ||
column3: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!

column2: ba(n)dh khalaasee bhaanai hoi ||
column3: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.

column2: hor aakh na sakai koi ||
column3: No one else has any say in this.

column2: je ko khaik aakhan pai ||
column3: If some fool should presume to say that he does,

column2: oh jaanai jeteeaa muh khai ||
column3: he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.

column2: aape jaanai aape dhei ||
column3: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.

column2: aakheh s bh keiee kei ||
column3: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.

column2: jis no bakhase sifat saalaeh ||
column3: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,

column2: naanak paatisaahee paatisaahu ||25||
column3: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||

column2: amul gun amul vaapaar ||
column3: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.

column2: amul vaapaare'e amul bha(n)ddaar ||
column3: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.

column2: amul aaveh amul lai jaeh ||
column3: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.

column2: amul bhai amulaa samaeh ||
column3: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.

column2: amul dharam amul dheebaan ||
column3: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.

column2: amul tul amul paravaan ||
column3: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.

column2: amul bakhasees amul neesaan ||
column3: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.

column2: amul karam amul furamaan ||
column3: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.

column2: amulo amul aakhiaa na jai ||
column3: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!

column2: aakh aakh rahe liv lai ||
column3: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.

column2: aakheh vedh paaTh puraan ||
column3: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.

column2: aakheh paRe kareh vakhiaan ||
column3: The scholars speak and lecture.

column2: aakheh barame aakheh i(n)dh ||
column3: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.

column2: aakheh gopee tai govi(n)dh ||
column3: The Gopis and Krishna speak.

column2: aakheh ieesar aakheh sidh ||
column3: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.

column2: aakheh kete keete budh ||
column3: The many created Buddhas speak.

column2: aakheh dhaanav aakheh dhev ||
column3: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

column2: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev ||
column3: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.

column2: kete aakheh aakhan paeh ||
column3: Many speak and try to describe Him.

column2: kete keh keh uTh uTh jaeh ||
column3: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.

column2: ete keete hor kareh ||
column3: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

column2: taa aakh na sakeh keiee kei ||
column3: even then, they could not describe Him.

column2: jevadd bhaavai tevadd hoi ||
column3: He is as Great as He wishes to be.

column2: naanak jaanai saachaa soi ||
column3: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.

column2: je ko aakhai boluvigaaR ||
column3: If anyone presumes to describe God,

column2: taa likheeaai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar ||26||
column3: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

column2: so dhar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
column3: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

column2: vaaje naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||
column3: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

column2: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||
column3: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

column2: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
column3: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

column2: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare ||
column3: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

column2: gaaveh ieesar baramaa dhevee sohan sadhaa savaare ||
column3: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

column2: gaaveh i(n)dh idhaasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
column3: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

column2: gaaveh sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan saadh vichaare ||
column3: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

column2: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaaveh veer karaare ||
column3: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

column2: gaavan pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedhaa naale ||
column3: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

column2: gaaveh mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh piaale ||
column3: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

column2: gaavan ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
column3: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

column2: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare ||
column3: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

column2: gaaveh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||
column3: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

column2: seiee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
column3: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

column2: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||
column3: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

column2: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
column3: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

column2: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
column3: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

column2: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
column3: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

column2: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
column3: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

column2: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
column3: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

column2: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||27||
column3: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

column2: mu(n)dhaa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot ||
column3: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

column2: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaiaa jugat dda(n)ddaa parateet ||
column3: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

column2: aaiee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||
column3: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.

column2: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
column3: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

column2: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||
column3: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

column2: bhugat giaan dhiaa bha(n)ddaaran ghaT ghaT vaajeh naadh ||
column3: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

column2: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saadh ||
column3: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

column2: sa(n)jog vijog dhui kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag ||
column3: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.

column2: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
column3: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

column2: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||
column3: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

column2: ekaa maiee jugat viaaiee tin chele paravaan ||
column3: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

column2: eik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)ddaaree ik laae dheebaan ||
column3: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

column2: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan ||
column3: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

column2: oh vekhai onaa nadhar na aavai bahutaa eh viddaan ||
column3: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!

column2: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
column3: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

column2: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||
column3: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||

column2: aasan loi loi bha(n)ddaar ||
column3: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

column2: jo kichh paiaa su ekaa vaar ||
column3: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

column2: kar kar vekhai sirajanahaar ||
column3: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.

column2: naanak sache kee saachee kaar ||
column3: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.

column2: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
column3: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

column2: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||
column3: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

column2: eik dhoo jeebhau lakh hoh lakh hoveh lakh vees ||
column3: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

column2: lakh lakh geRaa aakhe'eeh ek naam jagadhees ||
column3: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

column2: et raeh pat pavaReeaa chaReeaai hoi ikees ||
column3: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

column2: sun galaa aakaas kee keeTaa aaiee rees ||
column3: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

column2: naanak nadharee paieeaai kooRee kooRai Thees ||32||
column3: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||

column2: aakhan jor chupai neh jor ||
column3: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

column2: jor na ma(n)gan dhen na jor ||
column3: No power to beg, no power to give.

column2: jor na jeevan maran neh jor ||
column3: No power to live, no power to die.

column2: jor na raaj maal man sor ||
column3: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.

column2: jor na suratee giaan veechaar ||
column3: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.

column2: jor na jugatee chhuTai sa(n)saar ||
column3: No power to find the way to escape from the world.

column2: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||
column3: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.

column2: naanak utam neech na koi ||33||
column3: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||

column2: raatee rutee thitee vaar ||
column3: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;

column2: pavan paanee aganee paataal ||
column3: wind, water, fire and the nether regions

column2: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||
column3: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

column2: tis vich jeea jugat ke ra(n)g ||
column3: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.

column2: tin ke naam anek ana(n)t ||
column3: Their names are uncounted and endless.

column2: karamee karamee hoi veechaar ||
column3: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.

column2: sachaa aap sachaa dharabaar ||
column3: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.

column2: tithai sohan pa(n)ch paravaan ||
column3: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.

column2: nadharee karam pavai neesaan ||
column3: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.

column2: kach pakaiee othai pai ||
column3: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.

column2: naanak giaa jaapai jai ||34||
column3: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||

column2: dharam kha(n)dd kaa eho dharam ||
column3: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.

column2: giaan kha(n)dd kaa aakhahu karam ||
column3: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

column2: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||
column3: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

column2: kete barame ghaaRat ghaRe'eh roop ra(n)g ke ves ||
column3: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

column2: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upadhes ||
column3: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

column2: kete i(n)dh cha(n)dh soor kete kete ma(n)ddal dhes ||
column3: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

column2: kete sidh budh naath kete kete dhevee ves ||
column3: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

column2: kete dhev dhaanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)dh ||
column3: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

column2: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)dh ||
column3: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

column2: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||
column3: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||

column2: giaan kha(n)dd meh giaan paracha(n)dd ||
column3: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

column2: tithai naadh binodh kodd ana(n)dh ||
column3: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

column2: saram kha(n)dd kee baanee roop ||
column3: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.

column2: tithai ghaaRat ghaReeaai bahut anoop ||
column3: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

column2: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaeh ||
column3: These things cannot be described.

column2: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutai ||
column3: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

column2: tithai ghaReeaai surat mat man budh ||
column3: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

column2: tithai ghaReeaai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
column3: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||

column2: karam kha(n)dd kee baanee jor ||
column3: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.

column2: tithai hor na koiee hor ||
column3: No one else dwells there,

column2: tithai jodh mahaabal soor ||
column3: except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.

column2: tin meh raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
column3: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.

column2: tithai seeto seetaa mahimaa maeh ||
column3: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

column2: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh ||
column3: Their beauty cannot be described.

column2: naa oh mareh na Thaage jaeh ||
column3: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

column2: jin kai raam vasai man maeh ||
column3: within whose minds the Lord abides.

column2: tithai bhagat vaseh ke loa ||
column3: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.

column2: kareh ana(n)dh sachaa man soi ||
column3: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.

column2: sach kha(n)dd vasai nira(n)kaar ||
column3: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.

column2: kar kar vekhai nadhar nihaal ||
column3: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.

column2: tithai kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)dd ||
column3: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

column2: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
column3: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.

column2: tithai loa loa aakaar ||
column3: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

column2: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
column3: As He commands, so they exist.

column2: vekhai vigasai kar veechaar ||
column3: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.

column2: naanak kathanaa karaRaa saar ||37||
column3: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||

column2: jat paahaaraa dheeraj suniaar ||
column3: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

column2: aharan mat vedh hatheeaar ||
column3: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.

column2: bhau khalaa agan tap taau ||
column3: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.

column2: bhaa(n)ddaa bhaau a(n)mrit tit ddaal ||
column3: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,

column2: ghaReeaai sabadh sachee Takasaal ||
column3: and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

column2: jin kau nadhar karam tin kaar ||
column3: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.

column2: naanak nadharee nadhar nihaal ||38||
column3: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||

column2: salok ||

column2: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
column3: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

column2: cha(n)giaaieeaa buriaaieeaa vaachai dharam hadhoor ||

column2: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||

column2: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||

column2: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhuTee naal ||1||

column3: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

column2: vaaje tere naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||

column2: kete tere raag paree siau kahe'eeh kete tere gaavanahaare ||
column3: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

column3: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

column2: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare ||
column3: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
column3: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
column3: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

column2: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare ||
column3: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.

column2: gaavan tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
column3: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesur jug jug vedhaa naale ||
column3: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
column3: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
column3: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare ||
column3: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

column2: gaavan tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
column3: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

column2: seiee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
column3: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

column2: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
column3: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

column2: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
column3: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

column2: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
column3: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

column2: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
column3: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

column2: kar kar dhekhai keetaa aapanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
column3: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

column2: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
column3: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

column2: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||
column3: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||

column2: sun vaddaa aakhai sabh koi ||

column2: kevadd vaddaa ddeeThaa hoi ||

column2: keemat pai na kahiaa jai ||

column2: kahanai vaale tere rahe samai ||1||

column2: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||

column2: koi na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||

column2: sabh suratee mil surat kamaiee ||

column2: sabh keemat mil keemat paiee ||
column3: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.

column2: giaanee dhiaanee gur gurahaiee ||
column3: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

column2: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||
column3: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

column2: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||
column3: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,

column2: sidhaa purakhaa keeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||

column2: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
column3: without You, no one has attained such powers.

column2: karam milai naahee Thaak rahaieeaa ||3||
column3: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||

column2: aakhan vaalaa kiaa vechaaraa ||

column2: sifatee bhare tere bha(n)ddaaraa ||
column3: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

column2: jis too dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
column3: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?

column2: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa ||4||2||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||

column2: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau ||

column2: aakhan aaukhaa saachaa naau ||

column2: aakh thake keemat nahee paiee ||

column2: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||

column2: gun eho hor naahee koi ||

column2: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||

column2: jevadd aap tevadd teree dhaat ||

column2: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||

column2: khasam visaareh te kamajaat ||
column3: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

column2: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||3||
column3: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||

column2: mere meet gurdhev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
column3: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.

column2: gurmat naam meraa praan sakhaiee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||

column2: har jan ke vadd bhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
column3: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.

column2: har har naam milai tirapataaseh mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
column3: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

column2: jin har har har ras naam na paiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
column3: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.

column2: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhirag jeeve dhirag jeevaas ||3||
column3: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

column2: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paiee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
column3: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.

column2: dhan dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paiaa mil jan naanak naam paragaas ||4||4||
column3: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||

column3: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

column2: kaahe re man chitaveh udham jaa aahar har jeeau pariaa ||

column2: sail pathar meh ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||

column2: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile su tariaa ||

column2: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sooke kaasaT hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||

column2: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe Thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||

column2: tin kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa ||3||

column2: sabh nidhaan dhas asaT sidhaan Thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||

column2: jan naanak bal bal sadh bal jaieeaai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||5||
column3: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
column3: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.

column3: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.

column2: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
column3: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.

column2: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||

column2: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
column3: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||

column2: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
column3: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.

column2: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
column3: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.

column3: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.

column2: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
column3: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?

column2: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin kurabaanaa ||2||
column3: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

column2: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukhavaasee ||
column3: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

column2: se mukat se mukat bhe jin har dhiaaiaa jee tin tooTee jam kee faasee ||
column3: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.

column2: jin nirabhau jin har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jee tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
column3: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.

column2: jin seviaa jin seviaa meraa har jee te har har roop samaasee ||
column3: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

column2: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jee jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
column3: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

column2: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bia(n)t bea(n)taa ||
column3: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.

column3: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.

column2: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
column3: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.

column3: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.

column2: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
column3: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||

column2: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
column3: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.

column2: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
column3: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.

column2: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
column3: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.

column2: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||

column2: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||

column2: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||

column2: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||

column2: ku(n)goo kee kaa(n)iaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas ||
column3: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

column2: aThasaTh teerath kaa mukh Tikaa tit ghaT mat vigaas ||
column3: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

column2: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas ||1||
column3: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

column2: baabaa hor mat hor hor ||
column3: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

column2: je sau ver kamaieeaai kooRai kooRaa jor ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

column2: pooj lagai peer aakheeaai sabh milai sa(n)saar ||
column3: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

column2: naau sadhaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar ||
column3: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

column2: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar ||2||
column3: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

column2: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin meT na sakai koi ||
column3: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

column2: onaa a(n)dhar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragaT hoi ||
column3: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

column2: naau poojeeaai naau ma(n)neeaai akha(n)dd sadhaa sach soi ||3||
column3: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

column2: khehoo kheh ralaieeaai taa jeeau kehaa hoi ||
column3: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

column2: jaleeaa sabh siaanapaa uThee chaliaa roi ||
column3: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

column2: naanak naam visaariaai dhar giaa kiaa hoi ||4||8||
column3: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: gunava(n)tee gun veetharai aaugunava(n)tee jhoor ||
column3: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

column2: je loReh var kaamanee neh mileeaai pir koor ||
column3: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

column2: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa paieeaai pir dhoor ||1||
column3: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

column2: mere Thaakur poorai takhat addol ||
column3: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

column2: gurmukh pooraa je kare paieeaai saach atol ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

column2: prabh harima(n)dhar sohanaa tis meh maanak laal || motee heeraa niramalaa ka(n)chan koT reesaal ||
column3: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful. Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

column2: bin pauRee gaR kiau chaRau gur har dhiaan nihaal ||2||
column3: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

column2: gur pauRee beRee guroo gur tulahaa har naau ||
column3: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

column2: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dhareeaau ||
column3: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

column2: je tis bhaavai uoojalee sat sar naavan jaau ||3||
column3: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

column2: pooro pooro aakheeaai poorai takhat nivaas ||
column3: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

column2: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas ||
column3: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

column2: naanak pooraa je milai kiau ghaaTai gun taas ||4||9||
column3: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: aavahu bhaine gal mileh a(n)k sahelaReeaaeh ||
column3: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

column2: mil kai kareh kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaaeh ||
column3: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

column2: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaeh ||1||
column3: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

column2: karataa sabh ko terai jor ||
column3: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

column2: ek sabadh beechaareeaai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

column2: jai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
column3: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, ""By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?""

column2: sahaj sa(n)tokh seegaareeaa miThaa bolanee ||
column3:
We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

739	kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||	You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||
740	sach milai sach uoopajai sach meh saach samai ||	Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.
741	surat hovai pat uoogavai gurbachanee bhau khai ||	Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.
742	naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape le milai ||4||10||	O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||
743	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
744	bhalee saree j ubaree haumai muiee gharaahu ||	It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.
745	dhoot lage fir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu ||	The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.
746	kalap tiaagee baadh hai sachaa veparavaahu ||1||	I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||
747	man re sach milai bhau jai ||	O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.
748	bhai bin nirabhau kiau theeaai gurmukh sabadh samai ||1|| rahaau ||	Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
749	ketaa aakhan aakheeaai aakhan toT na hoi ||	How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.
750	ma(n)gan vaale ketaRe dhaataa eko soi ||	There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.
751	jis ke jeea paraan hai man vasiaai sukh hoi ||2||	He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||
752	jag supanaa baajee banee khin meh khel khelai ||	The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.
753	sa(n)jogee mil ekase vijogee uTh jai ||	Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.
754	jo tis bhaanaa so theeaai avar na karanaa jai ||3||	Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||
755	gurmukh vasat vesaaheeaai sach vakhar sach raas ||	The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.
756	jinee sach vana(n)jiaa gur poore saabaas ||	Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.
757	naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudhaa jis paas ||4||11||	O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||
758	sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
759	dhaat milai fun dhaat kau sifatee sifat samai ||	As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.
760	laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||	Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.
761	sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhai ||1||	Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||
762	bhaiee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||	O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.
763	sa(n)t sabhaa gur paieeaai mukat padhaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||	In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||
764	uoochau thaan suhaavanaa uoopar mahal muraar ||	Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.
765	sach karanee dhe paieeaai dhar ghar mahal piaar ||	By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.
766	gurmukh man samajhaieeaai aatam raam beechaar ||2||	The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||
767	tirabidh karam kamaie'eeh aas a(n)dhesaa hoi ||	By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.
768	kiau gur bin tirakuTee chhuTasee sahaj miliaai sukh hoi ||	Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.
769	nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeaai nadhar kare mal dhoi ||3||	Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||
770	bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiau ghar vaas ||	Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?
771	eko sabadh veechaareeaai avar tiaagai aas ||	Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.
772	naanak dhekh dhikhaieeaai hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||4||12||	O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||
773	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
774	dhirag jeevan dhohaaganee muThee dhoojai bhai ||	The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.
775	kalar keree ka(n)dh jiau ahinis kir ddeh pai ||	Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.
776	bin sabadhai sukh naa theeaai pir bin dhookh na jai ||1||	Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||
777	mu(n)dhe pir bin kiaa seegaar ||	O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
778	dhar ghar ddoiee na lahai dharageh jhooTh khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||	In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||
779	aap sujaan na bhuliee sachaa vadd kirasaan ||	The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.
780	pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam dhe dhaan ||	First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.
781	nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||	The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||
782	gur kau jaan na jaaniee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||	Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?
783	a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manmukh a(n)dh gubaar ||	The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.
784	aavan jaan na chukiee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||	Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||
785	cha(n)dhan mol anaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||	The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;
786	choaa cha(n)dhan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||	she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,
787	je dhan ka(n)t na bhaaviee ta sabh adda(n)bar kooR ||4||	but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||
788	sabh ras bhogan baadh heh sabh seegaar vikaar ||	Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.
789	jab lag sabadh na bhedheeaai kiau sohai gurdhuaar ||	Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?
790	naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin seh naal piaar ||5||13||	O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||
791	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
792	su(n)n(j)ee dheh ddaraavanee jaa jeeau vichahu jai ||	The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.
793	bhaeh bala(n)dhee vijhavee dhooau na nikasio kai ||	The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.
794	pa(n)che ru(n)ne dhukh bhare binase dhoojai bhai ||1||	The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||
795	mooRe raam japahu gun saar ||	You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.
796	haumai mamataa mohanee sabh muThee aha(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||	Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||
797	jinee naam visaariaa dhoojee kaarai lag ||	Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.
798	dhubidhaa laage pach mue a(n)tar tirasanaa ag ||	Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.
799	gur raakhe se ubare hor muThee dha(n)dhai Thag ||2||	Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||
800	muiee pareet piaar giaa muaa vair virodh ||	Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.
801	dha(n)dhaa thakaa hau muiee mamataa maiaa karodh ||	Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.
802	karam milai sach paieeaai gurmukh sadhaa nirodh ||3||	Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||
803	sachee kaarai sach milai gurmat palai pai ||	By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.
804	so nar ja(n)mai naa marai naa aavai naa jai ||	Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.
805	naanak dhar paradhaan so dharageh paidhaa jai ||4||14||	O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||
806	sireeraag mahal 1 ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
807	tan jal bal maaTee bhiaa man maiaa moh manoor ||	The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.
808	aaugan fir laagoo bhe koor vajaavai toor ||	Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.
809	bin sabadhai bharamaieeaai dhubidhaa ddobe poor ||1||	Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||
810	man re sabadh tarahu chit lai ||	O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.
811	jin gurmukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jai ||1|| rahaau ||	Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
812	tan soochaa so aakheeaai jis meh saachaa naau ||	That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.
813	bhai sach raatee dhehuree jihavaa sach suaau ||	One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,
814	sachee nadhar nihaaleeaai bahuR na paavai taau ||2||	is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||
815	saache te pavanaa bhiaa pavanai te jal hoi ||	From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.
816	jal te tirabhavan saajiaa ghaT ghaT jot samoi ||	From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.
817	niramal mailaa naa theeaai sabadh rate pat hoi ||3||	The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||
818	eih man saach sa(n)tokhiaa nadhar kare tis maeh ||	One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.
819	pa(n)ch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maeh ||	The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.
820	naanak aaugan veesare gur raakhe pat taeh ||4||15||	O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||
821	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
822	naanak beRee sach kee tareeaai gur veechaar ||	O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.
823	eik aaveh ik jaavahee poor bhare aha(n)kaar ||	Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.
824	manahaTh matee booddeeaai gurmukh sachu su taar ||1||	Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||
825	gur bin kiau tareeaai sukh hoi ||	Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?
826	jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too mai avar na dhoojaa koi ||1|| rahaau ||	As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||
827	aagai dhekhau ddau jalai paachhai hario a(n)goor ||	In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.
828	jis te upajai tis te binasai ghaT ghaT sach bharapoor ||	We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.
829	aape mel milaavahee saachai mahal hadhoor ||2||	He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||
830	saeh saeh tujh sa(n)malaa kadhe na visaareau ||	With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.
831	jiau jiau saahab man vasai gurmukh a(n)mrit peau ||	The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
832	man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameau ||3||	Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||
833	jin eh jagat upaiaa tirabhavan kar aakaar ||	The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.
834	gurmukh chaanan jaaneeaai manmukh mugadh gubaar ||	The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.
835	ghaT ghaT jot nira(n)taree boojhai gurmat saar ||4||	One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||
836	gurmukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas ||	Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.
837	sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas ||	They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.
838	naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa jeeau pi(n)dd prabh paas ||5||16||	O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||
839	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
840	sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh ||	Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.
841	jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ih tan dheh ||	As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.
842	bin gun kaam na aaviee ddeh dderee tan kheh ||1||	Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||
843	mere man lai laahaa ghar jaeh ||	O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.
844	gurmukh naam salaaheeaai haumai nivaree bhaeh ||1|| rahaau ||	The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||
845	sun sun ga(n)ddan ga(n)ddeeaai likh paR bujheh bhaar ||	Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,
846	tirasanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar ||	but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.
847	oh veparavaahu atolavaa gurmat keemat saar ||2||	That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
848	lakh siaanap je karee lakh siau preet milaap ||	Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people
849	bin sa(n)gat saadh na dhraapeeaa bin naavai dhookh sa(n)taap ||	still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.
850	har jap jeeare chhuTeeaai gurmukh cheenai aap ||3||	Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||
851	tan man gur peh vechiaa man dheeaa sir naal ||	I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.
852	tirabhavan khoj dda(n)ddoliaa gurmukh khoj nihaal ||	I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.
853	satagur mel milaiaa naanak so prabh naal ||4||17||	The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||
854	sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||	Siree Raag, First Mehla:
855	maranai kee chi(n)taa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas ||	I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.
856	too sarab jeeaa pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas ||	You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.
857	a(n)tar gurmukh too vaseh jiau bhaavai tiau nirajaas ||1||	You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||
858	jeeare raam japat man maan ||	O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.
859	a(n)tar laagee jal bujhee paiaa gurmukh giaan ||1|| rahaau ||	The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
860	a(n)tar kee gat jaaneeaai gur mileeaai sa(n)k utaar ||	Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.
861	muiaa jit ghar jaieeaai tit jeevadhiaa mar maar ||	To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.
862	anahadh sabadh suhaavane paieeaai gur veechaar ||2||	The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||
863	anahadh baanee paieeaai teh haumai hoi binaas ||	The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

column2: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa likh na jaanai koi ||
column3: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.

column2: je sau sair mele'eeh til na pujaaveh roi ||
column3: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.

column2: keemat kinai na paieeaa sabh sun sun aakheh soi ||2||
column3: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again and again. ||2||

column2: peer paikaamar saalak saadhak suhadhe aaur saheedh ||
column3: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and the martyrs,

column2: sekh masaik kaajee mulaa dhar dharaves raseedh ||
column3: the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

column2: barakat tin kau agalee paRadhe rahan dharoodh ||3||
column3: -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him. ||3||

column2: puchh na saaje puchh na ddaahe puchh na dhevai lei ||
column3: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeks no advice while giving or taking.

column2: aapanee kudharat aape jaanai aape karan karei ||
column3: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.

column2: sabhanaa vekhai nadhar kar jai bhaavai tai dhei ||4||
column3: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||

column2: thaavaa naav na jaane'eeh naavaa kevadd naau ||
column3: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.

column2: jithai vasai meraa paatisaahu so kevadd hai thaau ||
column3: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?

column2: a(n)baR koi na sakiee hau kis no puchhan jaau ||5||
column3: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||

column2: varanaa varan na bhaavanee je kisai vaddaa karei ||
column3: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.

column2: vadde hath vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
column3: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.

column2: hukam savaare aapanai chasaa na ddil karei ||6||
column3: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||

column2: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut lainai kai veechaar ||
column3: Everyone cries out, ""More! More!"", with the idea of receiving.

column2: kevadd dhaataa aakheeaai dhe kai rahiaa sumaar ||
column3: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.

column2: naanak toT na aaviee tere jugeh jugeh bha(n)ddaar ||7||1||
column3: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age after age. ||7||1||

column2: mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: First Mehla:

column2: sabhe ka(n)t maheleeaa sagaleeaa kareh seegaar ||
column3: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him.

column2: ganat ganaavan aaieeaa soohaa ves vikaar ||
column3: But when the time comes to settle their accounts, their red robes are corrupt.

column2: paakha(n)dd prem na paieeaai khoTaa paaj khuaar ||1||
column3: His Love is not obtained through hypocrisy. Her false coverings bring only ruin. ||1||

column2: har jeeau iau pir raavai naar ||
column3: In this way, the Dear Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys His bride.

column2: tudh bhaavan sohaaganee apanee kirapaa laih savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: The happy soul-bride is pleasing to You, Lord; by Your Grace, You adorn her. ||1||Pause||

column2: gur sabadhee seegaareeaa tan man pir kai paas ||
column3: She is decorated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; her mind and body belong to her Husband Lord.

column2: dhui kar joR khaRee takai sach kahai aradhaas ||
column3: With her palms pressed together, she stands, waiting on Him, and offers her True prayers to Him.

column2: laal ratee sach bhai vasee bhai ratee ra(n)g raas ||2||
column3: Dyed in the deep crimson of the Love of her Darling Lord, she dwells in the Fear of the True One. Imbued with His Love, she is dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

column2: pria kee cheree kaa(n)ddeeaai laalee maanai naau ||
column3: She is said to be the hand-maiden of her Beloved Lord; His sweetheart surrenders to His Name.

column2: saachee preet na tuTiee saache mel milaau ||
column3: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.

column2: sabadh ratee man vedhiaa hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||3||
column3: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, her mind is pierced through. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

column2: saa dhan ra(n)dd na baisiee je satigur maeh samai ||
column3: That bride, who is absorbed into the True Guru, shall never become a widow.

column2: pir reesaaloo nautano saachau marai na jai ||
column3: Her Husband Lord is Beautiful; His Body is forever fresh and new. The True One does not die, and shall not go.

column2: nit ravai sohaaganee saachee nadhar rajai ||4||
column3: He continually enjoys His happy soul-bride; He casts His Gracious Glance of Truth upon her, and she abides in His Will. ||4||

column2: saach dhaRee dhan maaddeeaai kaapaR prem seegaar ||
column3: The bride braids her hair with Truth; her clothes are decorated with His Love.

column2: cha(n)dhan cheet vasaiaa ma(n)dhar dhasavaa dhuaar ||
column3: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple of the Tenth Gate is opened.

column2: dheepak sabadh vigaasiaa raam naam ur haar ||5||
column3: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||

column2: naaree a(n)dhar sohanee masatak manee piaar ||
column3: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel of the Lord's Love.

column2: sobhaa surat suhaavanee saachai prem apaar ||
column3: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.

column2: bin pir purakh na jaaniee saache gur kai het piaar ||6||
column3: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the True Guru. ||6||

column2: nis a(n)dhiaaree sute'ee kiau pir bin rain vihai ||
column3: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?

column2: a(n)k jalau tan jaaleeaau man dhan jal bal jai ||
column3: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.

column2: jaa dhan ka(n)t na raaveeaa taa birathaa joban jai ||7||
column3: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain. ||7||

column2: sejai ka(n)t mahelaRee sootee boojh na pai ||
column3: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come to know Him.

column2: hau sutee pir jaaganaa kis kau poochhau jai ||
column3: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?

column2: satigur melee bhai vasee naanak prem sakhai ||8||2||
column3: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak, His Love is always with me. ||8||2||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: aape gun aape kathai aape sun veechaar ||
column3: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear it and contemplate it.

column2: aape ratan parakh too(n) aape mol apaar ||
column3: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.

column2: saachau maan mahat too(n) aape dhevanahaar ||1||
column3: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||

column2: har jeeau too(n) karataa karataar ||
column3: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.

column2: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) har naam milai aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

column2: aape heeraa niramalaa aape ra(n)g majeeTh ||
column3: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.

column2: aape motee uoojalo aape bhagat baseeTh ||
column3: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.

column2: gur kai sabadh salaahanaa ghaT ghaT ddeeTh addeeTh ||2||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart, the Unseen is seen. ||2||

column2: aape saagar bohithaa aape paar apaar ||
column3: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the one beyond.

column2: saachee vaaT sujaan too(n) sabadh laghaavanahaar ||
column3: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry us across.

column2: niddariaa ddar jaaneeaai baajh guroo gubaar ||3||
column3: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||

column2: asathir karataa dhekheeaai hor ketee aavai jai ||
column3: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.

column2: aape niramal ek too(n) hor ba(n)dhee dha(n)dhai pai ||
column3: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.

column2: gur raakhe se ubare saache siau liv lai ||4||
column3: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4||

column2: har jeeau sabadh pachhaaneeaai saach rate gur vaak ||
column3: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.

column2: tit tan mail na lagiee sach ghar jis otaak ||
column3: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.

column2: nadhar kare sach paieeaai bin naavai kiaa saak ||5||
column3: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without the Name, who are our relatives? ||5||

column2: jinee sach pachhaaniaa se sukhe'ee jug chaar ||
column3: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.

column2: haumai tirasanaa maar kai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
column3: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.

column2: jag meh laahaa ek naam paieeaai gur veechaar ||6||
column3: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned by contemplating the Guru. ||6||

column2: saachau vakhar laadheeaai laabh sadhaa sach raas ||
column3: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits forever with the Capital of Truth.

column2: saachee dharageh baisiee bhagat sachee aradhaas ||
column3: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.

column2: pat siau lekhaa nibaRai raam naam paragaas ||7||
column3: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord. ||7||

column2: uoochaa uoochau aakheeaai kahau na dhekhiaa jai ||
column3: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.

column2: jeh dhekhaa teh ek too(n) satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
column3: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.

column2: jot nira(n)tar jaaneeaai naanak sahaj subhai ||8||3||
column3: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding. ||8||3||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: machhulee jaal na jaaniaa sar khaaraa asagaahu ||
column3: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.

column2: at siaanee sohanee kiau keeto vesaahu ||
column3: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?

column2: keete kaaran paakaRee kaal na Talai siraahu ||1||
column3: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||

column2: bhaiee re iau sir jaanahu kaal ||
column3: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!

column2: jiau machhee tiau maanasaa pavai achi(n)taa jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||

column2: sabh jag baadho kaal ko bin gur kaal afaar ||
column3: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.

column2: sach rate se ubare dhubidhaa chhodd vikaar ||
column3: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.

column2: hau tin kai balihaaranai dhar sachai sachiaar ||2||
column3: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||

column2: seechaane jiau pa(n)kheeaa jaalee badhik haath ||
column3: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.

column2: gur raakhe se ubare hor faathe chogai saath ||
column3: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.

column2: bin naavai chun suTe'eeh koi na sa(n)gee saath ||3||
column3: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||

column2: sacho sachaa aakheeaai sache sachaa thaan ||
column3: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.

column2: jinee sachaa ma(n)niaa tin man sach dhiaan ||
column3: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.

column2: man mukh sooche jaane'eeh gurmukh jinaa giaan ||4||
column3: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths are known to be pure. ||4||

column2: satigur agai aradhaas kar saajan dhei milai ||
column3: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with your Best Friend.

column2: saajan miliaai sukh paiaa jamadhoot mue bikh khai ||
column3: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall take poison and die.

column2: naavai a(n)dhar hau vasaa(n) naau vasai man aai ||5||
column3: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||

column2: baajh guroo gubaar hai bin sabadhai boojh na pai ||
column3: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding is not obtained.

column2: gurmatee paragaas hoi sach rahai liv lai ||
column3: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

column2: tithai kaal na sa(n)charai jotee jot samai ||6||
column3: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||

column2: too(n)hai saajan too(n) sujaan too(n) aape melanahaar ||
column3: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us with Yourself.

column2: gur sabadhee saalaaheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end or limitation.

column2: tithai kaal na apaRai jithai gur kaa sabadh apaar ||7||
column3: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad resounds. ||7||

column2: hukamee sabhe uoopajeh hukamee kaar kamaeh ||
column3: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions are performed.

column2: hukamee kaalai vas hai hukamee saach samaeh ||
column3: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.

column2: naanak jo tis bhaavai so theeaai inaa ja(n)taa vas kichh naeh ||8||4||
column3: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: man jooThai tan jooTh hai jihavaa jooThee hoi ||
column3: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well.

column2: mukh jhooThai jhooTh bolanaa kiau kar soochaa hoi ||
column3: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?

column2: bin abh sabadh na maa(n)jeeaai saache te sach hoi ||1||
column3: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||

column2: mu(n)dhe gunaheenee sukh keh ||
column3: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?

column2: pir raleeaa ras maanasee saach sabadh sukh neh ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

column2: pir paradhesee je theeaai dhan vaa(n)ddee jhoorei ||
column3: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,

column2: jiau jal thoRai machhulee karan palaav karei ||
column3: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

column2: pir bhaavai sukh paieeaai jaa aape nadhar karei ||2||
column3: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||

column2: pir saalaahee aapanaa sakhee sahelee naal ||
column3: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.

column2: tan sohai man mohiaa ratee ra(n)g nihaal ||
column3: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.

column2: sabadh savaaree sohanee pir raave gun naal ||3||
column3: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||

column2: kaaman kaam na aaviee khoTee avaganiaar ||
column3: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.

column2: naa sukh peieeaai saahurai jhooTh jalee vekaar ||
column3: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.

column2: aavan va(n)n(j)n ddaakhaRo chhoddee ka(n)t visaar ||4||
column3: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||

column2: pir kee naar suhaavanee mutee so kit saadh ||
column3: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?

column2: pir kai kaam na aaviee bole faadhil baadh ||
column3: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.

column2: dhar ghar ddoiee naa lahai chhooTee dhoojai saadh ||5||
column3: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||

column2: pa(n)ddit vaacheh potheeaa naa boojheh veechaar ||
column3: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.

column2: an kau matee dhe chaleh maiaa kaa vaapaar ||
column3: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.

column2: kathanee jhooThee jag bhavai rahanee sabadhu su saar ||6||
column3: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||

column2: kete pa(n)ddit jotakee bedhaa kareh beechaar ||
column3: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.

column2: vaadh virodh salaahane vaadhe aavan jaan ||
column3: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.

column2: bin gur karam na chhuTasee keh sun aakh vakhaan ||7||
column3: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||

column2: sabh gunava(n)tee aakhe'eeh mai gun naahee koi ||
column3: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.

column2: har var naar suhaavanee mai bhaavai prabh soi ||
column3: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.

column2: naanak sabadh milaavaRaa naa vechhoRaa hoi ||8||5||
column3: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: jap tap sa(n)jam saadheeaai teerath keechai vaas ||
column3: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;

column2: pu(n)n dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa bin saache kiaa taas ||
column3: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?

column2: jehaa raadhe tehaa lunai bin gun janam vinaas ||1||
column3: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||

column2: mu(n)dhe gun dhaasee sukh hoi ||
column3: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.

column2: avagan tiaag samaieeaai gurmat pooraa soi ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||

column2: mool na bujhai aapanaa vasat rahee ghar baar ||
