column2: vin vakhar dhukh agalaa kooR muThee kooRiaar ||2||
column3: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

column2: laahaa ahinis nautanaa parakhe ratan veechaar ||
column3: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

column2: vasat lahai ghar aapanai chalai kaaraj saar ||
column3: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

column2: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar gurmukh braham beechaar ||3||
column3: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

column2: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)gat paieeaai je mele melanahaar ||
column3: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

column2: miliaa hoi na vichhuRai jis a(n)tar jot apaar ||
column3: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

column2: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai prem piaar ||4||
column3: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

column2: jinee aap pachhaaniaa ghar meh mahal suthai ||
column3: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

column2: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai pai ||
column3: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

column2: tirabhavan so prabh jaaneeaai saacho saachai nai ||5||
column3: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

column2: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sa(n)g ||
column3: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

column2: mahalee mahal bulaieeaai so pir raave ra(n)g ||
column3: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

column2: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sa(n)g ||6||
column3: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

column2: bhoolee bhoolee thal chaRaa thal chaR ddoogar jaau ||
column3: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

column2: ban meh bhoolee je firaa bin gur boojh na paau ||
column3: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

column2: naavahu bhoolee je firaa fir fir aavau jaau ||7||
column3: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

column2: puchhahu jai padhaauooaa chale chaakar hoi ||
column3: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

column2: raajan jaaneh aapanaa dhar ghar Thaak na hoi ||
column3: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

column2: naanak eko rav rahiaa dhoojaa avar na koi ||8||6||
column3: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

column2: gur te niramal jaaneeaai niramal dheh sareer ||
column3: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

column2: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer ||

column2: gurmat saachaa man vasai naam bhalo pat saakh ||

column2: har naamai tul na pujiee sabh ddiThee Thok vajai ||3||

column2: manahaTh budhee keteeaa kete bedh beechaar ||

column2: kete ba(n)dhan jeea ke gurmukh mokh dhuaar ||

column2: poorai sabadh salaaheeaai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||9||
column3: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

column2: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sahaj kareh vaapaar ||
column3: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

column2: anadhin laahaa har naam lain akhuT bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
column3: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

column2: naanak toT na aaviee dhe'ee dhevanahaar ||10||6||23||
column3: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

column2: satigur miliaai fer na pavai janam maran dhukh jai ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

column2: poorai sabadh sabh sojhee hoiee har naamai rahai samai ||1||
column3: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

column2: man mere satigur siau chit lai ||
column3: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

column2: niramal naam sadh navatano aap vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

column2: har jeeau raakhahu apunee saranaiee jiau raakheh tiau rahanaa ||
column3: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

column2: gur kai sabadh jeevat marai gurmukh bhavajal taranaa ||2||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

column2: vaddai bhaag naau paieeaai gurmat sabadh suhaiee ||
column3: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

column2: aape man vasiaa prabh karataa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||3||
column3: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

column2: eikanaa manmukh sabadh na bhaavai ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaiaa ||
column3: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

column2: lakh chauraaseeh fir fir aavai birathaa janam gavaiaa ||4||
column3: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

column2: bhagataa man aana(n)dh hai sachai sabadh ra(n)g raate ||
column3: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

column2: anadhin gun gaaveh sadh niramal sahaje naam samaate ||5||
column3: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

column2: gurmukh a(n)mirat baanee boleh sabh aatam raam pachhaanee ||
column3: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

column2: eko sevan ek araadheh gurmukh akath kahaanee ||6||
column3: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

column2: sachaa saahib seveeaai gurmukh vasai man aai ||
column3: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

column2: sadhaa ra(n)g raate sach siau apunee kirapaa kare milai ||7||
column3: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

column2: aape kare karaae aape ikanaa sutiaa dhei jagai ||
column3: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

column2: aape mel milaidhaa naanak sabadh samai ||8||7||24||
column3: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

column2: satigur seviaai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer ||
column3: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

column2: man aana(n)dh sadhaa sukh paiaa bheTiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
column3: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

column2: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
column3: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

column2: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
column3: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

column2: satigur seviaai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

column2: sachai sabadh pat uoopajai sache sachaa naau ||
column3: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

column2: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

column2: manmukh sach na jaananee tin Thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

column2: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
column3: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

column2: sadhaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabadh nivaas ||
column3: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

column2: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa gurmatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
column3: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

column2: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
column3: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

column2: sachee saakhee upadhes sach sache sachee soi ||
column3: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

column2: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dhukhe'ee chale roi ||4||
column3: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

column2: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
column3: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

column2: jam dhar badhe maare'eh kook na sunai pookaar ||
column3: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

column2: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||5||
column3: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

column2: eh jag jalataa dhekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa ||
column3: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

column2: satigur sach dhiRaiaa sadhaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
column3: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

column2: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||6||
column3: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

column2: lakh chauraaseeh firadhe rahe bin satigur mukat na hoiee ||
column3: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

column2: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||
column3: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

column2: satigur sabadh sunaiaa bin sache avar na koiee ||7||
column3: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

column2: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
column3: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

column2: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
column3: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

column2: naanak bhagat sukhe'ee sadhaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
column3: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

column2: jaa kau musakal at banai ddoiee koi na dhei ||
column3: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

column2: laagoo hoe dhusamanaa saak bh bhaj khale ||
column3: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

column2: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau ||
column3: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

column2: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau ||1||
column3: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

column2: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan ||
column3: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

column2: aai na jaiee thir sadhaa gur sabadhee sach jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

column2: je ko hovai dhubalaa na(n)g bhukh kee peer ||
column3: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

column2: dhamaRaa palai naa pavai naa ko dhevai dheer ||
column3: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

column2: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj ||
column3: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

column2: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj ||2||
column3: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

column2: jaa kau chi(n)taa bahut bahut dhehee viaapai rog ||
column3: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

column2: girasat kuTa(n)b paleTiaa kadhe harakh kadhe sog ||
column3: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

column2: gaun kare chahu ku(n)T kaa ghaRee na baisan soi ||
column3: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

column2: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoi ||3||
column3: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

column2: kaam karodh moh vas keeaa kirapan lobh piaar ||
column3: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

column2: chaare kilavikh un agh ke'ee hoaa asur sa(n)ghaar ||
column3: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

column2: pothee geet kavit kichh kadhe na karan dhariaa ||
column3: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

column2: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa ||4||
column3: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

column2: saasat si(n)mirat bedh chaar mukhaagar bichare ||
column3: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

column2: tape tapeesar jogeeaa teerath gavan kare ||
column3: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

column2: khaT karamaa te dhugune poojaa karataa nai ||
column3: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

column2: ra(n)g na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jai ||5||
column3: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

column2: raaj milak sikadhaareeaa ras bhogan bisathaar ||
column3: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

column2: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam afaar ||
column3: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

column2: ra(n)g tamaase bahu bidhee chai lag rahiaa ||
column3: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

column2: chit na aaio paarabraham taa sarap kee joon giaa ||6||
column3: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

column2: bahut dhanaadd achaarava(n)t sobhaa niramal reet ||
column3: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

column2: maat pitaa sut bhaieeaa saajan sa(n)g pareet ||
column3: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

column2: lasakar tarakasaba(n)dh ba(n)dh jeeau jeeau sagalee keet ||
column3: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;

column2: chit na aaio paarabraham taa khaR rasaatal dheet ||7||
column3: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||

column2: kaiaa rog na chhidhr kichh naa kichh kaaRaa sog ||
column3: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief at all;

column2: mrit na aavee chit tis ahinis bhogai bhog ||
column3: you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;

column2: sabh kichh keeton aapanaa jeei na sa(n)k dhariaa ||
column3: you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

column2: chit na aaio paarabraham jamaka(n)kar vas pariaa ||8||
column3: but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

column2: kirapaa kare jis paarabraham hovai saadhoo sa(n)g ||
column3: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: jiau jiau oh vadhaieeaai tiau tiau har siau ra(n)g ||
column3: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.

column2: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam aap avar na dhoojaa thaau ||
column3: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.

column2: satigur tuThai paiaa naanak sachaa naau ||9||1||26||
column3: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained. ||9||1||26||

column2: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:

column2: jaanau nahee bhaavai kavan baataa ||
column3: I do not know what pleases my Lord.

column2: man khoj maarag ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||

column2: dhiaanee dhiaan laaveh ||
column3: The meditatives practice meditation,

column2: giaanee giaan kamaaveh ||
column3: and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,

column2: prabh kin hee jaataa ||1||
column3: but how rare are those who know God! ||1||

column2: bhagautee rahat jugataa ||
column3: The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,

column2: jogee kahat mukataa ||
column3: the Yogi speaks of liberation,

column2: tapasee tapeh raataa ||2||
column3: and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||

column2: monee monidhaaree ||
column3: The men of silence observe silence,

column2: saniaasee brahamachaaree ||
column3: the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,

column2: audhaasee udhaas raataa ||3||
column3: and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||

column2: bhagat navai parakaaraa ||
column3: There are nine forms of devotional worship.

column2: pa(n)ddit vedh pukaaraa ||
column3: The Pandits recite the Vedas.

column2: girasatee girasat dharamaataa ||4||
column3: The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||

column2: eik sabadhee bahu roop avadhootaa ||
column3: Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,

column2: kaapaRee kaute jaagootaa ||
column3: the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,

column2: eik teerath naataa ||5||
column3: and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||

column2: nirahaar varatee aaparasaa ||
column3: Those who go without food, those who never touch others,

column2: eik look na dheveh dharasaa ||
column3: the hermits who never show themselves,

column2: eik man hee giaataa ||6||
column3: and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||

column2: ghaaT na kin hee kahaiaa ||
column3: Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;

column2: sabh kahate hai paiaa ||
column3: all say that they have found the Lord.

column2: jis mele so bhagataa ||7||
column3: But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||

column2: sagal ukat upaavaa || tiaagee saran paavaa ||
column3: Abandoning all devices and contrivances, I have sought His Sanctuary.

column2: naanak gur charan paraataa ||8||2||27||
column3: Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27||

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa ||
column3: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

column2: jogee a(n)dhar jogeeaa ||
column3: Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;

column2: too(n) bhogee a(n)dhar bhogeeaa ||
column3: among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

column2: teraa a(n)t na paiaa surag machh piaal jeeau ||1||
column3: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||

column2: hau vaaree hau vaaranai kurabaan tere naav no ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||

column2: tudh sa(n)saar upaiaa ||
column3: You created the world,

column2: sire sir dha(n)dhe laiaa ||
column3: and assigned tasks to one and all.

column2: vekheh keetaa aapanaa kar kudharat paasaa ddaal jeeau ||2||
column3: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||

column2: paragaT paahaarai jaapadhaa ||
column3: You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.

column2: sabh naavai no parataapadhaa ||
column3: Everyone longs for Your Name,

column2: satigur baajh na paio sabh mohee maiaa jaal jeeau ||3||
column3: but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||

column2: satigur kau bal jaieeaai ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

column2: jit miliaai param gat paieeaai ||
column3: Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained.

column2: sur nar mun jan lochadhe so satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||4||
column3: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||

column2: satasa(n)gat kaisee jaaneeaai ||
column3: How is the Society of the Saints to be known?

column2: jithai eko naam vakhaaneeaai ||
column3: There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.

column2: eko naam hukam hai naanak satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||5||
column3: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||

column2: eih jagat bharam bhulaiaa ||
column3: This world has been deluded by doubt.

column2: aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
column3: You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.

column2: parataap lagaa dhohaaganee bhaag jinaa ke naeh jeeau ||6||
column3: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||

column2: dhohaaganee kiaa neesaaneeaa ||
column3: What are the signs of the discarded brides?

column2: khasamahu ghutheeaa fireh nimaaneeaa ||
column3: They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.

column2: maile ves tinaa kaamanee dhukhee rain vihai jeeau ||7||
column3: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||

column2: sohaaganee kiaa karam kamaiaa ||
column3: What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?

column2: poorab likhiaa fal paiaa ||
column3: They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.

column2: nadhar kare kai aapanee aape le milai jeeau ||8||
column3: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||

column2: hukam jinaa no manaiaa ||
column3: Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,

column2: tin a(n)tar sabadh vasaiaa ||
column3: have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

column2: saheeaa se sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar jeeau ||9||
column3: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||

column2: jinaa bhaane kaa ras aaiaa ||
column3: Those who take pleasure in God's Will

column2: tin vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||
column3: remove doubt from within.

column2: naanak satigur aaisaa jaaneeaai jo sabhasai le milai jeeau ||10||
column3: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||

column2: satigur miliaai fal paiaa ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,

column2: jin vichahu ahakaran chukaiaa ||
column3: and egotism is driven out from within.

column2: dhuramat kaa dhukh kaTiaa bhaag baiThaa masatak aai jeeau ||11||
column3: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||

column2: a(n)mrit teree baaneeaa ||
column3: The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

column2: teriaa bhagataa ridhai samaaneeaa ||
column3: It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.

column2: sukh sevaa a(n)dhar rakhiaai aapanee nadhar kareh nisataar jeeau ||12||
column3: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||

column2: satigur miliaa jaaneeaai ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;

column2: jit miliaai naam vakhaaneeaai ||
column3: by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

column2: satigur baajh na paio sabh thakee karam kamai jeeau ||13||
column3: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals. ||13||

column2: hau satigur viTahu ghumaiaa ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;

column2: jin bhram bhulaa maarag paiaa ||
column3: I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.

column2: nadhar kare je aapanee aape le ralai jeeau ||14||
column3: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||

column2: too(n) sabhanaa maeh samaiaa ||
column3: You, Lord, are pervading in all,

column2: tin karatai aap lukaiaa ||
column3: and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

column2: naanak gurmukh paragaT hoiaa jaa kau jot dharee karataar jeeau ||15||
column3: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||

column2: aape khasam nivaajiaa ||
column3: The Master Himself bestows honor.

column2: jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saajiaa ||
column3: He creates and bestows body and soul.

column2: aapane sevak kee paij rakheeaa dhui kar masatak dhaar jeeau ||16||
column3: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon their foreheads. ||16||

column2: sabh sa(n)jam rahe siaanapaa ||
column3: All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.

column2: meraa prabh sabh kichh jaanadhaa ||
column3: My God knows everything.

column2: pragaT prataap varataio sabh lok karai jaikaar jeeau ||17||
column3: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17 |

column2: mere gun avagan na beechaariaa ||
column3: He has not considered my merits and demerits;

column3: Her marriage is eternal; her Husband is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. O Servant Nanak, His Love is her only Support. ||4||4||11||

column3: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

column2: nirabhau niravair athaeh atole ||

column2: uooch neech kare pratipaalaa ||

column3: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

column3: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

column2: gurdhev sakhaa agiaan bha(n)jan gurdhev ba(n)dhip sahodharaa ||
column3: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

column2: gurdhev dhaataa har naam upadhesai gurdhev ma(n)t nirodharaa ||
column3: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

column2: gurdhev saa(n)t sat budh moorat gurdhev paaras paras paraa ||
column3: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

column2: gurdhev teerath a(n)mirat sarovar gur giaan majan apara(n)paraa ||
column3: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

column2: gurdhev karataa sabh paap harataa gurdhev patit pavit karaa ||
column3: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

column2: gurdhev aadh jugaadh jug jug gurdhev ma(n)t har jap udharaa ||
column3: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

column2: gurdhev sa(n)gat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham mooR paapee jit lag taraa ||
column3: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.

column2: gurdhev satigur paarabraham paramesar gurdhev naanak har namasakaraa ||1||
column3: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: aapeh keeaa karaiaa aapeh karanai jog ||
column3: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.

column2: naanak eko rav rahiaa dhoosar hoaa na hog ||1||
column3: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: oa(n) saadh satigur namasakaara(n) ||
column3: ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.

column2: aadh madh a(n)t nira(n)kaara(n) ||
column3: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.

column2: aapeh su(n)n aapeh sukh aasan ||
column3: He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat of peace.

column2: aapeh sunat aap hee jaasan ||
column3: He Himself listens to His Own Praises.

column2: aapan aap aapeh upaio ||
column3: He Himself created Himself.

column2: aapeh baap aap hee maio ||
column3: He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.

column2: aapeh sookham aapeh asathoolaa ||
column3: He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.

column2: lakhee na jaiee naanak leelaa ||1||
column3: O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||

column2: kar kirapaa prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
column3: O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,

column2: tere sa(n)tan kee man hoi ravaalaa || rahaau ||
column3: that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: nira(n)kaar aakaar aap niragun saragun ek ||
column3: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and also with attributes.

column2: ekeh ek bakhaanano naanak ek anek ||1||
column3: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: oa(n) gurmukh keeo akaaraa ||
column3: ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the Primal Guru.

column2: ekeh soot parovanahaaraa ||
column3: He strung it upon His one thread.

column2: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n trai gun bisathaara(n) ||
column3: He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.

column2: niragun te saragun dhirasaTaara(n) ||
column3: From formless, He appeared as form.

column2: sagal bhaat kar kareh upaio ||
column3: The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.

column2: janam maran man moh baddaio ||
column3: The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.

column2: dhuhoo bhaat te aap niraaraa ||
column3: He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.

column2: naanak a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||2||
column3: O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: seiee saeh bhagava(n)t se sach sa(n)pai har raas ||
column3: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and very fortunate.

column2: naanak sach such paieeaai teh sa(n)tan kai paas ||1||
column3: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1||

column2: pavaRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: sasaa sat sat sat souoo ||
column3: SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.

column2: sat purakh te bhi(n)n na kouoo ||
column3: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.

column2: souoo saran parai jeh paaya(n) ||
column3: They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.

column2: simar simar gun gai sunaaya(n) ||
column3: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

column2: sa(n)sai bharam nahee kachh biaapat ||
column3: Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.

column2: pragaT prataap taahoo ko jaapat ||
column3: They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.

column2: so saadhoo ieh pahuchanahaaraa ||
column3: They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.

column2: naanak taa kai sadh balihaaraa ||3||
column3: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: dhan dhan kahaa pukaarate maiaa moh sabh koor ||
column3: Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false.

column2: naam bihoone naanakaa hot jaat sabh dhoor ||1||
column3: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||

column2: pavaRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: dhadhaa dhoor puneet tere janooaa ||
column3: DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

column2: dhan teuoo jeh ruch iaa manooaa ||
column3: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

column2: dhan nahee baachheh surag na aachheh ||
column3: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

column2: at pria preet saadh raj raacheh ||
column3: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.

column2: dha(n)dhe kahaa biaapeh taahoo || jo ek chhaadd an kateh na jaahoo ||
column3: How can worldly affairs affect those who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

column2: jaa kai heeaai dheeo prabh naam ||
column3: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,

column2: naanak saadh pooran bhagavaan ||4||
column3: O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: anik bhekh ar n(g)iaan dhiaan manahaTh miliaau na koi ||
column3: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

column2: kahu naanak kirapaa bhiee bhagat n(g)iaanee soi ||1||
column3: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: n(g)(n)n(g)aa n(g)iaan nahee mukh baatau ||
column3: NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.

column2: anik jugat saasatr kar bhaatau ||
column3: It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

column2: n(g)iaanee soi jaa kai dhiraR souoo ||
column3: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

column2: kahat sunat kachh jog na houoo ||
column3: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

column2: n(g)iaanee rahat aagiaa dhiraR jaa kai ||
column3: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

column2: ausan seet samasar sabh taa kai ||
column3: Heat and cold are all the same to them.

column2: n(g)iaanee tat gurmukh beechaaree ||
column3: The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;

column2: naanak jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree ||5||
column3: O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: aavan aae sirasaT meh bin boojhe pas ddor ||
column3: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

column2: naanak gurmukh so bujhai jaa kai bhaag mathor ||1||
column3: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: yaa jug meh ekeh kau aaiaa ||
column3: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.

column2: janamat mohio mohanee maiaa ||
column3: But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

column2: garabh ku(n)T meh uradh tap karate ||
column3: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.

column2: saas saas simarat prabh rahate ||
column3: They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.

column2: aurajh pare jo chhodd chhaddaanaa ||
column3: But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.

column2: dhevanahaar maneh bisaraanaa ||
column3: They forget the Great Giver from their minds.

column2: dhaarahu kirapaa jiseh gusaiee || it ut naanak tis bisarahu naahee ||6||
column3: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagiaa bhi(n)n na koi ||
column3: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

column2: aavan jaanaa teh miTai naanak jeh man soi ||1||
column3: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: euoo jeea bahut grabh vaase ||
column3: This soul has lived in many wombs.

column2: moh magan meeTh jon faase ||
column3: Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

column2: ein maiaa trai gun bas keene ||
column3: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.

column2: aapan moh ghaTe ghaT dheene ||
column3: Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.

column2: e saajan kachh kahahu upaiaa ||
column3: O friend, tell me some way,

column2: jaa te tarau bikham ieh maiaa ||
column3: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.

column2: kar kirapaa satasa(n)g milaae ||
column3: The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

column2: naanak taa kai nikaT na maae ||7||
column3: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: kirat kamaavan subh asubh keene tin prabh aap ||
column3: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

column2: pas aapan hau hau karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat ||1||
column3: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: ekeh aap karaavanahaaraa ||
column3: The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.

column2: aapeh paap pu(n)n bisathaaraa ||
column3: He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

column2: eiaa jug jit jit aapeh laio ||
column3: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

column2: so so paio ju aap dhivaio ||
column3: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

column2: auaa kaa a(n)t na jaanai kouoo ||
column3: No one knows His limits.

column2: jo jo karai souoo fun houoo ||
column3: Whatever He does, comes to pass.

column2: ekeh te sagalaa bisathaaraa ||
column3: From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.

column2: naanak aap savaaranahaaraa ||8||
column3: O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: raach rahe banitaa binodh kusam ra(n)g bikh sor ||
column3: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

column2: naanak teh saranee parau binas jai mai mor ||1||
column3: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: re man bin har jeh rachahu teh teh ba(n)dhan paeh ||
column3: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

column2: jeh bidh katahoo na chhooTeeaai saakat teuoo kamaeh ||
column3: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

column2: hau hau karate karam rat taa ko bhaar afaar ||
column3: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

column2: preet nahee jau naam siau tau euoo karam bikaar ||
column3: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

column2: baadhe jam kee jevaree meeThee maiaa ra(n)g ||
column3: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

column2: bhram ke mohe neh bujheh so prabh sadhahoo sa(n)g ||
column3: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

column2: lekhai ganat na chhooTeeaai kaachee bheet na sudh ||
column3: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

column2: jiseh bujhaae naanakaa teh gurmukh niramal budh ||9||
column3: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: TooTe ba(n)dhan jaas ke hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
column3: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: jo raate ra(n)g ek kai naanak gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
column3: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: raaraa ra(n)gahu iaa man apanaa ||
column3: RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

column2: har har naam japahu jap rasanaa ||
column3: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

column2: re re dharageh kahai na kouoo ||
column3: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.

column2: aau baiTh aadhar subh dheuoo ||
column3: Everyone shall welcome you, saying, ""Come, and sit down.""

column2: auaa mahalee paaveh too baasaa ||
column3: In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.

column2: janam maran neh hoi binaasaa ||
column3: There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

column2: masatak karam likhio dhur jaa kai ||
column3: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

column2: har sa(n)pai naanak ghar taa kai ||10||
column3: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: laalach jhooTh bikaar moh biaapat mooRe a(n)dh ||
column3: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

column2: laag pare dhuraga(n)dh siau naanak maiaa ba(n)dh ||1||
column3: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: lalaa lapaT bikhai ras raate ||
column3: LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;

column2: aha(n)budh maiaa madh maate ||
column3: they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.

column2: eiaa maiaa meh janameh maranaa ||
column3: In this Maya, they are born and die.

column2: jiau jiau hukam tivai tiau karanaa ||
column3: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

column2: kouoo uoon na kouoo pooraa ||
column3: No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.

column2: kouoo sughar na kouoo mooraa ||
column3: No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

column2: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
column3: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.

column2: naanak Thaakur sadhaa alipanaa ||11||
column3: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: laal gupaal gobi(n)dh prabh gahir ga(n)bheer athaeh ||
column3: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

column2: dhoosar naahee avar ko naanak beparavaeh ||1||
column3: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: lalaa taa kai lavai na kouoo ||
column3: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.

column2: ekeh aap avar neh houoo ||
column3: He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.

column2: hovanahaar hot sadh aaiaa ||
column3: He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

column2: auaa kaa a(n)t na kaahoo paiaa ||
column3: No one has ever found His limit.

column2: keeT hasat meh poor samaane ||
column3: In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.

column2: pragaT purakh sabh Thaauoo jaane ||
column3: The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

column2: jaa kau dheeno har ras apanaa ||
column3: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

column2: naanak gurmukh har har teh japanaa ||12||
column3: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: aatam ras jeh jaaniaa har ra(n)g sahaje maan ||
column3: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

column2: naanak dhan dhan dha(n)n jan aae te paravaan ||1||
column3: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: aaiaa safal taahoo ko ganeeaai ||
column3: How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

column2: jaas rasan har har jas bhaneeaai ||
column3: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

column2: aai baseh saadhoo kai sa(n)ge ||
column3: They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

column2: anadhin naam dhiaaveh ra(n)ge ||
column3: night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.

column2: aavat so jan naameh raataa ||
column3: Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;

column2: jaa kau dhiaa miaa bidhaataa ||
column3: the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

column2: ekeh aavan fir jon na aaiaa ||
column3: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.

column2: naanak har kai dharas samaiaa ||13||
column3: O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: yaas japat man hoi ana(n)dh binasai dhoojaa bhaau || dhookh dharadh tirasanaa bujhai naanak naam samaau ||1||
column3: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched. O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: yayaa jaarau dhuramat dhouoo ||
column3: YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.

column2: tiseh tiaag sukh sahaje souoo ||
column3: Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.

column2: yayaa jai parahu sa(n)t saranaa ||
column3: Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;

column2: jeh aasar iaa bhavajal taranaa ||
column3: with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

column2: yayaa janam na aavai souoo || ek naam le maneh parouoo ||
column3: Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart, does not have to take birth again.

column2: yayaa janam na haareeaai gur poore kee Tek ||
column3: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

column2: naanak teh sukh paiaa jaa kai heearai ek ||14||
column3: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: a(n)tar man tan bas rahe ieet uoot ke meet ||
column3: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

column2: gur poorai upadhesiaa naanak japeeaai neet ||1||
column3: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: anadhin simarahu taas kau jo a(n)t sahaiee hoi ||
column3: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

column2: eeh bikhiaa dhin chaar chhia chhaadd chalio sabh koi ||
column3: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

column2: kaa ko maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
column3: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

column2: gireh banitaa kachh sa(n)g na leeaa ||
column3: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.

column2: aaisee sa(n)ch ju binasat naahee ||
column3: So gather that wealth which shall never perish,

column2: pat setee apunai ghar jaahee ||
column3: so that you may go to your true home with honor.

column2: saadhasa(n)g kal keeratan gaiaa ||
column3: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

column2: naanak te te bahur na aaiaa ||15||
column3: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: at su(n)dhar kuleen chatur mukh n(g)iaanee dhanava(n)t ||
column3: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

column2: mritak kahe'eeh naanakaa jeh preet nahee bhagava(n)t ||1||
column3: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: n(g)(n)n(g)aa khaT saasatr hoi n(g)iaataa ||
column3: NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.

column2: poorak ku(n)bhak rechak karamaataa ||
column3: He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.

column2: n(g)iaan dhiaan teerath isanaanee ||
column3: He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.

column2: somapaak aparas udhiaanee ||
column3: He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

column2: raam naam sa(n)g man nahee hetaa ||
column3: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,

column2: jo kachh keeno souoo anetaa ||
column3: then everything he does is transitory.

column2: auaa te uootam ganau cha(n)ddaalaa ||
column3: Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,

column2: naanak jeh man baseh gupaalaa ||16||
column3: O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: ku(n)T chaar dheh dhis bhrame karam kirat kee rekh ||
column3: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

column3: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column2: kakaa kaaran karataa souoo ||
column3: KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

column3: No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.

column3: Nothing can be done a second time.

column3: The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.

column2: kaahoo pa(n)th dhikhaarai aapai ||
column3: To some, He Himself shows the Way.

column2: kaahoo udhiaan bhramat pachhutaapai ||
column3: While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.

column2: aapan khel aap hee keeno ||
column3: He Himself has set His own play in motion.

column2: jo jo dheeno su naanak leeno ||17||
column3: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||

column3: Shalok:

column3: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

column2: har har japat anek jan naanak naeh sumaar ||1||
column3: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column3: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

column2: jo dhenaa so dhe rahio bhaavai teh teh jaeh ||
column3: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

column2: kharach khajaanaa naam dhan iaa bhagatan kee raas ||
column3: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

column2: khimaa gareebee anadh sahaj japat raheh gunataas ||
column3: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

column2: kheleh bigaseh anadh siau jaa kau hot kirapaal ||
column3: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

column2: sadheev ganeev suhaavane raam naam gireh maal ||
column3: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

column2: khedh na dhookh na ddaan teh jaa kau nadhar karee ||
column3: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

column2: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa pooree tinaa paree ||18||
column3: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: gan min dhekhahu manai maeh sarapar chalano log ||

column3: Pauree:

column3: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and every breath; meditate on Him forever.

column3: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;

column3: there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in old age.

column2: oh beraa neh boojheeaai jau aai parai jam fa(n)dh ||

column2: gur prasaadh simarat rahai jaahoo masatak bhaag ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.

column2: naanak aae safal te jaa kau prieh suhaag ||19||
column3: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ||19||

column3: Shalok:

column3: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:

column2: aadh jugaadhee hun hovat naanak ekai soi ||1||
column3: In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists.||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: ghaghaa ghaalahu maneh eh bin har dhoosar naeh ||
column3: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.

column2: neh hoaa neh hovanaa jat kat ohee samaeh ||
column3: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.

column2: ghooleh tau man jau aaveh saranaa ||
column3: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.

column2: naam tat kal meh punahacharanaa ||
column3: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.

column2: ghaal ghaal anik pachhutaaveh ||
column3: So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.

column2: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paaveh ||
column3: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?

column2: ghol mahaa ras a(n)mrit teh peeaa ||
column3: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,

column2: naanak har gur jaa kau dheeaa ||20||
column3: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: n(g)n ghaale sabh dhivas saas neh baddan ghaTan til saar ||
column3: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one little bit.

column2: jeevan loreh bharam moh naanak teuoo gavaar ||1||
column3: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column2: n(g)(n)n(g)aa n(g)raasai kaal teh jo saakat prabh keen ||

column3: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

column2: n(g)iaan dhiaan taahoo kau aae ||
column3: They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,

column2: kar kirapaa jeh aap dhivaae ||
column3: whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;

column2: n(g)natee n(g)nee nahee kouoo chhooTai ||
column3: no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.

column2: kaachee gaagar sarapar fooTai ||
column3: The vessel of clay shall surely break.

column2: so jeevat jeh jeevat japiaa ||
column3: They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.

column2: pragaT bhe naanak neh chhapiaa ||21||
column3: They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: chit chitavau charanaarabi(n)dh uoodh kaval bigasaa(n)t ||
column3: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

column2: pragaT bhe aapeh guobi(n)dh naanak sa(n)t mataa(n)t ||1||
column3: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column3: CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day, when I became attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

column2: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhram aaio ||
column3: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,

column3: God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

column2: chaar bichaar binasio sabh dhooaa ||
column3: By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.

column2: saadhasa(n)g man niramal hooaa ||
column3: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.

column2: chi(n)t bisaaree ek dhirasaTetaa ||
column3: Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,

column2: naanak giaan a(n)jan jeh netraa ||22||
column3: O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: chhaatee seetal man sukhee chha(n)t gobidh gun gai ||
column3: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

column2: aaisee kirapaa karahu prabh naanak dhaas dhasai ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column3: CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.

column3: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!

column2: chhaadd siaanap bahu chaturaiee ||

column3: and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

column2: chhaar kee putaree param gat paiee ||
column3: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,

column2: naanak jaa kau sa(n)t sahaiee ||23||
column3: O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: jor julam fooleh ghano kaachee dheh bikaar ||

column2: aha(n)budh ba(n)dhan pare naanak naam chhuTaar ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column3: he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.

column2: jau jaanai hau bhagat giaanee ||
column3: When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,

column2: aagai Thaakur til nahee maanee ||
column3: then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.

column2: jau jaanai mai kathanee karataa ||
column3: When he believes himself to be a preacher,

column2: biaapaaree basudhaa jiau firataa ||
column3: he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.

column2: saadhasa(n)g jeh haumai maaree ||
column3: But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,

column2: naanak taa kau mile muraaree ||24||
column3: O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: jhaalaaghe uTh naam jap nis baasur aaraadh ||

column2: kaarhaa tujhai na biaapiee naanak miTai upaadh ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column2: jhoorat jhoorat saakat mooaa ||

column3: his heart is filled with the love of duality.

column2: jhareh kasa(n)mal paap tere manooaa ||
column3: Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,

column2: a(n)mirat kathaa sa(n)tasa(n)g sunooaa ||
column3: listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.

column2: jhareh kaam karodh dhrusaTaiee ||
column3: Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,

column2: naanak jaa kau kirapaa gusaiee ||25||
column3: O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: n(j)tan karahu tum anik bidh rahan na paavahu meet ||
column3: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

column2: jeevat rahahu har har bhajahu naanak naam pareet ||1||

column2: n(j)aanahu iaa bidh sahee chit jhooThau maiaa ra(n)g ||
column3: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

column2: n(j)aanat soiee sa(n)t sui bhram te keechit bhi(n)n ||

column2: a(n)dh koop te teh kaddahu jeh hovahu suprasa(n)n ||

column2: n(j)aa kai haath samarath te kaaran karanai jog ||
column3: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

column2: naanak teh usatat karau n(j)aahoo keeo sa(n)jog ||26||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: TooTe ba(n)dhan janam maran saadh sev sukh pai ||

column2: naanak manahu na beesarai gun nidh gobidh rai ||1||

column3: Pauree:

column2: Tohe Taahe bahu bhavan bin naavai sukh naeh ||

column2: baar baar jaau sa(n)t sadhake ||
column3: Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.

column2: naanak paap binaase kadh ke ||27||
column3: O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: Thaak na hotee tinahu dhar jeh hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
column3: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

column2: jo jan prabh apune kare naanak te dhan dha(n)n ||1||

column2: Thahak Thahak maiaa sa(n)g mooe ||

column3: they do not find happiness anywhere.

column2: Thaa(n)dd paree sa(n)teh sa(n)g basiaa ||
column3: One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;

column2: a(n)mirat naam tahaa jeea rasiaa ||
column3: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.

column2: Thaakur apune jo jan bhaiaa ||
column3: That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master

column2: naanak uaa kaa man seetalaiaa ||28||
column3: - O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath ||
column3: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

column2: ddolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak dhe kar hath ||1||
column3: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||

column3: This place, here, is established by hard work,

column2: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sa(n)g chaalai ||
column3: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

column2: auaa dderaa kee so mit jaanai ||
column3: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,

column3: upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

column2: dderaa nihachal sach saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
column3: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

column2: naanak te jan neh ddolaiaa ||29||
column3: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
column3: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: ddaddaa ddooddat keh firahu ddooddan iaa man maeh ||
column3: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

column2: sa(n)g tuhaarai prabh basai ban ban kahaa firaeh ||
column3: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?

column2: dderee ddaahahu saadhasa(n)g aha(n)budh bikaraal ||
column3: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

column2: sukh paavahu sahaje basahu dharasan dhekh nihaal ||
column3: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

column2: dderee jaamai jam marai garabh jon dhukh pai ||
column3: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

column2: moh magan lapaTat rahai hau hau aavai jai ||
column3: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

column2: ddahat ddahat ab ddeh pare saadh janaa saranai ||
column3: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

column2: dhukh ke faahe kaaTiaa naanak le'ee samai ||30||
column3: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: jeh saadhoo gobidh bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
column3: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

column2: naa hau naa too(n) neh chhuTeh nikaT na jaieeahu dhoot ||1||
column3: - the Righteous Judge says, ""Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!""||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: naanaa ran te seejheeaai aatam jeetai koi ||
column3: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

column2: haumai an siau lar marai so sobhaa dhoo hoi ||
column3: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

column2: manee miTai jeevat marai gur poore upadhes ||
column3: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

column2: manooaa jeetai har milai teh sooratan ves ||

column2: naa ko jaanai aapano ekeh Tek adhaar ||

column2: rain dhinas simarat rahai so prabh purakh apaar ||

column2: ren sagal iaa man karai euoo karam kamai ||
column3: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

column2: hukamai boojhai sadhaa sukh naanak likhiaa pai ||31||
column3: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: tan man dhan arapau tisai prabhoo milaavai moh ||
column3: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

column2: naanak bhram bhau kaaTeeaai chookai jam kee joh ||1||
column3: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: tataa taa siau preet kar gun nidh gobidh rai ||
column3: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

column2: fal paaveh man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jai ||
column3: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

column2: traas miTai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||

column2: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai gireh joban neh raaj ||
