column2: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
column3: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

column2: taataa kachhoo na hoiee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
column3: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

column2: pratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maiee baap ||32||
column3: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: thaake bahu bidh ghaalate tirapat na tirasanaa laath ||
column3: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

column2: sa(n)ch sa(n)ch saakat mooe naanak maiaa na saath ||1||
column3: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: thathaa thir kouoo nahee kai pasaarahu paav ||
column3: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

column2: anik ba(n)ch bal chhal karahu maiaa ek upaav ||
column3: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

column2: thailee sa(n)chahu sram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar ||
column3: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

column2: man kai kaam na aaviee a(n)te aausar baar ||
column3: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

column2: thit paavahu gobidh bhajahu sa(n)teh kee sikh leh ||
column3: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

column2: preet karahu sadh ek siau iaa saachaa asaneh ||
column3: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

column2: kaaran karan karaavano sabh bidh ekai haath ||
column3: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

column2: jit jit laavahu tit tit lageh naanak ja(n)t anaath ||33||
column3: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: dhaaseh ek nihaariaa sabh kachh dhevanahaar ||
column3: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

column2: saas saas simarat raheh naanak dharas adhaar ||1||
column3: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: dhadhaa dhaataa ek hai sabh kau dhevanahaar ||
column3: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

column2: dhe(n)dhe toT na aaviee aganat bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
column3: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.

column2: dhainahaar sadh jeevanahaaraa ||
column3: The Great Giver is alive forever.

column2: man moorakh kiau taeh bisaaraa ||
column3: O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?

column2: dhos nahee kaahoo kau meetaa ||
column3: No one is at fault, my friend.

column2: maiaa moh ba(n)dh prabh keetaa ||
column3: God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.

column2: dharadh nivaareh jaa ke aape || naanak te te gurmukh dhraape ||34||
column3: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh; O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: dhar jeeare ik Tek too laeh biddaanee aas ||
column3: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

column2: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
column3: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: dhadhaa dhaavat tau miTai sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi baas ||
column3: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

column2: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoi maneh paragaas ||
column3: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.

column2: dhan saachaa teuoo sach saahaa ||
column3: Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.

column2: har har poo(n)jee naam bisaahaa ||
column3: The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.

column2: dheeraj jas sobhaa teh baniaa ||
column3: Patience, glory and honor come to those

column2: har har naam sravan jeh suniaa ||
column3: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

column2: gurmukh jeh ghaT rahe samaiee ||
column3: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,

column2: naanak teh jan milee vaddaiee ||35||
column3: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: naanak naam naam jap japiaa a(n)tar baahar ra(n)g ||
column3: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

column2: gur poorai upadhesiaa narak naeh saadhasa(n)g ||1||
column3: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: na(n)naa narak pareh te naahee || jaa kai man tan naam basaahee ||
column3: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.

column2: naam nidhaan gurmukh jo japate ||
column3: Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

column2: bikh maiaa meh naa oi khapate ||
column3: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

column2: na(n)naakaar na hotaa taa kahu || naam ma(n)tr gur dheeno jaa kahu ||
column3: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru, shall not be turned away.

column2: nidh nidhaan har a(n)mirat poore ||
column3: They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;

column2: teh baaje naanak anahadh toore ||36||
column3: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: pat raakhee gur paarabraham taj parapa(n)ch moh bikaar ||
column3: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy, emotional attachment and corruption.

column2: naanak souoo aaraadheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
column3: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: papaa paramit paar na paiaa ||
column3: PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.

column2: patit paavan agam har raiaa ||
column3: The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;

column2: hot puneet koT aparaadhoo ||
column3: He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;

column2: a(n)mirat naam japeh mil saadhoo ||
column3: they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: parapach dhroh moh miTanaiee ||
column3: Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,

column2: jaa kau raakhahu aap gusaiee ||
column3: by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.

column2: paatisaahu chhatr sir souoo ||
column3: He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.

column2: naanak dhoosar avar na kouoo ||37||
column3: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: faahe kaaTe miTe gavan fateh bhiee man jeet ||
column3: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.

column2: naanak gur te thit paiee firan miTe nit neet ||1||
column3: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderings cease. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: fafaa firat firat too aaiaa ||
column3: FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;

column2: dhrulabh dheh kalijug meh paiaa ||
column3: in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.

column2: fir iaa aausar charai na haathaa ||
column3: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.

column2: naam japahu tau kaTe'eeh faasaa ||
column3: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

column2: fir fir aavan jaan na hoiee ||
column3: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,

column2: ekeh ek japahu jap soiee ||
column3: if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.

column2: karahu kirapaa prabh karanaihaare ||
column3: Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,

column2: mel leh naanak bechaare ||38||
column3: and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: binau sunahu tum paarabraham dheen dhiaal gupaal ||
column3: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.

column2: sukh sa(n)pai bahu bhog ras naanak saadh ravaal ||1||
column3: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: babaa braham jaanat te brahamaa ||
column3: BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.

column2: baisano te gurmukh such dharamaa ||
column3: A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.

column2: beeraa aapan buraa miTaavai ||
column3: One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;

column2: taahoo buraa nikaT nahee aavai ||
column3: no evil even approaches him.

column2: baadhio aapan hau hau ba(n)dhaa ||
column3: Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.

column2: dhos dhet aageh kau a(n)dhaa ||
column3: The spiritually blind place the blame on others.

column2: baat cheet sabh rahee siaanap ||
column3: But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.

column2: jiseh janaavahu so jaanai naanak ||39||
column3: O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: bhai bha(n)jan agh dhookh naas maneh araadh hare ||
column3: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in your mind.

column2: sa(n)tasa(n)g jeh ridh basio naanak te na bhrame ||1||
column3: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wander around in doubt. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: bhabhaa bharam miTaavahu apanaa ||
column3: BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion

column2: eiaa sa(n)saar sagal hai supanaa ||
column3: this world is just a dream.

column2: bharame sur nar dhevee dhevaa ||
column3: The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.

column2: bharame sidh saadhik brahamevaa ||
column3: The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.

column2: bharam bharam maanukh ddahakaae ||
column3: Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.

column2: dhutar mahaa bikham ieh maae ||
column3: It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.

column2: gurmukh bhram bhai moh miTaiaa ||
column3: That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,

column2: naanak teh param sukh paiaa ||40||
column3: O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: maiaa ddolai bahu bidhee man lapaTio teh sa(n)g ||
column3: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.

column2: maagan te jeh tum rakhahu su naanak naameh ra(n)g ||1||
column3: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: mamaa maaganahaar iaanaa ||
column3: MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant

column2: dhenahaar dhe rahio sujaanaa ||
column3: the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.

column2: jo dheeno so ekeh baar ||
column3: Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.

column2: man moorakh keh kareh pukaar ||
column3: O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?

column2: jau maageh tau maageh beeaa ||
column3: Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;

column2: jaa te kusal na kaahoo theeaa ||
column3: no one has obtained happiness from these.

column2: maagan maag ta ekeh maag ||
column3: If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.

column2: naanak jaa te pareh paraag ||41||
column3: O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: mat pooree paradhaan te gur poore man ma(n)t ||
column3: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.

column2: jeh jaanio prabh aapunaa naanak te bhagava(n)t ||1||
column3: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: mamaa jaahoo maram pachhaanaa || bheTat saadhasa(n)g pateeaanaa ||
column3: MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: dhukh sukh uaa kai samat beechaaraa ||
column3: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.

column2: narak surag rahat aautaaraa ||
column3: They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.

column2: taahoo sa(n)g taahoo niralepaa ||
column3: They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.

column2: pooran ghaT ghaT purakh bisekhaa ||
column3: The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.

column2: auaa ras meh uaahoo sukh paiaa ||
column3: In His Love, they find peace.

column2: naanak lipat nahee teh maiaa ||42||
column3: O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: yaar meet sun saajanahu bin har chhooTan naeh ||
column3: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.

column2: naanak teh ba(n)dhan kaTe gur kee charanee paeh ||1||
column3: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1||

column2: pavaRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: yayaa jatan karat bahu bidheeaa ||
column3: YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,

column2: ek naam bin keh lau sidheeaa ||
column3: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?

column2: yaahoo jatan kar hot chhuTaaraa ||
column3: Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained

column2: auaahoo jatan saadh sa(n)gaaraa ||
column3: those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: yaa ubaran dhaarai sabh kouoo ||
column3: Everyone has this idea of salvation,

column2: auaaeh jape bin ubar na houoo ||
column3: but without meditation, there can be no salvation.

column2: yaahoo taran taaran samaraathaa ||
column3: The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.

column2: raakh leh niragun naranaathaa ||
column3: O Lord, please save these worthless beings!

column2: man bach karam jeh aap janaiee ||
column3: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed

column2: naanak teh mat pragaTee aaiee ||43||
column3: - O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: ros na kaahoo sa(n)g karahu aapan aap beechaar ||
column3: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.

column2: hoi nimaanaa jag rahahu naanak nadharee paar ||1||
column3: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: raaraa ren hot sabh jaa kee ||
column3: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.

column2: taj abhimaan chhuTai teree baakee ||
column3: Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.

column2: ran dharageh tau seejheh bhaiee ||
column3: Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

column2: jau gurmukh raam naam liv laiee ||
column3: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.

column2: rahat rahat reh jaeh bikaaraa || gur poore kai sabadh apaaraa ||
column3: Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out, by the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.

column2: raate ra(n)g naam ras maate ||
column3: You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of the Naam.

column2: naanak har gur keenee dhaate ||44||
column3: O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: laalach jhooTh bikhai biaadh iaa dhehee meh baas ||
column3: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.

column2: har har a(n)mrit gurmukh peeaa naanak sookh nivaas ||1||
column3: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: lalaa laavau aaukhadh jaahoo ||
column3: LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

column2: dhookh dharadh teh miTeh khinaahoo ||
column3: is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.

column2: naam aaukhadh jeh ridhai hitaavai ||
column3: One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,

column2: taeh rog supanai nahee aavai ||
column3: is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

column2: har aaukhadh sabh ghaT hai bhaiee ||
column3: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.

column2: gur poore bin bidh na banaiee ||
column3: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.

column2: gur poorai sa(n)jam kar dheeaa ||
column3: When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,

column2: naanak tau fir dhookh na theeaa ||45||
column3: then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: vaasudhev sarabatr mai uoon na katahoo Thai ||
column3: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.

column2: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g hai naanak kai dhurai ||1||
column3: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: vavaa vair na kareeaai kaahoo ||
column3: WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.

column2: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar braham samaahoo ||
column3: In each and every heart, God is contained.

column2: vaasudhev jal thal meh raviaa ||
column3: The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.

column2: gur prasaadh viralai hee gaviaa ||
column3: How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.

column2: vair virodh miTe teh man te ||
column3: Hatred and alienation depart from those

column2: har keeratan gurmukh jo sunate ||
column3: who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

column2: varan chihan sagaleh te rahataa || naanak har har gurmukh jo kahataa ||46||
column3: O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: hau hau karat bihaaneeaa saakat mugadh ajaan ||
column3: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.

column2: RaRak mue jiau tirakhaava(n)t naanak kirat kamaan ||1||
column3: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: RaaRaa RaaR miTai sa(n)g saadhoo ||
column3: RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

column2: karam dharam tat naam araadhoo ||
column3: meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and Dharma.

column2: rooRo jeh basio ridh maahee ||
column3: When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,

column2: auaa kee RaaR miTat binasaahee ||
column3: conflict is erased and ended.

column2: RaaR karat saakat gaavaaraa ||
column3: The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments

column2: jeh heeaai aha(n)budh bikaaraa ||
column3: his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.

column2: RaaRaa gurmukh RaaR miTaiee || nimakh maeh naanak samajhaiee ||47||
column3: RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant, O Nanak, through the Teachings. ||47||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: saadhoo kee man oT gahu ukat siaanap tiaag ||
column3: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.

column2: gur dheekhiaa jeh man basai naanak masatak bhaag ||1||
column3: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: sasaa saran pare ab haare || saasatr simirat bedh pookaare ||
column3: SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

column2: sodhat sodhat sodh beechaaraa ||
column3: I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,

column2: bin har bhajan nahee chhuTakaaraa ||
column3: that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.

column2: saas saas ham bhoolanahaare ||
column3: With each and every breath, I make mistakes.

column2: tum samarath aganat apaare ||
column3: You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.

column2: saran pare kee raakh dhiaalaa ||
column3: I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!

column2: naanak tumare baal gupaalaa ||48||
column3: Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: khudhee miTee tab sukh bhe man tan bhe arog ||
column3: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.

column2: naanak dhirasaTee aaiaa usatat karanai jog ||1||
column3: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1||

column2: pauRee ||
column3: Pauree:

column2: khakhaa kharaa saraahau taahoo ||
column3: KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,

column2: jo khin meh uoone subhar bharaahoo ||
column3: who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.

column2: kharaa nimaanaa hot paraanee ||
column3: When the mortal being becomes totally humble,

column2: anadhin jaapai prabh nirabaanee ||
column3: then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

column2: bhaavai khasam ta uaa sukh dhetaa ||
column3: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.

column2: paarabraham aaiso aaganataa ||
column3: Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.

column2: asa(n)kh khate khin bakhasanahaaraa ||
column3: He forgives countless sins in an instant.

column2: naanak saahib sadhaa dhiaaraa ||49||
column3: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49||

column2: salok ||
column3: Shalok:

column2: sat kahau sun man mere saran parahu har rai ||
column3: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.

column2: aukat siaanap sagal tiaag naanak le samai ||1||
column3: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1||

column2: bhagat janaa kee baratan naam ||

column2: sa(n)t janaa kai man bisraam ||
column3: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

column2: har kaa naam dhaas kee oT ||
column3: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

column2: har kai naam udhare jan koT ||

column3: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

column3: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

column3: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

column2: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa ||
column3: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.

column2: naanak poojai har har dhevaa ||6||
column3: O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

column3: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

column2: har dhan jan kau aap prabh dheenaa ||
column3: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

column2: har har jan kai oT sataanee ||
column3: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

column2: har prataap jan avar na jaanee ||
column3: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

column2: ot pot jan har ras raate ||
column3: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.

column2: su(n)n samaadh naam ras maate ||
column3: In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

column2: aaTh pahar jan har har japai ||
column3: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

column2: har kaa bhagat pragaT nahee chhapai ||
column3: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

column2: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare ||
column3: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.

column2: naanak jan sa(n)g kete tare ||7||
column3: O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||

column2: paarajaat ih har ko naam ||
column3: This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.

column2: kaamadhen har har gun gaam ||
column3: The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

column2: sabh te uootam har kee kathaa ||
column3: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.

column3: Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

column3: The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.

column3: Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

column3: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

column3: Ashtapadee:

column2: khaT saasatr simirat vakhiaan ||
column3: the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;

column2: jog abhiaas karam dhram kiriaa ||
column3: the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;

column2: sagal tiaag ban madhe firiaa ||
column3: the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;

column2: anik prakaar ke'ee bahu jatanaa ||
column3: the performance of all sorts of works;

column2: pu(n)n dhaan home bahu ratanaa ||
column3: donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;

column2: sareer kaTai homai kar raatee ||
column3: cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;

column2: varat nem karai bahu bhaatee ||
column3: keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts

column2: nahee tul raam naam beechaar ||
column3: - none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

column2: naanak gurmukh naam japeeaai ik baar ||1||
column3: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

column2: nau kha(n)dd pirathamee firai chir jeevai ||
column3: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;

column2: mahaa udhaas tapeesar theevai ||
column3: you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation

column2: agan maeh homat paraan ||
column3: and burn yourself in fire;

column2: kanik asavai haivar bhoom dhaan ||
column3: you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;

column2: niaulee karam karai bahu aasan ||
column3: you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;

column2: jain maarag sa(n)jam at saadhan ||
column3: you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;

column2: nimakh nimakh kar sareer kaTaavai ||
column3: piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

column2: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai ||
column3: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

column2: har ke naam samasar kachh naeh ||
column3: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

column2: naanak gurmukh naam japat gat paeh ||2||

column2: man kaamanaa teerath dheh chhuTai ||

column2: garab gumaan na man te huTai ||
column3: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.

column2: soch karai dhinas ar raat ||
column3: You may practice cleansing day and night,

column2: man kee mail na tan te jaat ||
column3: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

column2: eis dhehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai ||
column3: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

column2: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa Tarai ||
column3: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.

column2: jal dhovai bahu dheh aneet ||

column2: sudh kahaa hoi kaachee bheet ||
column3: but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

column2: man har ke naam kee mahimaa uooch ||
column3: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

column2: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch ||3||
column3: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

column2: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai ||
column3: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

column2: anik jatan kar tirasan naa dhraapai ||
column3: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.

column2: bhekh anek agan nahee bujhai ||
column3: Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.

column2: koT upaav dharageh nahee sijhai ||
column3: Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

column2: chhooTas naahee uoobh piaal ||
column3: You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,

column2: moh biaapeh maiaa jaal ||
column3: if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.

column2: avar karatoot sagalee jam ddaanai ||
column3: All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

column2: govi(n)dh bhajan bin til nahee maanai ||
column3: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

column2: har kaa naam japat dhukh jai ||
column3: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.

column2: naanak bolai sahaj subhai ||4||
column3: O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||

column2: chaar padhaarath je ko maagai ||

column2: saadh janaa kee sevaa laagai ||

column2: je ko aapunaa dhookh miTaavai ||

column2: har har naam ridhai sadh gaavai ||

column2: je ko apunee sobhaa lorai ||

column2: je ko janam maran te ddarai ||

column2: saadh janaa kee saranee parai ||
column3: then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

column2: jis jan kau prabh dharas piaasaa ||

column2: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa ||5||

column2: aapas kau jo jaanai neechaa ||

column2: souoo ganeeaai sabh te uoochaa ||

column2: jaa kaa man hoi sagal kee reenaa ||

column2: sookh dhookh jan sam dhirasaTetaa ||

column2: nimaane kau prabh tero maan ||

column2: sagal ghaTaa kau dhevahu dhaan ||

column2: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||

column2: sagal ghaTaa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||

column2: sagal kiraa meh uootam kiriaa ||

column2: sagal udham meh udham bhalaa ||

column2: har kaa naam japahu jeea sadhaa ||

column2: jaa kee Tahal paavai dharageh maan ||

column2: tiseh bisaarai mugadh ajaan ||
column3: and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.

column2: sadhaa sadhaa ih bhoolanahaar ||
column3: Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;

column2: naanak raakhanahaar apaar ||3||
column3: O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||

column2: saach chhodd jhooTh sa(n)g machai ||

column3: That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

column2: sa(n)g sahaiee tis paraharai ||

column2: garadhab preet bhasam sa(n)g hoi ||
column3: like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.

column2: a(n)dh koop meh patit bikaraal ||

column2: lok pachaaraa karai dhin raat ||
column3: They curse others day and night.

column2: baahar bhekh a(n)tar mal maiaa ||

column2: chhapas naeh kachh karai chhapaiaa ||

column2: baahar giaan dhiaan isanaan ||

column2: a(n)tar agan baahar tan suaaeh ||

column2: jaa kai a(n)tar basai prabh aap ||

column2: jatan karai tau bhee sur bha(n)g ||
column3: He may try, but his voice will fail him.

column2: keh pi(n)gul parabat par bhavan ||

column3: He simply cannot go there.

column2: karataar karunaa mai dheen benatee karai ||

column2: naanak tumaree kirapaa tarai ||6||
column3: Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

column2: sa(n)g sahaiee su aavai na cheet ||

column2: jo bairaiee taa siau preet ||
column3: He shows love to his enemies.

column2: balooaa ke gireh bheetar basai ||
column3: He lives in a castle of sand.

column2: anadh kel maiaa ra(n)g rasai ||
column3: He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.

column2: dhiraR kar maanai maneh prateet ||
column3: He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.

column2: kaal na aavai mooRe cheet ||
column3: Death does not even come to mind for the fool.

column2: bair birodh kaam karodh moh ||
column3: Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,

column2: jhooTh bikaar mahaa lobh dhroh ||
column3: falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:

column2: eiaahoo jugat bihaane kiee janam ||
column3: So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

column2: naanak raakh leh aapan kar karam ||7||

column2: too Thaakur tum peh aradhaas ||

column2: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teree raas ||

column2: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere ||

column2: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh dhoosar maneh na aanaanaa ||

column2: jo jan gai dhiaai jas Thaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaa(n) ||
column3: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

column2: kaaT sakat siv sahaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa ||
column3: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.

column3: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:

column2: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh guraprasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

column3: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

column2: e akhar khir jaahige oi akhar in meh naeh ||1||
column3: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

column2: jahaa bol teh achhar aavaa ||
column3: Wherever description is possible, only there the letters get used.

column2: jeh abol teh man na rahaavaa ||
column3: Where the state is beyond description, there, the mind itself ceases to be a descriptor.

column2: bol abol madh hai soiee ||
column3: He is in both speech and silence.

column2: jas oh hai tas lakhai na koiee ||2||
column3: No one can know or describe Him as He is. ||2||

column2: aleh lahau tau kiaa kahau kahau ta ko upakaar ||
column3: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

column2: baTak beej meh rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar ||3||
column3: His expanse spreads across the three worlds and He is contained within it just like the banyan tree is contained within its seed (and the seed is contained within the banyan tree). ||3||

column2: aleh laha(n)taa bhedh chhai kachh kachh paio bhedh ||
column3: One who tries to know the Unknowable Lord, his dilemma gets resolved, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

column2: aulaT bhedh man bedhio paio abha(n)g achhedh ||4||
column3: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

column2: turak tareekat jaaneeaai hi(n)dhoo bedh puraan ||
column3: The devout Muslim seeks guidance from the Tariqat ( Sufi scripture) ; the devout Hindu from the Vedas and Puraanas.

column3: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||

column2: oa(n)kaar aadh mai jaanaa ||
column3: I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

column2: likh ar meTai taeh na maanaa ||
column3: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes (into being) and erases.

column2: oa(n)kaar lakhai jau koiee ||
column3: If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,

column2: soiee lakh meTanaa na hoiee ||6||
column3: Knowing Him, (his elevated state) shall not perish. ||6||

column2: kakaa kiran kamal meh paavaa ||
column3: KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,

column2: sas bigaas sa(n)paT nahee aavaa ||
column3: the moon-light of Maya cannot close the blossomed heart lotus again.

column2: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa ||
column3: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,

column2: akeh kahaa keh kaa samajhaavaa ||7||
column3: I cannot describe the indescribable; I could speak, but what can I explain/describe? ||7||

column2: khakhaa ihai khoR man aavaa ||
column3: KHAKHA: When this mind (-bird that has received a ray of the divine light) has entered the tree hollow ( refuge of the Lord)

column2: khoRe chhaadd na dheh dhis dhaavaa ||
column3: It does not leave this tree hollow to wander in the ten directions.

column2: khasameh jaan khimaa kar rahai ||
column3: Then it (the mind bird) comes to know the source of compassion, the Lord and stays.

column2: tau hoi nikhiaau akhai padh lahai ||8||
column3: then, it becomes (one with) the immortal Lord, and attains the state of eternal dignity. ||8||

column2: gagaa gur ke bachan pachhaanaa ||
column3: GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word

column2: dhoojee baat na dhariee kaanaa ||
column3: does not listen to anything else.

column2: rahai biha(n)gam kateh na jaiee ||
column3: He remains unattached like a bird and does not go anywhere,

column2: ageh gahai geh gagan rahaiee ||9||
column3: when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||

column2: ghaghaa ghaT ghaT nimasai soiee ||
column3: GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every body.

column2: ghaT fooTe ghaT kabeh na hoiee ||
column3: Even when a body-pitcher bursts, the existence of the Lord does not diminish.

column2: taa ghaT maeh ghaaT jau paavaa ||

column2: so ghaT chhaadd avaghaT kat dhaavaa ||10||
column3: why should he abandon that landing/port to wander around? ||10||

column2: n(g)(n)n(g)aa nigreh saneh kar niravaaro sa(n)dheh ||
column3: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

column2: naahee dhekh na bhaajeeaai param siaanap eh ||11||
column3: (This task is hard, but) do not run away because the task seems hard and not attainable; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||

column2: chachaa rachit chitr hai bhaaree ||
column3: CHACHA: He created this world as if its a great painting.

column2: taj chitrai chetahu chitakaaree ||
column3: Let go of this painting, and remember the Painter.

column2: chitr bachitr ihai avajheraa ||
column3: The hassle is that this painting is so wondrous.

column2: taj chitrai chit raakh chiteraa ||12||
column3: ( To save yourself from this attachment) leave (contemplation of) the painting and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||

column2: chhachhaa ihai chhatrapat paasaa ||
column3: CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

column2: chhak k na rahahu chhaadd k na aasaa ||
column3: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

column2: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa ||
column3: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,

column2: taeh chhaadd kat aap badhaavaa ||13||
column3: but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||

column2: jajaa jau tan jeevat jaraavai ||

column2: joban jaar jugat so paavai ||
column3: and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

column2: as jar par jar jar jab rahai ||
column3: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,

column2: tab jai jot ujaarau lahai ||14||
column3: then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||

column2: jhajhaa urajh surajh nahee jaanaa ||
column3: JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.

column2: rahio jhajhak naahee paravaanaa ||
column3: You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.

column2: kat jhakh jhakh aauran samajhaavaa ||
column3: Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?

column2: jhagar ke'ee jhagarau hee paavaa ||15||
column3: Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||

column2: n(j)(n)n(j)aa nikaT ju ghaT rahio dhoor kahaa taj jai ||

column2: jaa kaaran jag ddooddiaau nerau paiaau taeh ||16||
column3: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||

column2: TaTaa bikaT ghaaT ghaT maahee ||

column2: khol kapaaT mahal k na jaahee ||
column3: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.

column2: dhekh aTal Tal kateh na jaavaa ||
column3: Beholding the Immovable Lord, you shall not slip and go anywhere else.

column2: rahai lapaT ghaT parachau paavaa ||17||
column3: You shall remain firmly attached to the Lord, and your heart will be happy. ||17||

column2: ThaThaa ihai dhoor Thag neeraa ||

column2: ddaddaa ddar upaje ddar jaiee ||

column2: niddar hooaa ddar ur hoi bhaagai ||19||

column2: ddaddaa ddig ddooddeh kat aanaa ||

column2: chaR sumer ddoodd jab aavaa ||

column2: dha(n)n janam taahee ko ganai ||

column2: dhasavai dhuaar ku(n)chee jab dheejai ||

column2: ba(n)dhak hoi ba(n)dh sudh lahai ||29||
column3: If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||

column2: ab bhau bhaan bharosau aavaa ||
column3: I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.

column2: jo baahar so bheetar jaaniaa ||

column2: bhiaa bhedh bhoopat pahichaaniaa ||30||

column2: mamaa mool gahiaa man maanai ||

column3: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.

column2: mat koiee man milataa bilamaavai ||

column2: magan bhiaa te so sach paavai ||31||
column3: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

column2: eih man pa(n)ch tat ko jeeau ||
column3: This mind is the life of the five elements.

column3: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

column3: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

column2: yayaa jau jaaneh tau dhuramat han kar bas kaiaa gaau ||
column3: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

column2: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau ||34||
column3: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||

column2: raaraa ras niras kar jaaniaa ||
column3: RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.

column2: hoi niras su ras pahichaaniaa ||
column3: Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

column2: eeh ras chhaadde uh ras aavaa ||
column3: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

column2: auh ras peeaa ieh ras nahee bhaavaa ||35||
column3: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||

column2: lalaa aaise liv man laavai ||
column3: LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

column2: anat na jai param sach paavai ||
column3: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

column2: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai ||
column3: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

column2: tau aleh lahai leh charan samaavai ||36||
column3: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||

column2: vavaa baar baar bisan samhaar ||
column3: WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.

column2: bisan sa(n)mhaar na aavai haar ||
column3: Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

column2: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai ||
column3: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

column2: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai ||37||
column3: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

column2: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeaai vaa jaane ih hoi ||
column3: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

column2: eih ar oh jab milai tab milat na jaanai koi ||38||
column3: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||

column2: sasaa so neekaa kar sodhahu ||
column3: SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.

column2: ghaT parachaa kee baat nirodhahu ||
column3: Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.

column2: ghaT parachai jau upajai bhaau ||
column3: The heart is attracted, when love wells up.

column2: poor rahiaa teh tirabhavan raau ||39||
column3: The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

column2: khakhaa khoj parai jau koiee || jo khojai so bahur na hoiee ||
column3: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him, finds Him, shall not be born again.

column2: khoj boojh jau karai beechaaraa ||
column3: When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

column2: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa ||40||
column3: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||

column2: sasaa so seh sej savaarai ||
column3: SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;

column2: soiee sahee sa(n)dheh nivaarai ||
column3: her skepticism is dispelled.

column2: alap sukh chhaadd param sukh paavaa ||
column3: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

column2: tab ieh treea ouh ka(n)t kahaavaa ||41||
column3: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||

column2: haahaa hot hoi nahee jaanaa ||
column3: HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

column2: jab hee hoi tabeh man maanaa ||
column3: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

column2: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koiee ||
column3: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

column2: tab ohee uh eh na hoiee ||42||
column3: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

column2: li(n)au li(n)au karat firai sabh log ||
column3: Everyone goes around saying, ""I'll take this, and I'll take that.""

column2: taa kaaran biaapai bahu sog ||
column3: Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

column2: lakhimee bar siau jau liau laavai ||
column3: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

column2: sog miTai sabh hee sukh paavai ||43||
column3: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||

column2: khakhaa khirat khapat ge kete ||
column3: KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.

column2: khirat khapat ajahoo(n) neh chete ||
column3: Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

column2: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai ||
column3: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

column2: jeh kaa bichhuraa teh thir lahai ||44||
column3: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||

column2: baavan akhar jore aan ||
column3: The fifty-two letters have been joined together.

column2: sakiaa na akhar ek pachhaan ||
column3: But people cannot recognize the One Word of God.

column2: sat kaa sabadh kabeeraa kahai ||
column3: Kabeer speaks the Shabad, the Word of Truth.

column2: pa(n)ddit hoi su anabhai rahai ||
column3: One who is a Pandit, a religious scholar, must remain fearless.

column2: pa(n)ddit logeh kau biauhaar ||
column3: It is the business of the scholarly person to join letters.

column2: giaanava(n)t kau tat beechaar ||
column3: The spiritual person contemplates the essence of reality.

column2: jaa kai jeea jaisee budh hoiee ||
column3: According to the wisdom within the mind,

column2: keh kabeer jaanaigaa soiee ||45||
column3: says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ||45||

column3: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing to You; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord of Dharma passes judgement.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
column3: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You, sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
column3: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavani(h) tudhano saadh beechaare ||
column3: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
column3: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriors sing to You.

column2: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRe rakheesur jug jug bedhaa naale ||
column3: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of the Vedas throughout the ages.

column2: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
column3: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world and in the nether regions, sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano ratan upaae tere jete aThasaTh teerath naale ||
column3: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavani(h) tudhano khaanee chaare ||
column3: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources of creation sing to You.

column2: gaavani(h) tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
column3: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand, sing to You.

column2: seiee tudhano gaavani(h) jo tudh bhaavani(h) rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
column3: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with the nectar of Your devotional worship.

column2: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
column3: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?

column2: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
column3: That Lord and Master - He is True, forever True; He is True, and True is His Name.

column2: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
column3: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.

column2: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
column3: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.

column2: kar kar dhekhai keetaa apanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
column3: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.

column2: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
column3: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him.

column2: so paatisaahu saahaa pat saahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||1||
column3: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1||

column2: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
column3: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

column2: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
column3: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.

column2: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
column3: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.

column2: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
column3: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.

column2: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||
column3: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.

column2: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
column3: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, how insignificant are mortal beings! ||1||

column2: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
column3: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One Primal Being, All-permeating.

column2: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
column3: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!

column2: too(n) aape dhaataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
column3: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other than You.

column2: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
column3: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?

column2: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin(h) kurabaanaa ||2||
column3: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

column2: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukh vaasee ||
column3: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

column2: se mukat se mukat bhe jin(h) har dhiaaiaa jeeau tin TooTee jam kee faasee ||
column3: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.

column2: jin nirabhau jin(h) har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jeeau tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
column3: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears are dispelled.

column2: jin(h) seviaa jin(h) seviaa meraa har jeeau te har har roop samaasee ||
column3: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

column2: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jeeau jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
column3: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

column2: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bea(n)t bea(n)taa ||
column3: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.

column2: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
column3: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.

column2: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
column3: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.

column2: tere anek tere anek paReh bahu si(n)mirat saasat jee kar kiriaa khaT karam kara(n)taa ||
column3: For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

column2: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
column3: Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||4||

column2: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
column3: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.

column2: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
column3: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You are the Eternal, Unchanging Creator.

column2: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
column3: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.

column2: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||
column3: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

column2: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoiee ||5||2||

column3: but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are.

column2: keemat pai na kahiaa jai ||

column2: kahanai vaale tere rahe samai ||1||

column2: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||

column2: koiee na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||

column3: all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.

column2: giaanee dhiaanee gur gur haiee ||

column2: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||

column2: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||

column2: sidhaa purakhaa keeaa vaddiaaieeaa(n) ||
column3: and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

column2: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
column3: without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.

column2: karam milai naahee Thaak rahaieeaa ||3||
column3: They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||

column2: aakhan vaalaa kiaa bechaaraa ||

column2: sifatee bhare tere bha(n)ddaaraa ||
column3: Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.

column2: jis too(n) dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
column3: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?

column2: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa ||4||1||
column3: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Aasaa, First Mehla:

column2: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau ||
column3: Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.

column2: aakhan aaukhaa saachaa naau ||
column3: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

column2: saache naam kee til vaddiaaiee || aakh thake keemat nahee paiee ||

column2: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh ||

column2: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||
column3: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||

column2: gun eho hor naahee koi ||

column2: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
column3: there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||

column2: jevadd aap tevadd teree dhaat ||
column3: As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.

column2: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||
column3: It is You who created day and night as well.

column2: khasam visaareh te kamajaat ||
column3: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

column2: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||2||
column3: O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Aasaa, First Mehla:

column2: je dhar maa(n)gat kook kare mahalee khasam sune ||
column3: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.

column2: bhaavai dheerak bhaavai dhake ek vaddaiee dhei ||1||

column2: jaanahu jot na poochhahu jaatee aagai jaat na he ||1|| rahaau ||

column2: aap karaae aap karei ||
column3: He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.

column2: aap ulaam(h)e chit dharei ||
column3: He Himself considers our complaints.

column2: jaa too(n) karanahaar karataar ||
column3: Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,

column2: kiaa muhataajee kiaa sa(n)saar ||2||
column3: why should I submit to the world? ||2||

column2: aap upaae aape dhei ||
column3: You Yourself created and You Yourself give.

column2: aape dhuramat maneh karei ||
column3: You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;

column2: gur parasaadh vasai man aai ||
column3: by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,

column2: dhukh an(h)eraa vichahu jai ||3||
column3: and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||

column2: saach piaaraa aap karei ||
column3: He Himself infuses love for the Truth.

column2: avaree kau saach na dhei ||
column3: Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.

column2: je kisai dhei vakhaanai naanak aagai poochh na lei ||4||3||
column3: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that person is not called to account. ||4||3||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Aasaa, First Mehla:

column2: taal madheere ghaT ke ghaaT ||
column3: The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;

column2: dholak dhuneeaa vaajeh vaaj ||
column3: the drum of the world resounds with the beat.

column2: naaradh naachai kal kaa bhaau ||
column3: Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

column2: jatee satee keh raakheh paau ||1||
column3: where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||

column2: naanak naam viTahu kurabaan ||
column3: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: a(n)dhee dhuneeaa saahib jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||

column2: guroo paasahu fir chelaa khai ||
column3: The disciple feeds on the Guru;

column2: taam pareet vasai ghar aai ||
column3: out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home.

column2: je sau varihaa jeevan khaan ||
column3: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,

column2: khasam pachhaanai so dhin paravaan ||2||
column3: that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||

column2: dharasan dhekhiaai dhiaa na hoi ||
column3: Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

column2: le dhite vin rahai na koi ||
column3: No one lives without give and take.

column2: raajaa niaau kare hath hoi ||
column3: The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.

column2: kahai khudhai na maanai koi ||3||
column3: No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||

column2: maanas moorat naanak naam ||
column3: O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;

column2: karanee kutaa dhar furamaan ||
column3: by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.

column2: gur parasaadh jaanai mihamaan ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,

column2: taa kichh dharageh paavai maan ||4||4||
column3: then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Aasaa, First Mehla:

column2: jetaa sabadh surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaiaa teree ||
column3: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

column2: too(n) aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na dhoojaa kahau maiee ||1||

column2: saahib meraa eko hai ||
column3: My Lord and Master is One;

column2: eko hai bhaiee eko hai ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

column2: aape maare aape chhoddai aape levai dhei ||
column3: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

column2: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadhar karei ||2||
column3: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

column2: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaiee ||
column3: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

column2: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeaai sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||3||

column2: kal kalavaalee maiaa madh meeThaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai ||
column3: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

column2: aape roop kare bahu bhaa(n)tee(n) naanak bapuRaa ev kahai ||4||5||
column3: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||

column2: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Aasaa, First Mehla:

column2: vaajaa mat pakhaavaj bhaau ||
column3: Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;

column2: hoi ana(n)dh sadhaa man chaau ||
column3: thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.

column2: ehaa bhagat eho tap taau ||

column2: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||1||

column2: poore taal jaanai saalaeh ||

column2: sat sa(n)tokh vajeh dhui taal ||

column2: raag naadh nahee dhoojaa bhaau ||
column3: Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

column2: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||2||

column2: bhau feree hovai man cheet ||

column2: leTan leT jaanai tan suaahu ||

column2: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||3||
column3: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||

column2: sikh sabhaa dheekhiaa kaa bhaau ||

column2: gurmukh sunanaa saachaa naau ||

column2: naanak aakhan veraa ver ||

column3: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.

column2: akhar birakh baag bhui chokhee si(n)chit bhaau karehee ||

column2: dhotee Tikaa naam samaal ||

column2: aaithai othai nibahee naal ||

column2: vin naavai hor karam na bhaal ||2||

column3: It goes here and there, hounded by death.

column3: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.

column2: aape bakhase satigur melai ||
column3: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.

column2: kaal ka(n)Tak maare sach pelai ||2||
column3: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||

column3: This mind is born of the five elements.

column3: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||

column3: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;

column2: eih man raajaa soor sa(n)graam ||
column3: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.

column2: maare pa(n)ch apunai vas ke'ee ||

column2: haumai graas ikat thai ke'ee ||6||

column3: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.

column2: anahadh sun maaniaa sabadh veechaaree ||
column3: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.

column2: aatam cheeni(h) bhe nira(n)kaaree ||7||
column3: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||

column2: eih man niramal dhar ghar soiee ||
column3: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.

column2: gurmukh bhagat bhaau dhun hoiee ||
column3: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.

column2: ahinis har jas gur parasaadh ||
column3: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.

column2: ghaT ghaT so prabh aadh jugaadh ||8||
column3: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||

column2: raam rasain ih man maataa ||
column3: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;

column2: sarab rasain gurmukh jaataa ||
column3: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.

column2: bhagat het gur charan nivaasaa ||
column3: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.

column3: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?

column2: raam naam bin kavan hamaaraa ||

column2: har gur dhaataa raam gupaalaa ||
column3: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

column2: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh dhiaalaa ||
column3: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.

column2: gurmukh raam merai man bhaiaa ||
column3: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.

column2: rog miTe dhukh Thaak rahaiaa ||3||
column3: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||

column3: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.

column2: har har simaran kilavikh ha(n)taa ||

column2: too(n) aap bhulaaveh naam visaar ||

column2: too(n) aape raakheh kirapaa dhaar ||4||
column3: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||

column3: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.

column2: aadh purakh gur dharas na dhekheh ||
column3: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.

column2: vin gur sabadhai janam k lekheh ||5||

column2: dhekh acharaj rahe bisamaadh ||
column3: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.

column2: ghaT ghaT sur nar sahaj samaadh ||
column3: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.

column2: bharipur dhaar rahe man maahee ||
column3: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.

column2: tum samasar avar ko naahee ||6||
column3: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||

column2: jaa kee bhagat het mukh naam ||
column3: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.

column2: sa(n)t bhagat kee sa(n)gat raam ||

column3: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.

column2: chhooTai gurmukh har gur giaan ||7||
column3: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||

column3: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;

column2: jo jan raam naam liv jaagai ||
column3: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.

column2: bhagat vachhal bhagataa har sa(n)g ||
column3: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.

column2: naanak mukat bhe har ra(n)g ||8||9||
column3: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||

column2: satigur sev dhekhahu prabh nainee ||1|| rahaau ||

column2: haumai dda(n)n sahai raajaa ma(n)gai dhaan ||4||

column2: tipat naahee maiaa moh pasaaree ||5||

column2: ba(n)dhan bedh baadh aha(n)kaar ||

column2: ba(n)dhan binasai moh vikaar ||7||
column3: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||

column2: naanak raam naam saranaiee ||
column3: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.

column2: satigur raakhe ba(n)dh na paiee ||8||10||

column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: je tis bhaavai dhe vaddiaaiee je bhaavai dhei sajai ||4||

column2: eik hi(n)dhavaanee avar turakaanee bhaTiaanee Thakuraanee ||
column3: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs

column3: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.

column2: jin(h) ke ba(n)ke gharee na aaiaa tin(h) kiau rain vihaanee ||6||
column3: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||

column2: je ghar boojhai aapanaa taa(n) needh na hoiee ||5||

column2: aaugan chhoddahu gun karahu aaise tat paraavahu ||7||

column2: karam hovai satigur milai boojhai beechaaraa ||
column3: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.

column2: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee vaddiaaiee ||10||13||

column2: a(n)tar jot sabadh dhun jaagai satigur jhagar niberai ||3||

column3: Serve such a True Guru, O my mind, that by serving Him, God's Love may be produced, and all others may be forgotten.

column3: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

column2: har kee tum sevaa karahu dhoojee sevaa karahu na koi jee ||

column2: kahai naanak har kaa bhaanaa hoaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaiee ||4||2||4||

column3: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

column2: har tis kadhe na veesarai har har kareh sadhaa man cheet ||1|| rahaau ||

column3: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6||

column3: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

column3: Goojaree, Third Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
