column2: maiaa mohe cheteh naahee ahilaa janam gavaavahe ||
column3: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.

column2: eik mooR mugadh na cheteh moole jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
column3: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.

column2: naam teraa sadhaa saachaa soi mai man bhaanaa ||2||
column3: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||

column2: teraa vakhat suhaavaa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||
column3: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

column2: sevak seveh bhaau kar laagaa saau paraanee ||
column3: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.

column2: saau praanee tinaa laagaa jinee a(n)mrit paiaa ||
column3: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the Ambrosial Name.

column2: naam terai joi raate nit chaReh savaiaa ||
column3: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.

column2: eik karam dharam na hoi sa(n)jam jaam na ek pachhaanee ||
column3: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.

column2: vakhat suhaavaa sadhaa teraa a(n)mirat teree baanee ||3||
column3: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

column2: hau balihaaree saache naavai ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to the True Name.

column2: raaj teraa kabahu na jaavai ||
column3: Your rule shall never end.

column2: raajo ta teraa sadhaa nihachal eh kabahu na jaave ||
column3: Your rule is eternal and unchanging; it shall never come to an end.

column2: chaakar ta teraa soi hovai joi sahaj samaave ||
column3: He alone becomes Your servant, who contemplates You in peaceful ease.

column2: dhusaman ta dhookh na lagai moole paap neR na aave ||
column3: Enemies and pains shall never touch him, and sin shall never draw near him.

column2: hau balihaaree sadhaa hovaa ek tere naave ||4||
column3: I am forever a sacrifice to the One Lord, and Your Name. ||4||

column2: jugeh juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare || keerat kareh suaamee terai dhuaare ||
column3: Throughout the ages, Your devotees sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, O Lord Master, at Your Door.

column2: japeh ta saachaa ek muraare ||
column3: They meditate on the One True Lord.

column2: saachaa muraare taam jaapeh jaam ma(n)n vasaavahe ||
column3: Only then do they meditate on the True Lord, when they enshrine Him in their minds.

column2: bharamo bhulaavaa tujheh keeaa jaam eh chukaavahe ||
column3: Doubt and delusion are Your making; when these are dispelled,

column2: gur parasaadhee karahu kirapaa leh jamahu ubaare ||
column3: then, by Guru's Grace, You grant Your Grace, and save them from the noose of Death.

column2: jugeh juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare ||5||
column3: Throughout the ages, they are Your devotees. ||5||

column2: vadde mere saahibaa alakh apaaraa ||
column3: O my Great Lord and Master, You are unfathomable and infinite.

column2: kiau kar karau bena(n)tee hau aakh na jaanaa ||
column3: How should I make and offer my prayer? I do not know what to say.

column2: nadhar kareh taa saach pachhaanaa ||
column3: If You bless me with Your Glance of Grace, I realize the Truth.

column2: saacho pachhaanaa taam teraa jaam aap bujhaavahe ||
column3: Only then do I come to realize the Truth, when You Yourself instruct me.

column2: dhookh bhookh sa(n)saar ke'ee sahasaa eh chukaavahe ||
column3: The pain and hunger of the world are Your making; dispel this doubt.

column2: binava(n)t naanak jai sahasaa bujhai gur beechaaraa ||
column3: Prays Nanak, ones skepticism is taken away, when he understands the Guru's wisdom.

column2: vaddaa saahib hai aap alakh apaaraa ||6||
column3: The Great Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ||6||

column2: tere ba(n)ke loin dha(n)t reesaalaa ||
column3: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful.

column2: sohane nak jin la(n)maRe vaalaa ||
column3: Your nose is so graceful, and Your hair is so long.

column2: ka(n)chan kaiaa suine kee ddaalaa ||
column3: Your body is so precious, cast in gold.

column2: sova(n)n ddaalaa kirasan maalaa japahu tusee saheleeho ||
column3: His body is cast in gold, and He wears Krishna's mala; meditate on Him, O sisters.

column2: jam dhuaar na hoh khaReeaa sikh sunahu maheleeho ||
column3: You shall not have to stand at Death's door, O sisters, if you listen to these teachings.

column2: ha(n)s ha(n)saa bag bagaa lahai man kee jaalaa ||
column3: From a crane, you shall be transformed into a swan, and the filth of your mind shall be removed.

column2: ba(n)ke loin dha(n)t reesaalaa ||7||
column3: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful. ||7||

column2: teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||
column3: Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet.

column2: kuhakan kokilaa taral juaanee ||
column3: You coo like a songbird, and your youthful beauty is alluring.

column2: taralaa juaanee aap bhaanee ichh man kee poore'e ||
column3: Your youthful beauty is so alluring; it pleases You, and it fulfills the heart's desires.

column2: saara(n)g jiau pag dharai Thim Thim aap aap sa(n)dhoore ||
column3: Like an elephant, You step with Your Feet so carefully; You are satisfied with Yourself.

column2: sreera(n)g raatee firai maatee udhak ga(n)gaa vaanee ||
column3: She who is imbued with the Love of such a Great Lord, flows intoxicated, like the waters of the Ganges.

column2: binava(n)t naanak dhaas har kaa teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||8||2||
column3: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave, O Lord; Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet. ||8||2||

column2: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa chha(n)t
column3: Wadahans, Third Mehla, Chhant:

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: aapane pir kai ra(n)g ratee muie'ee sobhaava(n)tee naare ||
column3: Let yourself be imbued with the Love of your Husband Lord, O beautiful, mortal bride.

column2: sachai sabadh mil rahee muie'ee pir raave bhai piaare ||
column3: Let yourself remain merged in the True Word of the Shabad, O mortal bride; savor and enjoy the Love of your Beloved Husband Lord.

column2: sachai bhai piaaree ka(n)t savaaree har har siau neh rachaiaa ||
column3: The Husband Lord embellishes His beloved bride with His True Love; she is in love with the Lord, Har, Har.

column2: aap gavaiaa taa pir paiaa gur kai sabadh samaiaa ||
column3: Renouncing her self-centeredness, she attains her Husband Lord, and remains merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

column2: saa dhan sabadh suhaiee prem kasaiee a(n)tar preet piaaree ||
column3: That soul bride is adorned, who is attracted by His Love, and who treasures the Love of her Beloved within her heart.

column2: naanak saa dhan mel liee pir aape saachai saeh savaaree ||1||
column3: O Nanak, the Lord blends that soul bride with Himself; the True King adorns her. ||1||

column2: niragunava(n)taRe'e pir dhekh hadhoore raam ||
column3: O worthless bride, see your Husband Lord ever-present.

column2: gurmukh jinee raaviaa muie'ee pir rav rahiaa bharapoore raam ||
column3: One who, as Gurmukh, enjoys her Husband Lord, O mortal bride, knows Him to be all-pervading everywhere.

column2: pir rav rahiaa bharapoore vekh hajoore jug jug eko jaataa ||
column3: The Lord is all-pervading everywhere; behold Him ever-present. Throughout the ages, know Him as the One.

column2: dhan baalee bholee pir sahaj raavai miliaa karam bidhaataa ||
column3: The young, innocent bride enjoys her Husband Lord; she meets Him, the Architect of karma.

column2: jin har ras chaakhiaa sabadh subhaakhiaa har sar rahee bharapoore ||
column3: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, and utters the sublime Word of the Shabad, remains immersed in the Lord's Ambrosial Pool.

column2: naanak kaaman saa pir bhaavai sabadhe rahai hadhoore ||2||
column3: O Nanak, that soul bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who, through the Shabad, remains in His Presence. ||2||

column2: sohaaganee jai poochhahu muie'ee jinee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
column3: Go and ask the happy soul-brides, O mortal bride, who have eradicated their self-conceit from within.

column2: pir kaa hukam na paio muie'ee jinee vichahu aap na gavaiaa ||
column3: Those who have not eradicated their self-conceit, O mortal bride, do not realize the Hukam of their Husband Lord's Command.

column2: jinee aap gavaiaa tinee pir paiaa ra(n)g siau raleeaa maanai ||
column3: Those who eradicate their self-conceit, obtain their Husband Lord; they delight in His Love.

column2: sadhaa ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee anadhin naam vakhaanai ||
column3: Ever imbued with His Love, in perfect poise and grace, she repeats His Name, night and day.

column2: kaaman vaddabhaagee a(n)tar liv laagee har kaa prem subhaiaa ||
column3: Very fortunate is that bride, who focuses her consciousness on Him; her Lord's Love is so sweet to her.

column2: naanak kaaman sahaje raatee jin sach seegaar banaiaa ||3||
column3: O Nanak, that soul-bride who is adorned with Truth, is imbued with her Lord's Love, in the state of perfect poise. ||3||

column2: haumai maar muie'ee too chal gur kai bhaae ||
column3: Overcome your egotism, O mortal bride, and walk in the Guru's Way.

column2: har var raaveh sadhaa muie'ee nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
column3: Thus you shall ever enjoy your Husband Lord, O mortal bride, and obtain an abode in the home of your own inner being.

column2: nij ghar vaasaa paae sabadh vajaae sadhaa suhaagan naaree ||
column3: Obtaining an abode in the home of her inner being, she vibrates the Word of the Shabad, and is a happy soul-bride forever.

column2: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa anadhin ka(n)t savaaree ||
column3: The Husband Lord is delightful, and forever young; night and day, He embellishes His bride.

column2: har var sohaago masatak bhaago sachai sabadh suhaae ||
column3: Her Husband Lord activates the destiny written on her forehead, and she is adorned with the True Shabad.

column2: naanak kaaman har ra(n)g raatee jaa chalai satigur bhaae ||4||1||
column3: O Nanak, the soul-bride is imbued with the Love of the Lord, when she walks according to the Will of the True Guru. ||4||1||

column2: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

column2: gurmukh sabh vaapaar bhalaa je sahaje keejai raam ||
column3: All dealings of the Gurmukh are good, if they are accomplished with poise and grace.

column2: anadhin naam vakhaaneeaai laahaa har ras peejai raam ||
column3: Night and day, he repeats the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he earns his profits, drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord.

column2: laahaa har ras leejai har raaveejai anadhin naam vakhaanai ||
column3: He earns the profit of the subtle essence of the Lord, meditating on the Lord, and repeating the Naam, night and day.

column2: gun sa(n)greh avagan vikaneh aapai aap pachhaanai ||
column3: He gathers in merits, and eliminates demerits, and realizes his own self.

column2: gurmat paiee vaddee vaddiaaiee sachai sabadh ras peejai ||
column3: Under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he drinks in the essence of the True Word of the Shabad.

column2: naanak har kee bhagat niraalee gurmukh viralai keejai ||1||
column3: O Nanak, devotional worship of the Lord is wonderful, but only a few Gurmukhs perform it. ||1||

column2: gurmukh khetee har a(n)tar beejeeaai har leejai sareer jamaae raam ||
column3: As Gurmukh, plant the crop of the Lord within the field of your body, and let it grow.

column2: aapane ghar a(n)dhar ras bhu(n)ch too laahaa lai parathaae raam ||
column3: Within the home of your own being, enjoy the Lord's subtle essence, and earn profits in the world hereafter.

column2: laahaa parathaae har ma(n)n vasaae dhan khetee vaapaaraa ||
column3: This profit is earned by enshrining the Lord within your mind; blessed is this farming and trade.

column2: har naam dhiaae ma(n)n vasaae boojhai gur beechaaraa ||
column3: Meditating on the Lord's Name, and enshrining Him within your mind, you shall come to understand the Guru's Teachings.

column2: manmukh khetee vanaj kar thaake tirasanaa bhukh na jaae ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of this farming and trade; their hunger and thirst will not go away.

column2: naanak naam beej man a(n)dhar sachai sabadh subhaae ||2||
column3: O Nanak, plant the seed of the Name within your mind, and adorn yourself with the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

column2: har vaapaar se jan laage jinaa masatak manee vaddabhaago raam ||
column3: Those humble beings engage in the Lord's Trade, who have the jewel of such pre-ordained destiny upon their foreheads.

column2: gurmatee man nij ghar vasiaa sachai sabadh bairaago raam ||
column3: Under Guru's Instruction, the soul dwells in the home of the self; through the True Word of the Shabad, she becomes unattached.

column2: mukh masatak bhaago sach bairaago saach rate veechaaree ||
column3: By the destiny written upon their foreheads, they become truly unattached, and by reflective meditation, they are imbued with Truth.

column2: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa sabadhe haumai maaree ||
column3: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is insane; through the Shabad, the ego is conquered.

column2: saachai sabadh laag mat upajai gurmukh naam sohaago ||
column3: Attached to the True Word of the Shabad, wisdom comes forth. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Husband Lord.

column2: naanak sabadh milai bhau bha(n)jan har raavai masatak bhaago ||3||
column3: O Nanak, through the Shabad, one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, and by the destiny written on her forehead, she enjoys Him. ||3||

column2: khetee vanaj sabh hukam hai hukame ma(n)n vaddiaaiee raam ||
column3: All farming and trading is by Hukam of His Will; surrendering to the Lord's Will, glorious greatness is obtained.

column2: gurmatee hukam boojheeaai hukame mel milaiee raam ||
column3: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand the Lord's Will, and by His Will, he is united in His Union.

column2: hukam milaiee sahaj samaiee gur kaa sabadh apaaraa ||
column3: By His Will, one merges and easily blends with Him. The Shabads of the Guru are incomparable.

column2: sachee vaddiaaiee gur te paiee sach savaaranahaaraa ||
column3: Through the Guru, true greatness is obtained, and one is embellished with Truth.

column2: bhau bha(n)jan paiaa aap gavaiaa gurmukh mel milaiee ||
column3: He finds the Destroyer of fear, and eradicates his self-conceit; as Gurmukh, he is united in His Union.

column2: kahu naanak naam nira(n)jan agam agochar hukame rahiaa samaiee ||4||2||
column3: Says Nanak, the Name of the immaculate, inaccessible, unfathomable Commander is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

column2: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

column2: man meriaa too sadhaa sach samaal jeeau ||
column3: O my mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

column2: aapanai ghar too sukh vaseh poh na sakai jamakaal jeeau ||
column3: Dwell in peace in the home of your own self, and the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

column2: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai saachai sabadh liv laae ||
column3: The noose of the Messenger of Death shall not touch you, when you embrace love for the True Word of the Shabad.

column2: sadhaa sach rataa man niramal aavan jaan rahaae ||
column3: Ever imbued with the True Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and its coming and going is ended.

column2: dhoojai bhai bharam vigutee manmukh mohee jamakaal ||
column3: The love of duality and doubt have ruined the self-willed manmukh, who is lured away by the Messenger of Death.

column2: kahai naanak sun man mere too sadhaa sach samaal ||1||
column3: Says Nanak, listen, O my mind: contemplate the True Lord forever. ||1||

column2: man meriaa a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai baahar vasat na bhaal ||
column3: O my mind, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside.

column2: jo bhaavai so bhu(n)ch too gurmukh nadhar nihaal ||
column3: Eat only that which is pleasing to the Lord, and as Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace.

column2: gurmukh nadhar nihaal man mere a(n)tar har naam sakhaiee ||
column3: As Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace, O my mind; the Name of the Lord, your help and support, is within you.

column2: manmukh a(n)dhule giaan vihoone dhoojai bhai khuaaiee ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are blind, and devoid of wisdom; they are ruined by the love of duality.

column2: bin naavai ko chhooTai naahee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
column3: Without the Name, no one is emancipated. All are bound by the Messenger of Death.

column2: naanak a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai too baahar vasat na bhaal ||2||
column3: O Nanak, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside. ||2||

column2: man meriaa janam padhaarath pai kai ik sach lage vaapaaraa ||
column3: O my mind, obtaining the blessing of this human birth, some are engaged in the trade of Truth.

column2: satigur sevan aapanaa a(n)tar sabadh apaaraa ||
column3: They serve their True Guru, and the Infinite Word of the Shabad resounds within them.

column2: a(n)tar sabadh apaaraa har naam piaaraa naame nau nidh paiee ||
column3: Within them is the Infinite Shabad, and the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Naam, the nine treasures are obtained.

column2: manmukh maiaa moh viaape dhookh sa(n)taape dhoojai pat gavaiee ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; they suffer in pain, and through duality, they lose their honor.

column2: haumai maar sach sabadh samaane sach rate adhikaiee ||
column3: But those who conquer their ego, and merge in the True Shabad, are totally imbued with Truth.

column2: naanak maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai satigur boojh bujhaiee ||3||
column3: O Nanak, it is so difficult to obtain this human life; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||3||

column2: man mere satigur sevan aapanaa se jan vaddabhaagee raam ||
column3: O my mind, those who serve their True Guru are the most fortunate beings.

column2: jo man maareh aapanaa se purakh bairaagee raam ||
column3: Those who conquer their minds are beings of renunciation and detachment.

column2: se jan bairaagee sach liv laagee aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa ||
column3: They are beings of renunciation and detachment, who lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord; they realize and understand their own selves.

column2: mat nihachal at gooRee gurmukh sahaje naam vakhaaniaa ||
column3: Their intellect is steady, deep and profound; as Gurmukh, they naturally chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: eik kaaman hitakaaree maiaa moh piaaree manmukh soi rahe abhaage ||
column3: Some are lovers of beautiful young women; emotional attachment to Maya is very dear to them. The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs remain asleep.

column2: naanak sahaje seveh gur apanaa se poore vaddabhaage ||4||3||
column3: O Nanak, those who intuitively serve their Guru, have perfect destiny. ||4||3||

column2: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

column2: ratan padhaarath vanaje'eeh satigur dheeaa bujhaiee raam ||
column3: Purchase the jewel, the invaluable treasure; the True Guru has given this understanding.

column2: laahaa laabh har bhagat hai gun meh gunee samaiee raam ||
column3: The profit of profits is the devotional worship of the Lord; one's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord.

column2: gun meh gunee samaae jis aap bujhaae laahaa bhagat saisaare ||
column3: One's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord; he comes to understand his own self. He earns the profit of devotional worship in this world.

column2: bin bhagatee sukh na hoiee dhoojai pat khoiee gurmat naam adhaare ||
column3: Without devotion, there is no peace; through duality, one's honor is lost, but under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with the Support of the Naam.

column2: vakhar naam sadhaa laabh hai jis no et vaapaar laae ||
column3: He ever earns the profit of the merchandise of the Naam, whom the Lord employs in this Trade.

column2: ratan padhaarath vanaje'eeh jaa(n) satigur dhei bujhaae ||1||
column3: He purchases the jewel, the invaluable treasure, unto whom the True Guru has given this understanding. ||1||

column2: maiaa moh sabh dhukh hai khoTaa ih vaapaaraa raam ||
column3: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal.

column2: kooR bol bikh khaavanee bahu vadheh vikaaraa raam ||
column3: Speaking falsehood, one eats poison, and the evil within increases greatly.

column2: bahu vadheh vikaaraa sahasaa ih sa(n)saaraa bin naavai pat khoiee ||
column3: The evil within increases greatly, in this world of doubt; without the Name, one's honor is lost.

column2: paR paR pa(n)ddit vaadh vakhaaneh bin boojhe sukh na hoiee ||
column3: Reading and studying, the religious scholars argue and debate; but without understanding, there is no peace.

column2: aavan jaanaa kadhe na chookai maiaa moh piaaraa ||
column3: Their comings and goings never end; emotional attachment to Maya is dear to them.

column2: maiaa moh sabh dhukh hai khoTaa ih vaapaaraa ||2||
column3: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal. ||2||

column2: khoTe khare sabh parakheean tit sache kai dharabaaraa raam ||
column3: The counterfeit and the genuine are all assayed in the Court of the True Lord.

column2: khoTe dharageh suTeean uoobhe karan pukaaraa raam ||
column3: The counterfeit are cast out of the Court, and they stand there, crying out in misery.

column2: uoobhe karan pukaaraa mugadh gavaaraa manmukh janam gavaiaa ||
column3: They stand there, crying out in misery; the foolish, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs have wasted their lives.

column2: bikhiaa maiaa jin jagat bhulaiaa saachaa naam na bhaiaa ||
column3: Maya is the poison which has deluded the world; it does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: manmukh sa(n)taa naal vair kar dhukh khaTe sa(n)saaraa ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are resentful toward the Saints; they harvest only pain in this world.

column2: khoTe khare parakheean tit sachai dharavaaraa raam ||3||
column3: The counterfeit and the genuine are assayed in that True Court of the Lord. ||3||

column2: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaiee raam ||
column3: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything.

column2: jit bhaavai tit laisee jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee raam ||
column3: As He pleases, He engages us; such is His glorious greatness.

column2: jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee aap karaiee vareeaam na fusee koiee ||
column3: Such is His glorious greatness - He Himself causes all to act; no one is a warrior or a coward.

column2: jagajeevan dhaataa karam bidhaataa aape bakhase soiee ||
column3: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Architect of karma - He Himself grants forgiveness.

column2: gur parasaadhee aap gavaieeaai naanak naam pat paiee ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated, O Nanak, and through the Naam, honor is obtained.

column2: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaiee ||4||4||
column3: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything. ||4||4||

column2: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

column2: sachaa saudhaa har naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa raam ||
column3: The True merchandise is the Lord's Name. This is the true trade.

column2: gurmatee har naam vanajeeaai at mol afaaraa raam ||
column3: Under Guru's Instruction, we trade in the Lord's Name; its value is very great.

column2: hau enee Tolee bhuleeas tis ka(n)t na baiThee paas jeeau ||
column3: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.

column2: a(n)bar koo(n)jaa kuraleeaa bag bahiThe aai jeeau ||
column3: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.

column2: saa dhan chalee saahurai kiaa muh dhesee agai jai jeeau ||
column3: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face will she show?

column2: sutee sutee jhaal theeaa bhulee vaaTaReeaas jeeau ||
column3: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.

column2: tai seh naalahu muteeas dhukhaa koo(n) dhareeaas jeeau ||
column3: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.

column2: tudh gun mai sabh avaganaa ik naanak kee aradhaas jeeau ||
column3: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:

column2: sabh raatee sohaaganee mai ddohaagan kaiee raat jeeau ||1||
column3: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1||

column2: soohee mahalaa pehilaa suchajee ||
column3: Soohee, First Mehla, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:

column2: jaa too taa mai sabh ko too saahib meree raas jeeau ||
column3: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealth and capital.

column2: tudh a(n)tar hau sukh vasaa too(n) a(n)tar saabaas jeeau ||
column3: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.

column2: bhaanai takhat vaddaieeaa bhaanai bheekh udhaas jeeau ||
column3: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasure of Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.

column2: bhaanai thal sir sar vahai kamal fulai aakaas jeeau ||
column3: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms in the sky.

column2: bhaanai bhavajal la(n)gheeaai bhaanai ma(n)jh bhareeaas jeeau ||
column3: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by the Pleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.

column2: bhaanai so sahu ra(n)gulaa sifat rataa gunataas jeeau ||
column3: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

column2: bhaanai sahu bheehaavalaa hau aavan jaan muieeaas jeeau ||
column3: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come and go, and die.

column2: too sahu agam atolavaa hau keh keh ddeh pieeaas jeeau ||
column3: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking of You, I have fallen at Your Feet.

column2: kiaa maagau kiaa keh sunee mai dharasan bhookh piaas jeeau ||
column3: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

column2: gur sabadhee sahu paiaa sach naanak kee aradhaas jeeau ||2||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2||

column2: soohee mahalaa panjavaa gunava(n)tee ||
column3: Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Gunvantee ~ The Worthy And Virtuous Bride:

column2: jo dheesai gursikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau pai jeeau ||
column3: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet.

column2: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee gur sajan dheh milai jeeau ||
column3: I tell to him the pain of my soul, and beg him to unite me with the Guru, my Best Friend.

column2: soiee dhas upadhesaRaa meraa man anat na kaahoo jai jeeau ||
column3: I ask that he impart to me such an understanding, that my mind will not go out wandering anywhere else.

column2: eih man tai koo(n) ddevasaa mai maarag dheh batai jeeau ||
column3: I dedicate this mind to you. Please, show me the Path to God.

column2: hau aaiaa dhoorahu chal kai mai takee tau saranai jeeau ||
column3: I have come so far, seeking the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

column2: mai aasaa rakhee chit meh meraa sabho dhukh gavai jeeau ||
column3: Within my mind, I place my hopes in You; please, take my pain and suffering away!

column2: eit maarag chale bhaieeaRe gur kahai su kaar kamai jeeau ||
column3: So walk on this Path, O sister soul-brides; do that work which the Guru tells you to do.

column2: tiaage(n) man kee mataRee visaare(n) dhoojaa bhaau jeeau ||
column3: Abandon the intellectual pursuits of the mind, and forget the love of duality.

column2: eiau paaveh har dharasaavaRaa neh lagai tatee vaau jeeau ||
column3: In this way, you shall obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; the hot winds shall not even touch you.

column2: hau aapahu bol na jaanadhaa mai kahiaa sabh hukamaau jeeau ||
column3: By myself, I do not even know how to speak; I speak all that the Lord commands.

column2: har bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa gur naanak keeaa pasaau jeeau ||
column3: I am blessed with the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship; Guru Nanak has been kind and compassionate to me.

column2: mai bahuR na tirasanaa bhukhaRee hau rajaa tirapat aghai jeeau ||
column3: I shall never again feel hunger or thirst; I am satisfied, satiated and fulfilled.

column2: jo gur dheesai sikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau pai jeeau ||3||
column3: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet. ||3||

column2: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
column3: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehla, First House:

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: bhar joban mai mat peieeaRai ghar paahunee bal raam jeeau ||
column3: Intoxicated with the wine of youth, I did not realize that I was only a guest at my parents' home (in this world).

column2: mailee avagan chit bin gur gun na samaavanee bal raam jeeau ||
column3: My consciousness is polluted with faults and mistakes; without the Guru, virtue does not even enter into me.

column2: gun saar na jaanee bharam bhulaanee joban baadh gavaiaa ||
column3: I have not known the value of virtue; I have been deluded by doubt. I have wasted away my youth in vain.

column2: var ghar dhar dharasan nahee jaataa pir kaa sahaj na bhaiaa ||
column3: I have not known my Husband Lord, His celestial home and gate, or the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I have not had the pleasure of my Husband Lord's celestial peace.

column2: satigur poochh na maarag chaalee sootee rain vihaanee ||
column3: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.

column2: naanak baalatan raaddepaa bin pir dhan kumalaanee ||1||
column3: O Nanak, in the prime of my youth, I am a widow; without my Husband Lord, the soul-bride is wasting away. ||1||

column2: baabaa mai var dheh mai har var bhaavai tis kee bal raam jeeau ||
column3: O father, give me in marriage to the Lord; I am pleased with Him as my Husband. I belong to Him.

column2: rav rahiaa jug chaar tirabhavan baanee jis kee bal raam jeeau ||
column3: He is pervading throughout the four ages, and the Word of His Bani permeates the three worlds.

column2: tirabhavan ka(n)t ravai sohaagan avaganava(n)tee dhoore ||
column3: The Husband Lord of the three worlds ravishes and enjoys His virtuous brides, but He keeps the ungraceful and unvirtuous ones far away.

column2: jaisee aasaa taisee manasaa poor rahiaa bharapoore ||
column3: As are our hopes, so are our minds' desires, which the All-pervading Lord brings to fulfillment.

column2: har kee naar su sarab suhaagan raa(n)dd na mailai vese ||
column3: The bride of the Lord is forever happy and virtuous; she shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to wear dirty clothes.

column2: naanak mai var saachaa bhaavai jug jug preetam taise ||2||
column3: O Nanak, I love my True Husband Lord; my Beloved is the same, age after age. ||2||

column2: baabaa lagan ganai ha(n) bhee va(n)n(j)aa saahurai bal raam jeeau ||
column3: O Baba, calculate that auspicious moment, when I too shall be going to my in-laws' house.

column2: saahaa hukam rajai so na Talai jo prabh karai bal raam jeeau ||
column3: The moment of that marriage will be set by the Hukam of God's Command; His Will cannot be changed.

column2: kirat piaa karatai kar paiaa meT na sakai koiee ||
column3: The karmic record of past deeds, written by the Creator Lord, cannot be erased by anyone.

column2: jaan(j)ee naau nareh nihakeval rav rahiaa tih loiee ||
column3: The most respected member of the marriage party, my Husband, is the independent Lord of all beings, pervading and permeating the three worlds.

column2: mai niraasee roi vichhu(n)nee baalee baalai hete ||
column3: Maya, crying out in pain, leaves, seeing that the bride and the groom are in love.

column2: naanak saach sabadh sukh mahalee gur charanee prabh chete ||3||
column3: O Nanak, the peace of the Mansion of God's Presence comes through the True Word of the Shabad; the bride keeps the Guru's Feet enshrined in her mind. ||3||

column2: baabul dhitaRee dhoor naa aavai ghar peieeaai bal raam jeeau ||
column3: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.

column2: rahasee vekh hadhoor pir raavee ghar soheeaai bal raam jeeau ||
column3: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.

column2: saache pir loRee preetam joRee mat pooree paradhaane ||
column3: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.

column2: sa(n)jogee melaa thaan suhelaa gunava(n)tee gur giaane ||
column3: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru's Wisdom, I have become virtuous.

column2: sat sa(n)tokh sadhaa sach palai sach bolai pir bhaae ||
column3: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

column2: naanak vichhuR naa dhukh paae gurmat a(n)k samaae ||4||1||
column3: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, I merge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1||

column2: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t ghar doojaa
column3: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Chhant, Second House:

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: ham ghar saajan aae ||
column3: My friends have come into my home.

column2: saachai mel milaae ||
column3: The True Lord has united me with them.

column2: sahaj milaae har man bhaae pa(n)ch mile sukh paiaa ||
column3: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with the chosen ones, I have found peace.

column2: saiee vasat paraapat hoiee jis setee man laiaa ||
column3: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.

column2: anadhin mel bhiaa man maaniaa ghar ma(n)dhar sohaae ||
column3: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.

column2: pa(n)ch sabadh dhun anahadh vaaje ham ghar saajan aae ||1||
column3: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||

column2: aavahu meet piaare || ma(n)gal gaavahu naare ||
column3: So come, my beloved friends, and sing the songs of joy, O sisters.

column2: sach ma(n)gal gaavahu taa prabh bhaavahu sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
column3: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughout the four ages.

column2: apanai ghar aaiaa thaan suhaiaa kaaraj sabadh savaare ||
column3: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated. Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.

column2: giaan mahaa ras netree a(n)jan tirabhavan roop dhikhaiaa ||
column3: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see the Lord's form throughout the three worlds.

column2: sakhee milahu ras ma(n)gal gaavahu ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||2||
column3: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends have come into my home. ||2||

column2: man tan a(n)mirat bhi(n)naa ||
column3: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;

column2: a(n)tar prem rata(n)naa ||
column3: deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

column2: a(n)tar ratan padhaarath merai param tat veechaaro ||
column3: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.

column2: ja(n)t bhekh too safalio dhaataa sir sir dhevanahaaro ||
column3: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.

column2: too jaan giaanee a(n)tarajaamee aape kaaran keenaa ||
column3: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.

column2: sunahu sakhee man mohan mohiaa tan man a(n)mirat bheenaa ||3||
column3: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind are drenched with Nectar. ||3||

column2: aatam raam sa(n)saaraa ||
column3: O Supreme Soul of the World,

column2: saachaa khel tum(h)aaraa ||
column3: Your play is true.

column2: sach khel tum(h)aaraa agam apaaraa tudh bin kaun bujhaae ||
column3: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make me understand?

column2: sidh saadhik siaane kete tujh bin kavan kahaae ||
column3: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?

column2: kaal bikaal bhe dhevaane man raakhiaa gur Thaae ||
column3: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.

column2: naanak avagan sabadh jalaae gun sa(n)gam prabh paae ||4||1||2||
column3: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulates virtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2||

column2: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa
column3: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Third House:

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: aavahu sajanaa hau dhekhaa dharasan teraa raam ||
column3: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

column2: ghar aapanaRai khaRee takaa mai man chaau ghaneraa raam ||
column3: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.

column2: man chaau ghaneraa sun prabh meraa mai teraa bharavaasaa ||
column3: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.

column2: dharasan dhekh bhiee nihakeval janam maran dhukh naasaa ||
column3: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; the pains of birth and death are taken away.

column2: sagalee jot jaataa too soiee miliaa bhai subhaae ||
column3: Your Light is in everyone; through it, You are known. Through love, You are easily met.

column2: naanak saajan kau bal jaieeaai saach mile ghar aae ||1||
column3: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Friend; He has come home to meet with those who are true. ||1||

column2: ghar aaiaRe saajanaa taa dhan kharee sarasee raam ||
column3: When her Friend comes to her home, the bride is very pleased.

column2: har mohiaRee saach sabadh Thaakur dhekh raha(n)see raam ||
column3: She is fascinated with the True Word of the Lord's Shabad; gazing upon her Lord and Master, she is filled with joy.

column2: gun sa(n)g raha(n)see kharee sarasee jaa raavee ra(n)g raatai ||
column3: She is filled with virtuous joy, and is totally pleased, when she is ravished and enjoyed by her Lord, and imbued with His Love.

column2: avagan maar gunee ghar chhaiaa poorai purakh bidhaatai ||
column3: Her faults and demerits are eradicated, and she roofs her home with virtue, through the Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

column2: tasakar maar vasee pa(n)chain adhal kare veechaare ||
column3: Conquering the thieves, she dwells as the mistress of her home, and administers justice wisely.

column2: naanak raam naam nisataaraa gurmat mileh piaare ||2||
column3: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, she is emancipated; through the Guru's Teachings, she meets her Beloved. ||2||

column2: var paiaRaa baalaRe'e aasaa manasaa pooree raam ||
column3: The young bride has found her Husband Lord; her hopes and desires are fulfilled.

column2: pir raaviaRee sabadh ralee rav rahiaa neh dhooree raam ||
column3: She enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord, and blends into the Word of the Shabad, pervading and permeating everywhere; the Lord is not far away.

column2: prabh dhoor na hoiee ghaT ghaT soiee tis kee naar sabaiee ||
column3: God is not far away; He is in each and every heart. All are His brides.

column2: aape raseeaa aape raave jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
column3: He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself ravishes and enjoys; this is His glorious greatness.

column2: amar addol amol apaaraa gur poorai sach paieeaai ||
column3: He is imperishable, immovable, invaluable and infinite. The True Lord is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

column2: naanak aape jog sajogee nadhar kare liv laieeaai ||3||
column3: O Nanak, He Himself unites in Union; by His Glance of Grace, He lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||3||

column2: pir uchaReeaai maaRaReeaai tih loaa sirataajaa raam ||
column3: My Husband Lord dwells in the loftiest balcony; He is the Supreme Lord of the three worlds.

column2: hau bisam bhiee dhekh gunaa anahadh sabadh agaajaa raam ||
column3: I am amazed, gazing upon His glorious excellence; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

column2: sabadh veechaaree karanee saaree raam naam neesaano ||
column3: I contemplate the Shabad, and perform sublime deeds; I am blessed with the insignia, the banner of the Lord's Name.

column2: naam binaa khoTe nahee Thaahar naam ratan paravaano ||
column3: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the false find no place of rest; only the jewel of the Naam brings acceptance and renown.

column2: pat mat pooree pooraa paravaanaa naa aavai naa jaasee ||
column3: Perfect is my honor, perfect is my intellect and password. I shall not have to come or go.

column2: naanak gurmukh aap pachhaanai prabh jaise avinaasee ||4||1||3||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands her own self; she becomes like her Imperishable Lord God. ||4||1||3||

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

column2: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laiaa ||
column3: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks.

column2: dhaan terai ghaT chaananaa tan cha(n)dh dheepaiaa ||
column3: Your gifts, O Lord, illuminate the heart, and the moon casts its light on the body.

column2: cha(n)dho dheepaiaa dhaan har kai dhukh a(n)dheraa uTh giaa ||
column3: The moon glows, by the Lord's gift, and the darkness of suffering is taken away.

column2: gun ja(n)n(j) laaRe naal sohai parakh mohaneeaai liaa ||
column3: The marriage party of virtue looks beautiful with the Groom; He chooses His enticing bride with care.

column2: veevaahu hoaa sobh setee pa(n)ch sabadhee aaiaa ||
column3: The wedding is performed with glorious splendor; He has arrived, accompanied by the vibrations of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds.

column2: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laiaa ||1||
column3: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks. ||1||

column2: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints.

column2: eih tan jin siau gaaddiaa man leeaRaa dheetaa ||
column3: This body is attached to them, and we have shared our minds.

column2: leeaa ta dheeaa maan jin(h) siau se sajan kiau veesareh ||
column3: We have shared our minds - how could I forget those friends?

column2: jin(h) dhis aaiaa hoh raleeaa jeea setee geh raheh ||
column3: Seeing them brings joy to my heart; I keep them clasped to my soul.

column2: sagal gun avagan na koiee hoh neetaa neetaa ||
column3: They have all virtues and merits, forever and ever; they have no demerits or faults at all.

column2: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||2||
column3: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints. ||2||

column2: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadd vaas lieejai ||
column3: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance.

column2: je gun hovani(h) saajanaa mil saajh kareejai ||
column3: If my friends have virtues, I will share in them.

column2: saajh kareejai guneh keree chhodd avagan chaleeaai ||
column3: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.

column2: pahire paTa(n)bar kar adda(n)bar aapanaa piR maleeaai ||
column3: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter the arena.

column2: jithai jai baheeaai bhalaa kaheeaai jhol a(n)mrit peejai ||
column3: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in.

column2: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadd vaas lieejai ||3||
column3: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||

column2: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor kare na koiee ||
column3: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.

column2: aakhan taa kau jaieeaai je bhoolaRaa hoiee ||
column3: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.

column2: je hoi bhoolaa jai kaheeaai aap karataa kiau bhulai ||
column3: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?

column2: sune dhekhe baajh kahiaai dhaan anama(n)giaa dhivai ||
column3: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.

column2: dhaan dhei dhaataa jag bidhaataa naanakaa sach soiee ||
column3: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the True Lord.

column2: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor kare na koiee ||4||1||4||
column3: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything. ||4||1||4||

column2: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: Soohee, First Mehla:

column2: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soiee ||
column3: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind.

column2: gur kee pauRee saach kee saachaa sukh hoiee ||
column3: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.

column2: sukh sahaj aavai saach bhaavai saach kee mat kiau Talai ||
column3: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings ever be erased?

column2: eisanaan dhaan sugiaan majan aap achhalio kiau chhalai ||
column3: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?

column2: parapa(n)ch moh bikaar thaake kooR kapaT na dhoiee ||
column3: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy and duality.

column2: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soiee ||1||
column3: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind. ||1||

column2: saahib so saalaaheeaai jin kaaran keeaa ||
column3: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.

column2: mail laagee man mailiaai kinai a(n)mrit peeaa ||
column3: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

column2: dharas bihoonaa saadh jan khin Tikan na aavai ||

column3: Those who are without the Lord suffer in hell; my mind is pierced through with the Lord's Feet.

column2: har rasik bairaagee naam liv laagee katahu na jai nikhedhiaa ||
column3: The Lord is both sensual and unattached; lovingly attune yourself to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. No one can ever deny Him.

column2: har siau jai milanaa saadhasa(n)g rahanaa so sukh a(n)k na maavai ||
column3: Go and meet with the Lord, and dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; no one can contain that peace within his being.

column3: Please be kind to me, O Lord and Master of Nanak, that I may merge in You. ||3||

column2: teraa jan ek aadh koiee ||

column2: kareh som paak hireh par dharabaa a(n)tar jhooTh gumaan ||
column3: The mortal eats the food which he has carefully prepared, and then steals the wealth of others. His inner being is filled with falsehood and pride.

column2: saasatr bedh kee bidh nahee jaaneh biaape man kai maan ||2||
column3: He knows nothing of the Vedas or the Shaastras; his mind is gripped by pride. ||2||

column2: sa(n)dhiaa kaal kareh sabh varataa jiau safaree dha(n)faan ||
column3: He says his evening prayers, and observes all the fasts, but this is all just a show.

column2: prabhoo bhulaae uoojhaR paae nihafal sabh karamaan ||3||
column3: God made him stray from the path, and sent him into the wilderness. All his actions are useless. ||3||

column2: so giaanee so baisanau paRi(h)aa jis karee kirapaa bhagavaan ||
column3: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is a devotee of Vishnu and a scholar, whom the Lord God blesses with His Grace.

column2: oun satigur sev param padh paiaa udhariaa sagal bisavaiaan ||4||
column3: Serving the True Guru, he obtains the supreme status and saves the whole world. ||4||

column2: kiaa ham katheh kichh kath nahee jaaneh prabh bhaavai tivai buolaan ||
column3: What can I say? I don't know what to say. As God wills, so do I speak.

column2: saadhasa(n)gat kee dhoor ik maa(n)gau jan naanak pio saraan ||5||2||
column3: I ask only for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Servant Nanak seeks their Sanctuary. ||5||2||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: ab moro naachano raho ||
column3: Now, my dancing is over.

column2: laal rageelaa sahaje paio satigur bachan laho ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: I have intuitively obtained my Darling Beloved. Through the Word of the True Guru's Teachings, I found Him. ||1||Pause||

column2: kuaar ka(n)niaa jaise sa(n)g saheree pria bachan upahaas kaho ||
column3: The virgin speaks with her friends about her husband and they laugh together;

column2: jau surijan gireh bheetar aaio tab mukh kaaj lajo ||1||
column3: but when he comes home, she becomes shy, and modestly covers her face. ||1||

column2: jiau kaniko koThaaree chaRio kabaro hot firo ||
column3: When gold is melted in the crucible, it flows freely everywhere.

column2: jab te sudh bhe hai baareh tab te thaan thiro ||2||
column3: But when it is made into pure solid bars of gold, then it remains stationary. ||2||

column2: jau dhin rain tuoo lau bajio moorat gharee palo ||
column3: As long as the days and the nights of one's life last, the clock strikes the hours, minutes and seconds.

column2: bajaavanahaaro uooTh sidhaario tab fir baaj na bhio ||3||
column3: But when the gong player gets up and leaves, the gong is not sounded again. ||3||

column2: jaise ku(n)bh udhak poor aanio tab ouh bhi(n)n dhirasaTo ||
column3: When the pitcher is filled with water, the water contained within it seems distinct.

column2: kahu naanak ku(n)bh jalai meh ddaario a(n)bhai a(n)bh milo ||4||3||
column3: Says Nanak, when the pitcher is emptied out, the water mingles again with water. ||4||3||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: ab poochhe kiaa kahaa ||
column3: Now if he is asked, what can he say?

column2: laino naam a(n)mirat ras neeko baavar bikh siau geh rahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: He was supposed to have gathered the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, but instead, the mad-man was busy with poison. ||1||Pause||

column2: dhulabh janam chira(n)kaal paio jaatau kauddee badhalahaa ||
column3: This human life, so difficult to obtain, was finally obtained after such a long time. He is losing it in exchange for a shell.

column2: kaathooree ko gaahak aaio laadhio kaalar birakh jivahaa ||1||
column3: He came to buy musk, but instead, he has loaded dust and thistle grass. ||1||

column2: aaio laabh laabhan kai taiee mohan Thaagauree siau ulajh pahaa ||
column3: He comes in search of profits, but he is entangled in the enticing illusion of Maya.

column2: kaach baadharai laal khoiee hai fir ih aausar kadh lahaa ||2||
column3: He loses the jewel, in exchange for mere glass. When will he have this blessed opportunity again? ||2||

column2: sagal paraadh ek gun naahee Thaakur chhoddeh dhaas bhajahaa ||
column3: He is full of sins, and he has not even one redeeming virtue. Forsaking his Lord and Master, he is involved with Maya, God's slave.

column2: aaiee masaT jaRavat kee niaaiee jiau tasakar dhar saa(n)ni(h)haa ||3||
column3: And when the final silence comes, like inanimate matter, he is caught like a thief at the door. ||3||

column2: aan upaau na kouoo soojhai har dhaasaa saranee par rahaa ||
column3: I cannot see any other way out. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's slaves.

column2: kahu naanak tab hee man chhuTeeaai jau sagale aaugan meT dharahaa ||4||4||
column3: Says Nanak, the mortal is emancipated, only when all his demerits and faults are erased and eradicated. ||4||4||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: maiee dheer rahee pria bahut biraagio ||
column3: O mother, my patience is gone. I am in love with my Husband Lord.

column2: anik bhaa(n)t aanoop ra(n)g re tin(h) siau ruchai na laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: There are so many kinds of incomparable pleasures, but I am not interested in any of them. ||1||Pause||

column2: nis baasur pria pria mukh Terau na(n)eedh palak nahee jaagio ||
column3: Night and day, I utter, ""Pri-a, Pri-a - Beloved, Beloved"" with my mouth. I cannot sleep, even for an instant; I remain awake and aware.

column2: haar kajar basatr anik seegaar re bin pir sabhai bikh laagio ||1||
column3: Necklaces, eye make-up, fancy clothes and decorations - without my Husband Lord, these are all poison to me. ||1||

column2: poochhau poochhau dheen bhaa(n)t kar kouoo kahai pria dhesaa(n)gio ||
column3: I ask and ask, with humility, ""Who can tell me which country my Husband Lord lives in?""

column2: hee(n)o dhe(n)au sabh man tan arapau sees charan par raakhio ||2||
column3: I would dedicate my heart to him, I offer my mind and body and everything; I place my head at his feet. ||2||

column2: charan ba(n)dhanaa amol dhaasaro dhe(n)au saadhasa(n)gat aradhaagio ||
column3: I bow at the feet of the voluntary slave of the Lord; I beg him to bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: karahu kirapaa moh prabhoo milaavahu nimakh dharas pekhaagio ||3||
column3: Show Mercy to me, that I may meet God, and gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan every moment. ||3||

column2: dhirasaT bhiee tab bheetar aaio meraa man anadhin seetalaagio ||
column3: When He is Kind to me, He comes to dwell within my being. Night and day, my mind is calm and peaceful.

column2: kahu naanak ras ma(n)gal gaae sabadh anaahadh baajio ||4||5||
column3: Says Nanak, I sing the Songs of Joy; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad resounds within me. ||4||5||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: maiee sat sat sat har sat sat sat saadhaa ||
column3: O mother, True, True True is the Lord, and True, True, True is His Holy Saint.

column2: bachan guroo jo poorai kahio mai chheek gaa(n)Tharee baadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: The Word which the Perfect Guru has spoken, I have tied to my robe. ||1||Pause||

column2: nis baasur nakhiatr binaasee rav saseear benaadhaa ||
column3: Night and day, and the stars in the sky shall vanish. The sun and the moon shall vanish.

column2: gir basudhaa jal pavan jaigo ik saadh bachan aTalaadhaa ||1||
column3: The mountains, the earth, the water and the air shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint shall endure. ||1||

column2: a(n)dd binaasee jer binaasee utabhuj set binaadhaa ||
column3: Those born of eggs shall pass away, and those born of the womb shall pass away. Those born of the earth and sweat shall pass away as well.

column2: chaar binaasee khaTeh binaasee ik saadh bachan nihachalaadhaa ||2||
column3: The four Vedas shall pass away, and the six Shaastras shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is eternal. ||2||

column2: raaj binaasee taam binaasee saatak bhee benaadhaa ||
column3: Raajas, the quality of energetic activity shall pass away. Taamas, the quality of lethargic darkness shall pass away. Saatvas, the quality of peaceful light shall pass away as well.

column2: dhirasaTimaan hai sagal binaasee ik saadh bachan aagaadhaa ||3||
column3: All that is seen shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is beyond destruction. ||3||

column2: aape aap aap hee aape sabh aapan khel dhikhaadhaa ||
column3: He Himself is Himself by Himself. All that is seen is His play.

column2: paio na jaiee kahee bhaa(n)t re prabh naanak gur mil laadhaa ||4||6||
column3: He cannot be found by any means. O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, God is found. ||4||6||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: merai man baasibo gur gobi(n)dh ||
column3: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.

column2: jahaa(n) simaran bhio hai Thaakur tahaa(n) nagar sukh aana(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Wherever my Lord and Master is remembered in meditation - that village is filled with peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

column2: jahaa(n) beesarai Thaakur piaaro tahaa(n) dhookh sabh aapadh ||
column3: Wherever my Beloved Lord and Master is forgotten - all misery and misfortune is there.

column2: jeh gun gai aana(n)dh ma(n)gal roop tahaa(n) sadhaa sukh sa(n)padh ||1||
column3: Where the Praises of my Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss and Joy are sung - eternal peace and wealth are there. ||1||

column2: jahaa sravan har kathaa na suneeaai teh mahaa bhiaan udhiaanadh ||
column3: Wherever they do not listen to the Stories of the Lord with their ears - the utterly desolate wilderness is there.

column2: jahaa(n) keeratan saadhasa(n)gat ras teh saghan baas falaa(n)nadh ||2||
column3: Where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung with love in the Saadh Sangat - there is fragrance and fruit and joy in abundance. ||2||

column2: bin simaran koT barakh jeevai sagalee aaudh birathaanadh ||
column3: Without meditative remembrance on the Lord, one may live for millions of years, but his life would be totally useless.

column2: ek nimakh gobi(n)dh bhajan kar tau sadhaa sadhaa jeevaanadh ||3||
column3: But if he vibrates and meditates on the Lord of the Universe, for even a moment, then he shall live forever and ever. ||3||

column2: saran saran saran prabh paavau dheejai saadhasa(n)gat kirapaanadh ||
column3: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary; please mercifully bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

column2: naanak poor rahio hai sarab mai sagal gunaa bidh jaa(n)nadh ||4||7||
column3: O Nanak, the Lord is All-pervading everywhere, amongst all. He knows the qualities and the condition of all. ||4||7||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: ab moh raam bharosau paae ||
column3: Now, I have obtained the Support of the Lord.

column2: jo jo saran pario karunaanidh te te bhaveh taraae ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the Ocean of Mercy are carried across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

column2: sukh soio ar sahaj samaio sahasaa gureh gavaae ||
column3: They sleep in peace, and intuitively merge into the Lord. The Guru takes away their cynicism and doubt.

column2: jo chaahat soiee har keeo man baa(n)chhat fal paae ||1||
column3: Whatever they wish for, the Lord does; they obtain the fruits of their minds' desires. ||1||

column2: hiradhai japau netr dhiaan laavau sravanee kathaa sunaae ||
column3: In my heart, I meditate on Him; with my eyes, I focus my meditation on Him. With my ears, I listen to His Sermon.

column2: charanee chalau maarag Thaakur kai rasanaa har gun gaae ||2||
column3: With my feet, I walk on my Lord and Mater's Path. With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

column2: dhekhio dhirasaT sarab ma(n)gal roop ulaTee sa(n)t karaae ||
column3: With my eyes, I see the Lord, the Embodiment of Absolute Bliss; the Saint has turned away from the world.

column2: paio laal amol naam har chhodd na katahoo jaae ||3||
column3: I have found the Priceless Name of the Beloved Lord; it never leaves me or goes anywhere else. ||3||

column2: kavan upamaa kaun baddaiee kiaa gun kahau reejhaae ||
column3: What praise, what glory and what virtues should I utter, in order to please the Lord?

column2: hot kirapaal dheen dhiaa prabh jan naanak dhaas dhasaae ||4||8||
column3: That humble being, unto whom the Merciful Lord is kind - O servant Nanak, he is the slave of God's slaves. ||4||8||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: oui sukh kaa siau baran sunaavat ||
column3: Who can I tell, and with whom can I speak, about this state of peace and bliss?

column2: anadh binodh pekh prabh dharasan man ma(n)gal gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: I am in ecstasy and delight, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. My mind sings His Songs of Joy and His Glories. ||1||Pause||

column2: bisam bhiee pekh bisamaadhee poor rahe kirapaavat ||
column3: I am wonderstruck, gazing upon the Wondrous Lord. The Merciful Lord is All-pervading everywhere.

column2: peeo a(n)mirat naam amolak jiau chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaavat ||1||
column3: I drink in the Invaluable Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Like the mute, I can only smile - I cannot speak of its flavor. ||1||

column2: jaise pavan ba(n)dh kar raakhio boojh na aavat jaavat ||
column3: As the breath is held in bondage, no one can understand its coming in and going out.

column2: jaa kau ridhai pragaas bhio har uaa kee kahee na jai kahaavat ||2||
column3: So is that person, whose heart is enlightened by the Lord - his story cannot be told. ||2||

column2: aan upaav jete kichh kahe'eeh tete seekhe paavat ||
column3: As many other efforts as you can think of - I have seen them and studied them all.

column2: achi(n)t laal gireh bheetar pragaTio agam jaise parakhaavat ||3||
column3: My Beloved, Carefree Lord has revealed Himself within the home of my own heart; thus I have realized the Inaccessible Lord. ||3||

column2: niragun nira(n)kaar abinaasee atulo tulio na jaavat ||
column3: The Absolute, Formless, Eternally Unchanging, Immeasurable Lord cannot be measured.

column2: kahu naanak ajar jin jariaa tis hee kau ban aavat ||4||9||
column3: Says Nanak, whoever endures the unendurable - this state belongs to him alone. ||4||9||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: bikhiee dhin rain iv hee gudhaarai ||
column3: The corrupt person passes his days and nights uselessly.

column2: gobi(n)dh na bhajai aha(n)budh maataa janam jooaai jiau haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: He does not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; he is intoxicated with egotistical intellect. He loses his life in the gamble. ||1||Pause||

column2: naam amolaa preet na tis siau par ni(n)dhaa hitakaarai ||
column3: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He loves only to slander others.

column2: chhaapar baa(n)dh savaarai tiran ko dhuaarai paavak jaarai ||1||
column3: Weaving the grass, he builds his house of straw. At the door, he builds a fire. ||1||

column2: kaalar poT uThaavai moo(n)ddeh a(n)mrit man te ddaarai ||
column3: He carries a load of sulfur on his head, and drives the Ambrosial Nectar out of his mind.

column2: oddai basatr kaajar meh pariaa bahur bahur fir jhaarai ||2||
column3: Wearing his good clothes, the mortal falls into the coal-pit; again and again, he tries to shake it off. ||2||

column2: kaaTai pedd ddaal par Thaaddau khai khai musakaarai ||
column3: Standing on the branch, eating and eating and smiling, he cuts down the tree.

column2: girio jai rasaatal pario chhiTee chhiTee sir bhaarai ||3||
column3: He falls down head-first and is shattered into bits and pieces. ||3||

column2: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaae pahuch na sakai gavaarai ||
column3: He bears vengeance against the Lord who is free of vengeance. The fool is not up to the task.

column2: kahu naanak sa(n)tan kaa raakhaa paarabraham nira(n)kaarai ||4||10||
column3: Says Nanak, the Saving Grace of the Saints is the Formless, Supreme Lord God. ||4||10||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: avar sabh bhoole bhramat na jaaniaa ||
column3: All the others are deluded by doubt; they do not understand.

column2: ek sudhaakhar jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa tin bedheh tat pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: That person, within whose heart the One Pure Word abides, realizes the essence of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

column2: paravirat maarag jetaa kichh hoieeaai tetaa log pachaaraa ||
column3: He walks in the ways of the world, trying to please people.

column2: jau lau ridhai nahee paragaasaa tau lau a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||1||
column3: But as long as his heart is not enlightened, he is stuck in pitch black darkness. ||1||

column2: jaise dharatee saadhai bahu bidh bin beejai nahee jaa(n)mai ||
column3: The land may be prepared in every way, but nothing sprouts without being planted.

column2: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee hai tuTai naahee abhimaanai ||2||
column3: Just so, without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated, nor is egotistical pride eradicated. ||2||

column2: neer bilovai at sram paavai nainoo kaise reesai ||
column3: The mortal may churn water until he is sore, but how can butter be produced?

column2: bin gur bheTe mukat na kaahoo milat nahee jagadheesai ||3||
column3: Without meeting the Guru, no one is liberated, and the Lord of the Universe is not met. ||3||

column2: khojat khojat ihai beechaario sarab sukhaa har naamaa ||
column3: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.

column2: kahu naanak tis bhio paraapat jaa kai lekh mathaamaa ||4||11||
column3: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed. ||4||11||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: anadhin raam ke gun kaheeaai ||
column3: Night and day, utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

column2: sagal padhaarath sarab sookh sidh man baa(n)chhat fal laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: You shall obtain all wealth, all pleasures and successes, and the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

column2: aavahu sa(n)t praan sukhadhaate simareh prabh abinaasee ||
column3: Come, O Saints, let us meditate in remembrance on God; He is the Eternal, Imperishable Giver of Peace and Praanaa, the Breath of Life.

column2: anaatheh naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan poor rahio ghaT vaasee ||1||
column3: Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; He is All-pervading and permeating, abiding in all hearts. ||1||

column2: gaavat sunat sunaavat saradhaa har ras pee vaddabhaage ||
column3: The very fortunate ones drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, singing, reciting and listening to the Lord's Praises.

column2: kal kales miTe sabh tan te raam naam liv jaage ||2||
column3: All their sufferings and struggles are wiped away from their bodies; they remain lovingly awake and aware in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

column2: kaam karodh jhooTh taj ni(n)dhaa har simaran ba(n)dhan tooTe ||
column3: So abandon your sexual desire, greed, falsehood and slander; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be released from bondage.

column2: moh magan aha(n) a(n)dh mamataa gur kirapaa te chhooTe ||3||
column3: The intoxication of loving attachments, egotism and blind possessiveness are eradicated by Guru's Grace. ||3||

column2: too samarath paarabraham suaamee kar kirapaa jan teraa ||
column3: You are All-Powerful, O Supreme Lord God and Master; please be Merciful to Your humble servant.

column2: poor rahio sarab meh Thaakur naanak so prabh neraa ||4||12||
column3: My Lord and Master is All-pervading and prevailing everywhere; O Nanak, God is Near. ||4||12||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: balihaaree gurdhev charan ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Divine Guru.

column2: jaa kai sa(n)g paarabraham dhiaaieeaai upadhes hamaaree gat karan ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: I meditate with Him on the Supreme Lord God; His Teachings have emancipated me. ||1||Pause||

column2: dhookh rog bhai sagal binaase jo aavai har sa(n)t saran ||
column3: All pains, diseases and fears are erased, for one who comes to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Saints.

column2: aap japai avareh naam japaavai vadd samarath taaran taran ||1||
column3: He Himself chants, and inspires others to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He is Utterly All-Powerful; He carries us across to the other side. ||1||

column2: jaa ko ma(n)tr utaarai sahasaa uoone kau subhar bharan ||
column3: His Mantra drives out cynicism, and totally fills the empty one.

column2: har dhaasan kee aagiaa maanat te naahee fun garabh paran ||2||
column3: Those who obey the Order of the Lord's slaves, do not enter into the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

column2: bhagatan kee Tahal kamaavat gaavat dhukh kaaTe taa ke janam maran ||
column3: Whoever works for the Lord's devotees and sings His Praises - his pains of birth and death are taken away.

column2: jaa kau bhio kirapaal beeThulaa tin har har ajar jaran ||3||
column3: Those unto whom my Beloved becomes Merciful, endure the Unendurable Ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

column2: har raseh aghaane sahaj samaane mukh te naahee jaat baran ||
column3: Those who are satisfied by the Sublime Essence of the Lord, merge intuitively into the Lord; no mouth can describe their state.

column2: gur prasaadh naanak sa(n)tokhe naam prabhoo jap jap udharan ||4||13||
column3: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they are content; chanting and meditating on God's Name, they are saved. ||4||13||

column2: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
column3: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

column2: gaio ree mai gun nidh ma(n)gal gaio ||
column3: I sing, O I sing the Songs of Joy of my Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

column2: bhale sa(n)jog bhale dhin aausar jau gopaal reejhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
column3: Fortunate is the time, fortunate is the day and the moment, when I become pleasing to the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

column2: sa(n)teh charan moralo maathaa ||
column3: I touch my forehead to the Feet of the Saints.

column2: hamare masatak sa(n)t dhare haathaa ||1||
column3: The Saints have placed their hands on my forehead. ||1||

column2: saadheh ma(n)tr moralo manooaa ||
column3: My mind is filled with the Mantra of the Holy Saints,

column2: taa te gat hoe trai guneeaa ||2||
column3: and I have risen above the three qualities||2||

column2: bhagateh dharas dhekh nain ra(n)gaa ||
column3: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of God's devotees, my eyes are filled with love.

column2: lobh moh tooTe bhram sa(n)gaa ||3||
column3: Greed and attachment are gone, along with doubt. ||3||

column2: kahu naanak sukh sahaj ana(n)dhaa ||
column3: Says Nanak, I have found intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

column2: kholi(h) bheet mile paramaana(n)dhaa ||4||14||
