column3: - I have seen them come crumbling down. O bride, do not be so proud of your nipples. ||1||

column2: sun mu(n)dhe haranaakhe'ee gooRaa vain apaar ||
column3: O bride with deer-like eyes, listen to the words of deep and infinite wisdom.

column2: pahilaa vasat sin(j)aan kai taa(n) keechai vaapaar ||
column3: First, examine the merchandise, and then, make the deal.

column2: dhohee dhichai dhurajanaa mitraa(n) koo(n) jaikaar ||
column3: Proclaim that you will not associate with evil people; celebrate victory with your friends.

column2: jit dhohee sajan milan lahu mu(n)dhe veechaar ||
column3: This proclamation, to meet with your friends, O bride - give it some thought.

column2: tan man dheejai sajanaa aaisaa hasan saar ||
column3: Surrender mind and body to the Lord your Friend; this is the most excellent pleasure.

column2: tis sau neh na keechiee j dhisai chalanahaar ||
column3: Do not fall in love with one who is destined to leave.

column2: naanak jin(h)ee iv kar bujhiaa tin(h)aa viTahu kurabaan ||2||
column3: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who understand this. ||2||

column2: je too(n) taaroo paan taahoo puchh tiRa(n)n(h) kal ||
column3: If you wish to swim across the water, then consult those who know how to swim.

column2: taahoo khare sujaan va(n)n(j)aa en(h)ee kaparee ||3||
column3: Those who have survived these treacherous waves are very wise. ||3||

column2: jhaR jhakhaR ohaaR laharee vahan lakhesaree ||
column3: The storm rages and the rain floods the land; thousands of waves rise and surge.

column2: satigur siau aalai beRe dduban naeh bhau ||4||
column3: If you cry out for help from the True Guru, you have nothing to fear - your boat will not sink. ||4||

column2: naanak dhuneeaa kaisee hoiee ||
column3: O Nanak, what has happened to the world?

column2: saalak mit na rahio koiee ||
column3: There is no guide or friend.

column2: bhaiee ba(n)dhee het chukaiaa ||
column3: There is no love, even among brothers and relatives.

column2: dhuneeaa kaaran dheen gavaiaa ||5||
column3: For the sake of the world, people have lost their faith. ||5||

column2: hai hai kar kai oh karen ||
column3: They cry and weep and wail.

column2: gal(h)aa piTan sir khohen ||
column3: They slap their faces and pull their hair out.

column2: naau lain ar karan samai ||
column3: But if they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they shall be absorbed into it.

column2: naanak tin balihaarai jai ||6||
column3: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to them. ||6||

column2: re man ddeeg na ddoleeaai seedhai maarag dhaau ||
column3: O my mind, do not waver or walk on the crooked path; take the straight and true path.

column2: paachhai baagh ddaraavano aagai agan talaau ||
column3: The terrible tiger is behind you, and the pool of fire is ahead.

column2: sahasai jeearaa par rahio maa kau avar na dda(n)g ||
column3: My soul is skeptical and doubtful, but I cannot see any other way to go.

column2: naanak gurmukh chhuTeeaai har preetam siau sa(n)g ||7||
column3: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, dwell with your Beloved Lord, and you shall be saved. ||7||

column2: baagh marai man maareeaai jis satigur dheekhiaa hoi ||
column3: The tiger is killed, and the mind is killed, through the Teachings of the True Guru.

column2: aap pachhaanai har milai bahuR na maranaa hoi ||
column3: One who understands himself, meets with the Lord, and never dies again.

column2: keechaR haath na booddiee ekaa nadhar nihaal ||
column3: One who sees the One and Only Lord with his eyes - his hands shall not get muddy and dirty.

column2: naanak gurmukh ubare gur saravar sachee paal ||8||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Guru has surrounded the ocean with the embankment of Truth. ||8||

column2: agan marai jal loR lahu vin gur nidh jal naeh ||
column3: If you wish to put out the fire, then look for water; without the Guru, the ocean of water is not found.

column2: janam marai bharamaieeaai je lakh karam kamaeh ||
column3: You shall continue to wander lost in reincarnation through birth and death, even if you do thousands of other deeds.

column2: jam jaagaat na lagiee je chalai satigur bhai ||
column3: But you shall not be taxed by the Messenger of Death, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

column2: naanak niramal amar padh gur har melai melai ||9||
column3: O Nanak, the immaculate, immortal status is obtained, and the Guru will unite you in the Lord's Union. ||9||

column2: kalar keree chhapaRee kuooaa mal mal nai ||
column3: The crow rubs and washes itself in the mud puddle.

column2: man tan mailaa avagunee chi(n)j bharee ga(n)dhee aai ||
column3: Its mind and body are polluted with its own mistakes and demerits, and its beak is filled with dirt.

column2: saravar ha(n)s na jaaniaa kaag kupa(n)khee sa(n)g ||
column3: The swan in the pool associated with the crow, not knowing that it was evil.

column2: saakat siau aaisee preet hai boojhahu giaanee ra(n)g ||
column3: Such is the love of the faithless cynic; understand this, O spiritually wise ones, through love and devotion.

column2: sa(n)t sabhaa jaikaar kar gurmukh karam kamaau ||
column3: So proclaim the victory of the Society of the Saints, and act as Gurmukh.

column2: niramal n(h)aavan naanakaa gur teerath dhareeaau ||10||
column3: Immaculate and pure is that cleansing bath, O Nanak, at the sacred shrine of the Guru's river. ||10||

column2: janame kaa fal kiaa ganee jaa(n) har bhagat na bhaau ||
column3: What should I account as the rewards of this human life, if one does not feel love and devotion to the Lord?

column2: paidhaa khaadhaa baadh hai jaa(n) man dhoojaa bhaau ||
column3: Wearing clothes and eating food is useless, if the mind is filled with the love of duality.

column2: vekhan sunanaa jhooTh hai mukh jhooThaa aalaau ||
column3: Seeing and hearing is false, if one speaks lies.

column2: naanak naam salaeh too hor haumai aavau jaau ||11||
column3: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; everything else is coming and going in egotism. ||11||

column2: hain virale naahee ghane fail fakaR sa(n)saar ||12||
column3: The Saints are few and far between; everything else in the world is just a pompous show. ||12||

column2: naanak lagee tur marai jeevan naahee taan ||
column3: O Nanak, one who is struck by the Lord dies instantaneously; the power to live is lost.

column2: choTai setee jo marai lagee saa paravaan ||
column3: If someone dies by such a stroke, then he is accepted.

column2: jis no laae tis lagai lagee taa paravaan ||
column3: He alone is struck, who is struck by the Lord; after such a stroke, he is approved.

column2: piram paikaam na nikalai laiaa tin sujaan ||13||
column3: The arrow of love, shot by the All-knowing Lord, cannot be pulled out. ||13||

column2: bhaa(n)ddaa dhovai kaun j kachaa saajiaa ||
column3: Who can wash the unbaked clay pot?

column2: dhaatoo pa(n)j ralai kooRaa paajiaa ||
column3: Joining the five elements together, the Lord made a false cover.

column2: bhaa(n)ddaa aanag raas jaa(n) tis bhaavasee ||
column3: When it pleases Him, He makes it right.

column2: param jot jaagai vaajaa vaavasee ||14||
column3: The supreme light shines forth, and the celestial song vibrates and resounds. ||14||

column2: manahu j a(n)dhe ghoop kahiaa biradh na jaananee ||
column3: Those who are totally blind in their minds, do not have the integrity to keep their word.

column2: man a(n)dhai uoo(n)dhai kaval dhisan khare karoop ||
column3: With their blind minds, and their upside-down heart-lotus, they look totally ugly.

column2: eik keh jaanan kahiaa bujhan te nar sughaR saroop ||
column3: Some know how to speak and understand what they are told. Those people are wise and good-looking.

column2: eikanaa naadh na bedh na geea ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
column3: Some do not know the Sound-current of the Naad, spiritual wisdom or the joy of song. They do not even understand good and bad.

column2: eikanaa sidh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheau na laha(n)t ||
column3: Some have no idea of perfection, wisdom or understanding; they know nothing about the mystery of the Word.

column2: naanak te nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||15||
column3: O Nanak, those people are really donkeys; they have no virtue or merit, but still, they are very proud. ||15||

column2: so brahaman jo bi(n)dhai braham ||
column3: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God.

column2: jap tap sa(n)jam kamaavai karam ||
column3: He chants and meditates, and practices austerity and good deeds.

column2: seel sa(n)tokh kaa rakhai dharam ||
column3: He keeps to the Dharma, with faith, humility and contentment.

column2: ba(n)dhan toRai hovai mukat ||
column3: Breaking his bonds, he is liberated.

column2: soiee brahaman poojan jugat ||16||
column3: Such a Brahmin is worthy of being worshipped. ||16||

column2: khatree so ju karamaa kaa soor ||
column3: He alone is a Kh'shaatriyaa, who is a hero in good deeds.

column2: pu(n)n dhaan kaa karai sareer ||
column3: He uses his body to give in charity;

column2: khet pachhaanai beejai dhaan ||
column3: he understands his farm, and plants the seeds of generosity.

column2: so khatree dharageh paravaan ||
column3: Such a Kh'shaatriyaa is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

column2: lab lobh je kooR kamaavai ||
column3: Whoever practices greed, possessiveness and falsehood,

column2: apanaa keetaa aape paavai ||17||
column3: shall receive the fruits of his own labors. ||17||

column2: tan na tapai tanoor jiau baalan hadd na baal ||
column3: Do not heat your body like a furnace, or burn your bones like firewood.

column2: sir pairee kiaa feRiaa a(n)dhar piree sam(h)aal ||18||
column3: What have your head and feet done wrong? See your Husband Lord within yourself. ||18||

column2: sabhanee ghaTee sahu vasai seh bin ghaT na koi ||
column3: God the Cosmic Husband dwells within all hearts; without Him, there is no heart at all.

column2: naanak te sohaaganee jin(h)aa gurmukh paragaT hoi ||19||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are the happy, virtuous soul-brides; the Lord is revealed to them. ||19||

column2: jau tau prem khelan kaa chaau ||
column3: If you desire to play this game of love with Me,

column2: sir dhar talee galee meree aau ||
column3: then step onto My Path with your head in hand.

column2: eit maarag pair dhareejai ||
column3: When you place your feet on this Path,

column2: sir dheejai kaan na keejai ||20||
column3: give Me your head, and do not pay any attention to public opinion. ||20||

column2: naal kiraaRaa dhosatee kooRai kooRee pai ||
column3: False is friendship with the false and greedy. False is its foundation.

column2: maran na jaapai mooliaa aavai kitai thai ||21||
column3: O Moollah, no one knows where death shall strike. ||21||

column2: giaan heena(n) agiaan poojaa ||
column3: Without spiritual wisdom, the people worship ignorance.

column2: a(n)dh varataavaa bhaau dhoojaa ||22||
column3: They grope in the darkness, in the love of duality. ||22||

column2: gur bin giaan dharam bin dhiaan ||
column3: Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom; without Dharma, there is no meditation.

column2: sach bin saakhee moolo na baakee ||23||
column3: Without Truth, there is no credit; without capital, there is no balance. ||23||

column2: maanoo ghalai uThee chalai ||
column3: The mortals are sent into the world; then, they arise and depart.

column2: saadh naahee ivehee galai ||24||
column3: There is no joy in this. ||24||

column2: raam jhurai dhal melavai a(n)tar bal adhikaar ||
column3: Raam Chand, sad at heart, assembled his army and forces.

column2: ba(n)tar kee sainaa seveeaai man tan jujh apaar ||
column3: The army of monkeys was at his service; his mind and body became eager for war.

column2: seetaa lai giaa dhahasiro lachhaman mooo saraap ||
column3: Raawan captured his wife Sita, and Lachhman was cursed to die.

column2: naanak karataa karanahaar kar vekhai thaap uthaap ||25||
column3: O Nanak, the Creator Lord is the Doer of all; He watches over all, and destroys what He has created. ||25||

column2: man meh jhoorai raamacha(n)dh seetaa lachhaman jog ||
column3: In his mind, Raam Chand mourned for Sita and Lachhman.

column2: hanava(n)tar aaraadhiaa aaiaa kar sa(n)jog ||
column3: Then, he remembered Hanuman the monkey-god, who came to him.

column2: bhoolaa dhait na samajhiee tin prabh ke'ee kaam ||
column3: The misguided demon did not understand that God is the Doer of deeds.

column2: naanak veparavaahu so kirat na miTiee raam ||26||
column3: O Nanak, the actions of the Self-existent Lord cannot be erased. ||26||

column2: laahauar sahar jahar kahar savaa pahar ||27||
column3: The city of Lahore suffered terrible destruction for four hours. ||27||

column2: mahalaa teejaa ||
column3: Third Mehla:

column2: laahauar sahar a(n)mirat sar sifatee dhaa ghar ||28||
column3: The city of Lahore is a pool of ambrosial nectar, the home of praise. ||28||

column2: mahalaa pehilaa ||
column3: First Mehla:

column2: audhosaahai kiaa neesaanee toT na aavai a(n)nee ||
column3: What are the signs of a prosperous person? His stores of food never run out.

column2: audhoseea ghare hee vuThee kuRie(n)ee ra(n)nee dha(n)mee ||
column3: Prosperity dwells in his home, with the sounds of girls and women.

column2: satee ra(n)nee ghare siaapaa rovan kooRee ka(n)mee ||
column3: All the women of his home shout and cry over useless things.

column2: jo levai so dhevai naahee khaTe dha(n)m saha(n)mee ||29||
column3: Whatever he takes, he does not give back. Seeking to earn more and more, he is troubled and uneasy. ||29||

column2: pabar too(n) hareeaavalaa kavalaa ka(n)chan va(n)n ||
column3: O lotus, your leaves were green, and your blossoms were gold.

column2: kai dhokhaRai saRioh kaalee hoieeaa dhehuree naanak mai tan bha(n)g ||
column3: What pain has burnt you, and made your body black? O Nanak, my body is battered.

column2: jaanaa paanee naa lahaa(n) jai setee meraa sa(n)g ||
column3: I have not received that water which I love.

column2: jit ddiThai tan parafuRai chaRai chavagan va(n)n ||30||
column3: Seeing it, my body blossomed forth, and I was blessed with a deep and beautiful color. ||30||

column2: raj na koiee jeeviaa pahuch na chaliaa koi ||
column3: No one lives long enough to accomplish all his wishes.

column2: giaanee jeevai sadhaa sadhaa suratee hee pat hoi ||
column3: Only the spiritually wise live forever; they are honored for their intuitive awareness.

column2: sarafai sarafai sadhaa sadhaa evai giee vihai ||
column3: Bit by bit, life passes away, even though the mortal tries to hold it back.

column2: naanak kis no aakheeaai vin puchhiaa hee lai jai ||31||
column3: O Nanak, unto whom should we complain? Death takes one's life away without anyone's consent. ||31||

column2: dhos na dheahu rai no mat chalai jaa(n) buddaa hovai ||
column3: Do not blame the Sovereign Lord; when someone grows old, his intellect leaves him.

column2: galaa(n) kare ghanereeaa taa(n) a(n)n(h)e pavanaa khaatee Tovai ||32||
column3: The blind man talks and babbles, and then falls into the ditch. ||32||

column2: poore kaa keeaa sabh kichh pooraa ghaT vadh kichh naahee ||
column3: All that the Perfect Lord does is perfect; there is not too little, or too much.

column2: naanak gurmukh aaisaa jaanai poore maa(n)h samaa(n)hee ||33||
column3: O Nanak, knowing this as Gurmukh, the mortal merges into the Perfect Lord God. ||33||

column2: salok mahalaa teejaa
column3: Shalok, Third Mehla:

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: abhiaagat eh na aakhe'eeh jin kai man meh bharam ||
column3: Do not call the wandering beggars holy men, if their minds are filled with doubt.

column2: tin ke dhite naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||1||
column3: Whoever gives to them, O Nanak, earns the same sort of merit. ||1||

column2: abhai nira(n)jan param padh taa kaa bheekhak hoi ||
column3: One who begs for the supreme status of the Fearless and Immaculate Lord

column2: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||2||
column3: - how rare are those who have the opportunity, O Nanak, to give food to such a person. ||2||

column2: hovaa pa(n)ddit jotakee vedh paRaa mukh chaar ||
column3: If I were a religious scholar, an astrologer, or one who could recite the four Vedas,

column2: navaa kha(n)ddaa vich jaaneeaa apane chaj veechaar ||3||
column3: I could be famous throughout the nine regions of the earth, for my wisdom and thoughtful contemplation. ||3||

column2: brahaman kailee ghaat ka(n)n(j)kaa anachaaree kaa dhaan ||
column3: The four Hindu cardinal sins of murdering a Brahmin, a cow, a female infant, and acceptance of the offerings of an evil person,

column2: fiTak fiTakaa koR badheeaa sadhaa sadhaa abhimaan ||
column3: cursed by the world and diseased by leprosy; he is forever and ever filled with egotistical pride.

column2: paeh ete jaeh veesar naanakaa ik naam ||
column3: One who forgets the Naam, O Nanak, is covered by these sins.

column2: sabh budhee jaale'eeh ik rahai tat giaan ||4||
column3: Let all wisdom be burnt away, except for the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

column2: maathai jo dhur likhiaa su meT na sakai koi ||
column3: No one can erase that primal destiny written upon one's forehead.

column2: naanak jo likhiaa so varatadhaa so boojhai jis no nadhar hoi ||5||
column3: O Nanak, whatever is written there, comes to pass. He alone understands, who is blessed by God's Grace. ||5||

column2: jinee naam visaariaa kooRai laalach lag ||
column3: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and become attached to greed and fraud,

column2: dha(n)dhaa maiaa mohanee a(n)tar tisanaa ag ||
column3: are engrossed in the entanglements of Maya the enticer, with the fire of desire within them.

column2: jin(h)aa vel na too(n)baRee maiaa Thage Thag ||
column3: Those who, like the pumpkin vine, are too stubborn climb the trellis, are cheated by Maya the cheater.

column2: manmukh ba(n)ni(h) chalaie'eeh naa milahee vag sag ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged and led away; the dogs do not join the herd of cows.

column2: aap bhulaae bhuleeaai aape mel milai ||
column3: The Lord Himself misleads the misguided ones, and He Himself unites them in His Union.

column2: naanak gurmukh chhuTeeaai je chalai satigur bhai ||6||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||6||

column2: saalaahee saalaahanaa bhee sachaa saalaeh ||
column3: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, and sing the Praises of the True Lord.

column2: naanak sachaa ek dhar beebhaa parahar aaeh ||7||
column3: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is True; stay away from all other doors. ||7||

column2: naanak jeh jeh mai firau teh teh saachaa soi ||
column3: O Nanak, wherever I go, I find the True Lord.

column2: jeh dhekhaa teh ek hai gurmukh paragaT hoi ||8||
column3: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||8||

column2: dhookh visaaran sabadh hai je ma(n)n vasaae koi ||
column3: The Word of the Shabad is the Dispeller of sorrow, if one enshrines it in the mind.

column2: gur kirapaa te man vasai karam paraapat hoi ||9||
column3: By Guru's Grace, it dwells in the mind; by God's Mercy, it is obtained. ||9||

column2: naanak hau hau karate khap mue khoohan lakh asa(n)kh ||
column3: O Nanak, acting in egotism, countless thousands have wasted away to death.

column2: satigur mile su ubare saachai sabadh ala(n)kh ||10||
column3: Those who meet with the True Guru are saved, through the Shabad, the True Word of the Inscrutable Lord. ||10||

column2: jinaa satigur ik man seviaa tin jan laagau pai ||
column3: Those who serve the True Guru single-mindedly - I fall at the feet of those humble beings.

column2: gur sabadhee har man vasai maiaa kee bhukh jai ||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord abides in the mind, and the hunger for Maya departs.

column2: se jan niramal uoojale j gurmukh naam samai ||
column3: Immaculate and pure are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam.

column2: naanak hor patisaaheeaa kooReeaa naam rate paatisaeh ||11||
column3: O Nanak, other empires are false; they alone are true emperors, who are imbued with the Naam. ||11||

column2: jiau purakhai ghar bhagatee naar hai at lochai bhagatee bhai ||
column3: The devoted wife in her husband's home has a great longing to perform loving devotional service to him;

column2: bahu ras saalane savaaradhee khaT ras meeThe pai ||
column3: she prepares and offers to him all sorts of sweet delicacies and dishes of all flavors.

column2: tiau baanee bhagat salaahadhe har naamai chit lai ||
column3: In the same way, the devotees praise the Word of the Guru's Bani, and focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name.

column2: man tan dhan aagai raakhiaa sir vechiaa gur aagai jai ||
column3: They place mind, body and wealth in offering before the Guru, and sell their heads to Him.

column2: bhai bhagatee bhagat bahu lochadhe prabh lochaa poor milai ||
column3: In the Fear of God, His devotees yearn for His devotional worship; God fulfills their desires, and merges them with Himself.

column2: har prabh veparavaahu hai kit khaadhai tipatai ||
column3: My Lord God is Self-existent and Independent. What does He need to eat to be satisfied?

column2: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tipataasai har gun gai ||
column3: Whoever walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, is pleasing to Him.

column2: dhan dhan kalajug naanakaa j chale satigur bhai ||12||
column3: Blessed, blessed are they, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||12||

column2: satiguroo na sevio sabadh na rakhio ur dhaar ||
column3: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and do not keep the Shabad enshrined in their hearts

column2: dhig tinaa kaa jeeviaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
column3: cursed are their lives. Why did they even come into the world?

column2: gurmatee bhau man pavai taa(n) har ras lagai piaar ||
column3: If one follows the Guru's Teachings, and keeps the Fear of God in his mind, then he is lovingly attuned to the sublime essence of the Lord.

column2: naau milai dhur likhiaa jan naanak paar utaar ||13||
column3: By his primal destiny, he obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is carried across. ||13||

column2: maiaa moh jag bharamiaa ghar musai khabar na hoi ||
column3: The world wanders lost in emotional attachment to Maya; it does not realize that its own home is being plundered.

column2: kaam karodh man hir liaa manmukh a(n)dhaa loi ||
column3: The self-willed manmukh is blind in the world; his mind is lured away by sexual desire and anger.

column2: giaan khaRag pa(n)ch dhoot sa(n)ghaare gurmat jaagai soi ||
column3: With the sword of spiritual wisdom, kill the five demons. Remain awake and aware to the Guru's Teachings.

column2: naam ratan paragaasiaa man tan niramal hoi ||
column3: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed, and the mind and body are purified.

column2: naamaheen nakaTe fireh bin naavai beh roi ||
column3: Those who lack the Naam wander around lost, with their noses cut off; without the Name, they sit and cry.

column2: naanak jo dhur karatai likhiaa su meT na sakai koi ||14||
column3: O Nanak, no one can erase that which is pre-ordained by the Creator Lord. ||14||

column2: gurmukhaa har dhan khaTiaa gur kai sabadh veechaar ||
column3: The Gurmukhs earn the wealth of the Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

column2: naam padhaarath paiaa atuT bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
column3: They receive the wealth of the Naam; their treasures are overflowing.

column2: har gun baanee uchareh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord, whose end and limitations cannot be found.

column2: naanak sabh kaaran karataa karai vekhai sirajanahaar ||15||
column3: O Nanak, the Creator is the Doer of all; the Creator Lord beholds all. ||15||

column2: gurmukh a(n)tar sahaj hai man chaRiaa dhasavai aakaas ||
column3: Within the Gurmukh is intuitive peace and poise; his mind ascends to the Tenth Plane of the Akaashic Ethers.

column2: tithai uoo(n)gh na bhukh hai har a(n)mirat naam sukh vaas ||
column3: No one is sleepy or hungry there; they dwell in the peace of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

column2: naanak dhukh sukh viaapat nahee jithai aatam raam pragaas ||16||
column3: O Nanak, pain and pleasure do not afflict anyone, where the Light of the Lord, the Supreme Soul, illuminates. ||16||

column2: kaam karodh kaa cholaRaa sabh gal aae pai ||
column3: All have come, wearing the robes of sexual desire and anger.

column2: eik upajeh ik binas jaa(n)h hukame aavai jai ||
column3: Some are born, and some pass away. They come and go according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

column2: ja(n)man maran na chukiee ra(n)g lagaa dhoojai bhai ||
column3: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; they are imbued with the love of duality.

column2: ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaieean karanaa kachhoo na jai ||17||
column3: Bound in bondage, they are made to wander, and they cannot do anything about it. ||17||

column2: jin kau kirapaa dhaareean tinaa satigur miliaa aai ||
column3: Those, upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, come and meet the True Guru.

column2: satigur mile ulaTee bhiee mar jeeviaa sahaj subhai ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, they turn away from the world; they remain dead while still alive, with intuitive peace and poise.

column2: naanak bhagatee ratiaa har har naam samai ||18||
column3: O Nanak, the devotees are imbued with the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||18||

column2: manmukh cha(n)chal mat hai a(n)tar bahut chaturaiee ||
column3: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is fickle; he is very tricky and clever within.

column2: keetaa karatiaa birathaa giaa ik til thai na paiee ||
column3: Whatever he has done, and all that he does, is useless. Not even an iota of it is acceptable.

column2: pu(n)n dhaan jo beejadhe sabh dharam rai kai jaiee ||
column3: The charity and generosity he pretends to give will be judged by the Righteous Judge of Dharma.

column2: bin satiguroo jamakaal na chhoddiee dhoojai bhai khuaaiee ||
column3: Without the True Guru, the Messenger of Death does not leave the mortal alone; he is ruined by the love of duality.

column2: joban jaa(n)dhaa nadhar na aaviee jar pahuchai mar jaiee ||
column3: Youth slips away imperceptibly, old age comes, and then he dies.

column2: put kalat moh het hai a(n)t belee ko na sakhaiee ||
column3: The mortal is caught in love and emotional attachment to children and spouse, but none of them will be his helper and support in the end.

column2: satigur seve so sukh paae naau vasai man aaiee ||
column3: Whoever serves the True Guru finds peace; the Name comes to abide in the mind.

column2: naanak se vadde vaddabhaagee j gurmukh naam samaiee ||19||
column3: O Nanak, great and very fortunate are those who, as Gurmukh, are absorbed in the Naam. ||19||

column2: manmukh naam na chetanee bin naavai dhukh roi ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Name; without the Name, they cry in pain.

column2: aatamaa raam na poojanee dhoojai kiau sukh hoi ||
column3: They do not worship the Lord, the Supreme Soul; how can they find peace in duality?

column2: haumai a(n)tar mail hai sabadh na kaaddeh dhoi ||
column3: They are filled with the filth of egotism; they do not wash it away with the Word of the Shabad.

column2: naanak bin naavai mailiaa mue janam padhaarath khoi ||20||
column3: O Nanak, without the Name, they die in their filth; they waste the priceless opportunity of this human life. ||20||

column2: manmukh bole a(n)dhule tis meh aganee kaa vaas ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are deaf and blind; they are filled with the fire of desire.

column2: baanee surat na bujhanee sabadh na kareh pragaas ||
column3: They have no intuitive understanding of the Guru's Bani; they are not illumined with the Shabad.

column2: onaa aapanee a(n)dhar sudh nahee gur bachan na kareh visaas ||
column3: They do not know their own inner being, and they have no faith in the Guru's Word.

column2: giaaneeaa a(n)dhar gur sabadh hai nit har liv sadhaa vigaas ||
column3: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is within the being of the spiritually wise ones. They always blossom in His love.

column2: har giaaneeaa kee rakhadhaa hau sadh balihaaree taas ||
column3: The Lord saves the honor of the spiritually wise ones.I am forever a sacrifice to them.

column2: gurmukh jo har sevadhe jan naanak taa kaa dhaas ||21||
column3: Servant Nanak is the slave of those Gurmukhs who serve the Lord. ||21||

column2: maiaa bhuia(n)gam sarap hai jag gheriaa bikh mai ||
column3: The poisonous snake, the serpent of Maya, has surrounded the world with its coils, O mother!

column2: bikh kaa maaran har naam hai gur garuR sabadh mukh pai ||
column3: The antidote to this poisonous venom is the Name of the Lord; the Guru places the magic spell of the Shabad into the mouth.

column2: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur miliaa aai ||
column3: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny come and meet the True Guru.

column2: mil satigur niramal hoiaa bikh haumai giaa bilai ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, they become immaculate, and the poison of egotism is eradicated.

column2: gurmukhaa ke mukh ujale har dharageh sobhaa pai ||
column3: Radiant and bright are the faces of the Gurmukhs; they are honored in the Court of the Lord.

column2: jan naanak sadhaa kurabaan tin jo chaaleh satigur bhai ||22||
column3: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||22||

column2: satigur purakh niravair hai nit hiradhai har liv lai ||
column3: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantly attuned to the Lord.

column2: niravairai naal vair rachaidhaa apanai ghar lookee lai ||
column3: Whoever directs hatred against the Guru, who has no hatred at all, only sets his own home on fire.

column2: a(n)tar karodh aha(n)kaar hai anadhin jalai sadhaa dhukh pai ||
column3: Anger and egotism are within him night and day; he burns, and suffers constant pain.

column2: kooR bol bol nit bhaukadhe bikh khaadhe dhoojai bhai ||
column3: They babble and tell lies, and keep on barking, eating the poison of the love of duality.

column2: bikh maiaa kaaran bharamadhe fir ghar ghar pat gavai ||
column3: For the sake of the poison of Maya, they wander from house to house, and lose their honor.

column2: besuaa kere poot jiau pitaa naam tis jai ||
column3: They are like the son of a prostitute, who does not know the name of his father.

column2: har har naam na chetanee karatai aap khuaai ||
column3: They do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Creator Himself brings them to ruin.

column2: har gurmukh kirapaa dhaareean jan vichhuRe aap milai ||
column3: The Lord showers His Mercy upon the Gurmukhs, and reunites the separated ones with Himself.

column2: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo satigur laage pai ||23||
column3: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||23||

column2: naam lage se uoobare bin naavai jam pur jaa(n)h ||
column3: Those who are attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are saved; without the Name, they must go to the City of Death.

column2: naanak bin naavai sukh nahee aai ge pachhutaeh ||24||
column3: O Nanak, without the Name, they find no peace; they come and go in reincarnation with regrets. ||24||

column2: chi(n)taa dhaavat reh ge taa(n) man bhiaa ana(n)dh ||
column3: When anxiety and wanderings come to an end, the mind becomes happy.

column2: gur prasaadhee bujheeaai saa dhan sutee nichi(n)dh ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, the soul-bride understands, and then she sleeps without worry.

column2: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin(h)aa bheTiaa gur govi(n)dh ||
column3: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

column2: naanak sahaje mil rahe har paiaa paramaana(n)dh ||25||
column3: O Nanak, they merge intuitively into the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||25||

column2: satigur sevan aapanaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||
column3: Those who serve their True Guru, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

column2: satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n lain har naam rakheh ur dhaar ||
column3: who honor and obey the Will of the True Guru, who keep the Lord's Name enshrined within their hearts,

column2: aaithai othai ma(n)neean har naam lage vaapaar ||
column3: are honored, here and hereafter; they are dedicated to the business of the Lord's Name.

column2: gurmukh sabadh sin(j)aapadhe tit saachai dharabaar ||
column3: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs gain recognition in that Court of the True Lord.

column2: sachaa saudhaa kharach sach a(n)tar piram piaar ||
column3: The True Name is their merchandise, the True Name is their expenditure; the Love of their Beloved fills their inner beings.

column2: jamakaal neR na aaviee aap bakhase karataar ||
column3: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Creator Lord Himself forgives them.

column2: naanak naam rate se dhanava(n)t hain niradhan hor sa(n)saar ||26||
column3: O Nanak, they alone are wealthy, who are imbued with the Naam; the rest of the world is poor. ||26||

column2: jan kee Tek har naam har bin naavai Thavar na Thaau ||
column3: The Lord's Name is the Support of the Lord's humble servants. Without the Lord's Name, the there is no other place, no place of rest.

column2: gurmatee naau man vasai sahaje sahaj samaau ||
column3: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Name abides in the mind, and one is intuitively, automatically absorbed in the Lord.

column2: vaddabhaagee naam dhiaaiaa ahinis laagaa bhaau ||
column3: Those with great good fortune meditate on the Naam; night and day, they embrace love for the Name.

column2: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin hau sadh kurabaanai jaau ||27||
column3: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of their feet; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||27||

column2: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee tisanaa jalatee kare pukaar ||
column3: The 8.4 million species of beings burn in desire and cry in pain.

column2: eih moh maiaa sabh pasariaa naal chalai na a(n)tee vaar ||
column3: All this show of emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you at that very last instant.

column2: bin har saa(n)t na aaviee kis aagai karee pukaar ||
column3: Without the Lord, peace and tranquility do not come; unto whom should we go and complain?

column2: vaddabhaagee satigur paiaa boojhiaa braham bichaar ||
column3: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and comes to understand the contemplation of God.

column2: tisanaa agan sabh bujh giee jan naanak har ur dhaar ||28||
column3: The fire of desire is totally extinguished, O servant Nanak, enshrining the Lord within the heart. ||28||

column2: asee khate bahut kamaavadhe a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
column3: I make so many mistakes, there is no end or limit to them.

column2: har kirapaa kar kai bakhas laih hau paapee vadd gunahagaar ||
column3: O Lord, please be merciful and forgive me; I am a sinner, a great offender.

column2: har jeeau lekhai vaar na aaviee too(n) bakhas milaavanahaar ||

column2: gur tuThai har prabh meliaa sabh kilavikh kaT vikaar ||
column3: The Guru, in His Pleasure, has united me with the Lord God; He has cut away all my sinful mistakes.

column2: jinaa har har naam dhiaaiaa jan naanak tin(h) jaikaar ||29||
column3: Servant Nanak celebrates the victory of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||29||

column2: vichhuR vichhuR jo mile satigur ke bhai bhai ||
column3: Those who have been separated and alienated from the Lord are united with Him again, through the Fear and the Love of the True Guru.

column2: janam maran nihachal bhe gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
column3: They escape the cycle of birth and death, and, as Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: gur saadhoo sa(n)gat milai heere ratan labha(n)ni(h) ||
column3: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, the diamonds and jewels are obtained.

column2: naanak laal amolakaa gurmukh khoj laha(n)ni(h) ||30||
column3: O Nanak, the jewel is priceless; the Gurmukhs seek and find it. ||30||

column2: manmukh naam na chetio dhig jeevan dhig vaas ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Naam. Cursed are their lives, and cursed are their homes.

column2: jis dhaa dhitaa khaanaa painanaa so man na vasio gunataas ||
column3: That Lord who gives them so much to eat and wear - they do not enshrine that Lord, the Treasure of Virtue, in their minds.

column2: eih man sabadh na bhedhio kiau hovai ghar vaas ||
column3: This mind is not pierced by the Word of the Shabad; how can it come to dwell in its true home?

column2: manmukheeaa dhohaaganee aavan jaan muieeaas ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are like discarded brides, ruined by coming and going in the cycle of reincarnation.

column2: gurmukh naam suhaag hai masatak manee likhiaas ||
column3: The Gurmukhs are embellished and exalted by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the jewel of destiny is engraved upon their foreheads.

column2: har har naam ur dhaariaa har hiradhai kamal pragaas ||
column3: They enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts; the Lord illumines their heart-lotus.

column2: satigur sevan aapanaa hau sadh balihaaree taas ||
column3: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

column2: naanak tin mukh ujale jin a(n)tar naam pragaas ||31||
column3: O Nanak, radiant and bright are the faces of those whose inner beings are illuminated with the Light of the Naam. ||31||

column2: sabadh marai soiee jan sijhai bin sabadhai mukat na hoiee ||

column2: bhekh kareh bahu karam vigute bhai dhoojai paraj vigoiee ||
column3: They wear religious robes and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are ruined; in the love of duality, their world is ruined.

column2: naanak bin satigur naau na paieeaai je sau lochai koiee ||32||
column3: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, even though one may long for it hundreds of times. ||32||

column2: har kaa naau at vadd uoochaa uoochee hoo uoochaa hoiee ||
column3: The Name of the Lord is utterly great, lofty and high, the highest of the high.

column2: apaR koi na sakiee je sau lochai koiee ||
column3: No one can climb up to it, even though one may long for it, hundreds of times.

column2: mukh sa(n)jam hachhaa na hoviee kar bhekh bhavai sabh koiee ||
column3: Speaking about self-discipline, no one become pure; everyone walks around wearing religious robes.

column2: gur kee pauRee jai chaRai karam paraapat hoiee ||
column3: Those blessed by the karma of good deeds go and climb the ladder of the Guru.

column2: a(n)tar aai vasai gur sabadh veechaarai koi ||
column3: The Lord comes and dwells within that one who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

column2: naanak sabadh marai man maaneeaai saache saachee soi ||33||
column3: O Nanak, when someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased. True is the reputation of those who are true. ||33||

column2: maiaa moh dhukh saagar hai bikh dhutar tariaa na jai ||
column3: Emotional attachment to Maya is a treacherous ocean of pain and poison, which cannot be crossed.

column2: meraa meraa karadhe pach mue haumai karat vihai ||
column3: Screaming, ""Mine, mine!"", they rot and die; they pass their lives in egotism.

column2: manmukhaa uravaar na paar hai adh vich rahe lapaTai ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are in limbo, neither on this side, nor the other; they are stuck in the middle.

column2: jo dhur likhiaa su kamaavanaa karanaa kachhoo na jai ||
column3: They act as they are pre-destined; they cannot do anything else.

column2: gurmatee giaan ratan man vasai sabh dhekhiaa braham subhai ||
column3: Following the Guru's Teachings, the jewel of spiritual wisdom abides in the mind, and then God is easily seen in all.

column2: naanak satigur bohithai vaddabhaagee chaRai te bhaujal paar la(n)ghai ||34||
column3: O Nanak, the very fortunate ones embark on the Boat of the True Guru; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||34||

column2: bin satigur dhaataa ko nahee jo har naam dhei aadhaar ||
column3: Without the True Guru, there is no giver who can bestow the Support of the Lord's Name.

column2: gur kirapaa te naau man vasai sadhaa rahai ur dhaar ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, the Name comes to dwell in the mind; keep it enshrined in your heart.

column2: tisanaa bujhai tipat hoi har kai nai piaar ||
column3: The fire of desire is extinguished, and one finds satisfaction, through the Love of the Name of the Lord.

column2: naanak gurmukh paieeaai har apanee kirapaa dhaar ||35||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, when He showers His Mercy. ||35||

column2: bin sabadhai jagat baraliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
column3: Without the Shabad, the world is so insane, that it cannot even be described.

column2: har rakhe se ubare sabadh rahe liv lai ||
column3: Those who are protected by the Lord are saved; they remain lovingly attuned to the Word of the Shabad.

column2: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadhaa jin rakhee banat banai ||36||
column3: O Nanak, the Creator who made this making knows everything. ||36||

column2: hom jag sabh teerathaa paRi(h) pa(n)ddit thake puraan ||
column3: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have grown weary of making fire-offerings and sacrifices, making pilgrimages to all the sacred shrines, and reading the Puraanas.

column2: bikh maiaa moh na miTiee vich haumai aavan jaan ||
column3: But they cannot get rid of the poison of emotional attachment to Maya; they continue to come and go in egotism.

column2: satigur miliaai mal utaree har japiaa purakh sujaan ||
column3: Meeting with the True Guru, one's filth is washed off, meditating on the Lord, the Primal Being, the All-knowing One.

column2: jinaa har har prabh seviaa jan naanak sadh kurabaan ||37||
column3: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who serve their Lord God. ||37||

column2: maiaa moh bahu chitavadhe bahu aasaa lobh vikaar ||
column3: Mortals give great thought to Maya and emotional attachment; they harbor great hopes, in greed and corruption.

column2: manmukh asathir naa theeaai mar binas jai khin vaar ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs do not become steady and stable; they die and are gone in an instant.

column2: vadd bhaag hovai satigur milai haumai tajai vikaar ||
column3: Only those who are blessed with great good fortune meet the True Guru, and leave behind their egotism and corruption.

column2: har naamaa jap sukh paiaa jan naanak sabadh veechaar ||38||
column3: Chanting the Name of the Lord, they find peace; servant Nanak contemplates the Word of the Shabad. ||38||

column2: bin satigur bhagat na hoviee naam na lagai piaar ||
column3: Without the True Guru, there is no devotional worship, and no love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

column2: jan naanak naam araadhiaa gur kai het piaar ||39||
column3: Servant Nanak worships and adores the Naam, with love and affection for the Guru. ||39||

column2: lobhee kaa vesaahu na keejai je kaa paar vasai ||
column3: Do not trust greedy people, if you can avoid doing so.

column2: a(n)t kaal tithai dhuhai jithai hath na pai ||
column3: At the very last moment, they will deceive you there, where no one will be able to lend a helping hand.

column2: manmukh setee sa(n)g kare muh kaalakh dhaag lagai ||
column3: Whoever associates with the self-willed manmukhs, will have his face blackened and dirtied.

column2: muh kaale tin(h) lobheeaa(n) jaasan janam gavai ||
column3: Black are the faces of those greedy people; they lose their lives, and leave in disgrace.

column2: satasa(n)gat har mel prabh har naam vasai man aai ||
column3: O Lord, let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; may the Name of the Lord God abide in my mind.

column2: janam maran kee mal utarai jan naanak har gun gai ||40||
column3: The filth and pollution of birth and death is washed away, O servant Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||40||

column2: dhur har prabh karatai likhiaa su meTanaa na jai ||
column3: Whatever is pre-destined by the Lord God Creator, cannot be erased.

column2: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa pratipaal kare har rai ||
column3: Body and soul are all His. The Sovereign Lord King cherishes all.

column2: chugal ni(n)dhak bhukhe rul mue enaa hath na kithaauoo pai ||

column2: baahar paakha(n)dd sabh karam kareh man hiradhai kapaT kamai ||
column3: Outwardly, they do all the proper deeds, but they are hypocrites; in their minds and hearts, they practice deception and fraud.

column2: khet sareer jo beejeeaai so a(n)t khaloaa aai ||
column3: Whatever is planted in the farm of the body, shall come and stand before them in the end.

column2: naanak kee prabh benatee har bhaavai bakhas milai ||41||
column3: Nanak offers this prayer: O Lord God, please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself. ||41||

column2: man aavan jaan na sujhiee naa sujhai dharabaar ||
column3: The mortal being does not understand the comings and goings of reincarnation; he does not see the Court of the Lord.

column2: maiaa moh paleTiaa a(n)tar agiaan gubaar ||
column3: He is wrapped up in emotional attachment and Maya, and within his being is the darkness of ignorance.

column2: tab nar sutaa jaagiaa sir dda(n)dd lagaa bahu bhaar ||
column3: The sleeping person wakes, only when he is hit on the head by a heavy club.

column2: gurmukhaa(n) karaa(n) upar har chetiaa se pain mokh dhuaar ||
column3: The Gurmukhs dwell upon the Lord; they find the door of salvation.

column2: naanak aap oh udhare sabh kuTa(n)b tare paravaar ||42||
column3: O Nanak, they themselves are saved, and all their relatives are carried across as well. ||42||

column2: sabadh marai so muaa jaapai ||
column3: Whoever dies in the Word of the Shabad, is known to be truly dead.

column2: gur parasaadhee har ras dhraapai ||
column3: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord.

column2: har dharageh gur sabadh sin(j)aapai ||
column3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is recognized in the Court of the Lord.

column2: bin sabadhai muaa hai sabh koi ||

column2: manmukh muaa apunaa janam khoi ||
column3: The self-willed manmukh dies; his life is wasted.

column2: har naam na cheteh a(n)t dhukh roi ||

column2: naanak karataa kare su hoi ||43||
column3: O Nanak, whatever the Creator Lord does, comes to pass. ||43||

column2: gurmukh budde kadhe naahee jin(h)aa a(n)tar surat giaan ||
column3: The Gurmukhs never grow old; within them is intuitive understanding and spiritual wisdom.

column2: sadhaa sadhaa har gun raveh a(n)tar sahaj dhiaan ||
column3: They chant the Praises of the Lord, forever and ever; deep within, they intuitively meditate on the Lord.

column2: oi sadhaa ana(n)dh bibek raheh dhukh sukh ek samaan ||
column3: They dwell forever in blissful knowledge of the Lord; they look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same.

column2: tinaa nadharee iko aaiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaan ||44||
column3: They see the One Lord in all, and realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul of all. ||44||

column2: manmukh baalak biradh samaan hai jin(h)aa a(n)tar har surat naahee ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs are like stupid children; they do not keep the Lord in their thoughts.

column2: vich haumai karam kamaavadhe sabh dharam rai kai jaa(n)hee ||
column3: They do all their deeds in egotism, and they must answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma.

column2: gurmukh hachhe niramale gur kai sabadh subhai ||
column3: The Gurmukhs are good and immaculately pure; they are embellished and exalted with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

column2: onaa mail pata(n)g na lagiee j chalan satigur bhai ||
column3: Not even a tiny bit of filth sticks to them; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

column2: manmukh jooTh na utarai je sau dhovan pai ||
column3: The filth of the manmukhs is not washed away, even if they wash hundreds of times.

column2: naanak gurmukh melian gur kai a(n)k samai ||45||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord; they merge into the Guru's Being. ||45||

column2: aapanai roh aape hee dhajhai ||
column3: By his own anger, he only burns himself.

column2: manmukh kamalaa ragaRai lujhai ||
column3: The self-willed manmukh drives himself crazy with worries and stubborn struggles.

column2: gurmukh hoi tis sabh kichh sujhai ||
column3: But those who become Gurmukh understand everything.

column2: naanak gurmukh man siau lujhai ||46||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukh struggles with his own mind. ||46||

column2: jinaa satigur purakh na sevio sabadh na keeto veechaar ||
column3: Those who do not serve the True Guru, the Primal Being, and do not reflect upon the Word of the Shabad

column2: oi maanas joon na aakheean pasoo ddor gaavaar ||
column3: - do not call them human beings; they are just animals and stupid beasts.

column2: onaa a(n)tar giaan na dhiaan hai har sau preet na piaar ||
column3: They have no spiritual wisdom or meditation within their beings; they are not in love with the Lord.

column2: manmukh mue vikaar meh mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs die in evil and corruption; they die and are reborn, again and again.

column2: jeevadhiaa no milai su jeevadhe har jagajeevan ur dhaar ||
column3: They alone live, who join with the living; enshrine the Lord, the Lord of Life, within your heart.

column2: naanak gurmukh sohane tit sachai dharabaar ||47||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs look beautiful in that Court of the True Lord. ||47||

column2: har ma(n)dhar har saajiaa har vasai jis naal ||
column3: The Lord built the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; the Lord dwells within it.

column2: gurmatee har paiaa maiaa moh parajaal ||
column3: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord; my emotional attachment to Maya has been burnt away.

column2: har ma(n)dhar vasat anek hai nav nidh naam samaal ||
column3: Countless things are in the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; contemplate the Naam, and the nine treasures will be yours.

column2: dhan bhagava(n)tee naanakaa jinaa gurmukh ladhaa har bhaal ||
column3: Blessed is that happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, seeks and finds the Lord.

column2: vaddabhaagee gaR ma(n)dhar khojiaa har hiradhai paiaa naal ||48||
column3: By great good fortune, one searches the temple of the body-fortress, and finds the Lord within the heart. ||48||

column2: manmukh dheh dhis fir rahe at tisanaa lobh vikaar ||
column3: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in the ten directions, led by intense desire, greed and corruption.

column2: maiaa moh na chukiee mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||
column3: Their attachment to Maya does not cease; they die, only to be reborn, over and over again.

column2: satigur sev sukh paiaa at tisanaa taj vikaar ||
column3: Serving the True Guru, peace is found; intense desire and corruption are discarded.

column2: janam maran kaa dhukh giaa jan naanak sabadh beechaar ||49||
column3: The pains of death and birth are taken away; servant Nanak reflects upon the Word of the Shabad. ||49||

column2: har har naam dhiaai man har dharageh paaveh maan ||
column3: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal being, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

column2: kilavikh paap sabh kaTe'eeh haumai chukai gumaan ||
column3: All your sins and terrible mistakes shall be taken away, and you shall be rid of your pride and egotism.

column2: gurmukh kamal vigasiaa sabh aatam braham pachhaan ||
column3: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, realizing God, the Soul of all.

column2: har har kirapaa dhaar prabh jan naanak jap har naam ||50||
column3: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant the Name of the Lord. ||50||

column2: dhanaasaree dhanava(n)tee jaaneeaai bhaiee jaa(n) satigur kee kaar kamai ||
column3: In Dhanaasaree, the soul-bride is known to be wealthy, O Siblings of Destiny, when she works for the True Guru.

column2: tan man saupe jeea sau bhaiee le hukam firaau ||
column3: She surrenders her body, mind and soul, O Siblings of Destiny, and lives according to the Hukam of His Command.

column2: jeh baisaaveh baiseh bhaiee jeh bhejeh teh jaau ||
column3: I sit where He wishes me to sit, O Siblings of Destiny; wherever He sends me, I go.

column2: evadd dhan hor ko nahee bhaiee jevadd sachaa naau ||
column3: There is no other wealth as great, O Siblings of Destiny; such is the greatness of the True Name.

column2: sadhaa sache ke gun gaavaa(n) bhaiee sadhaa sache kai sa(n)g rahaau ||
column3: I sing forever the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; I shall remain with the True One forever.

column2: painan gun cha(n)giaaieeaa bhaiee aapanee pat ke saadh aape khai ||
column3: So wear the clothes of His Glorious Virtues and goodness, O Siblings of Destiny; eat and enjoy the flavor of your own honor.

column2: tis kaa kiaa saalaaheeaai bhaiee dharasan kau bal jai ||
column3: How can I praise Him, O Siblings of Destiny? I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

column2: satigur vich vaddeeaa vaddiaaieeaa bhaiee karam milai taa(n) pai ||
column3: Great is the Glorious Greatness of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; if one is blessed with good karma, He is found.

column2: eik hukam ma(n)n na jaananee bhaiee dhoojai bhai firai ||
column3: Some do not know how to submit to the Hukam of His Command, O Siblings of Destiny; they wander around lost in the love of duality.

column2: sa(n)gat ddoiee naa milai bhaiee baisan milai na thaau ||
column3: They find no place of rest in the Sangat, O Siblings of Destiny; they find no place to sit.

column2: naanak hukam tinaa manaisee bhaiee jinaa dhure kamaiaa naau ||
column3: Nanak: they alone submit to His Command, O Siblings of Destiny, who are pre-destined to live the Name.

column2: tin(h) viTahu hau vaariaa bhaiee tin kau sadh balihaarai jaau ||51||
column3: I am a sacrifice to them, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||51||

column2: se dhaaReeaa(n) sacheeaa j gur charanee laga(n)ni(h) ||
column3: Those beards are true, which brush the feet of the True Guru.

column2: anadhin sevan gur aapanaa anadhin anadh raha(n)ni(h) ||
column3: Those who serve their Guru night and day, live in bliss, night and day.

column2: naanak se muh sohane sachai dhar dhisa(n)ni(h) ||52||
column3: O Nanak, their faces appear beautiful in the Court of the True Lord. ||52||

column2: mukh sache sach dhaaReeaa sach boleh sach kamaeh ||
column3: True are the faces and true are the beards, of those who speak the Truth and live the Truth.

column2: sachaa sabadh man vasiaa satigur maa(n)h samaa(n)h ||
column3: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their minds; they are absorbed in the True Guru.

column2: sachee raasee sach dhan utam padhavee paa(n)h ||
column3: True is their capital, and true is their wealth; they are blessed with the ultimate status.

column2: sach suneh sach ma(n)n lain sachee kaar kamaeh ||
column3: They hear the Truth, they believe in the Truth; they act and work in the Truth.

column2: sachee dharageh baisanaa sache maeh samaeh ||
column3: They are given a place in the Court of the True Lord; they are absorbed in the True Lord.

column2: naanak vin satigur sach na paieeaai manmukh bhoole jaa(n)h ||53||
column3: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the True Lord is not found. The self-willed manmukhs leave, wandering around lost. ||53||

column2: baabeehaa priau priau kare jalanidh prem piaar ||
column3: The rainbird cries, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"" She is in love with the treasure, the water.

column2: gur mile seetal jal paiaa sabh dhookh nivaaranahaar ||
column3: Meeting with the Guru, the cooling, soothing water is obtained, and all pain is taken away.

column2: tis chukai sahaj uoopajai chukai kook pukaar ||
column3: My thirst has been quenched, and intuitive peace and poise have welled up; my cries and screams of anguish are past.

column2: naanak gurmukh saa(n)t hoi naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||54||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are peaceful and tranquil; they enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their hearts. ||54||

column2: baabeehaa too(n) sach chau sache sau liv lai ||
column3: O rainbird, chirp the True Name, and let yourself be attuned to the True Lord.

column2: boliaa teraa thai pavai gurmukh hoi alai ||
column3: Your word shall be accepted and approved, if you speak as Gurmukh.

column2: sabadh cheen tikh utarai ma(n)n lai rajai ||
column3: Remember the Shabad, and your thirst shall be relieved; surrender to the Will of the Lord.

column2: chaare ku(n)ddaa jhok varasadhaa boo(n)dh pavai sahaj subhai ||
column3: The clouds are heavy, hanging low, and the rain is pouring down on all sides; the rain-drop is received, with natural ease.

column2: jal hee te sabh uoopajai bin jal piaas na jai ||
column3: From water, everything is produced; without water, thirst is not quenched.

column2: naanak har jal jin peeaa tis bhookh na laagai aai ||55||
column3: O Nanak, whoever drinks in the Water of the Lord, shall never feel hunger again. ||55||

column2: baabeehaa too(n) sahaj bol sachai sabadh subhai ||
column3: O rainbird, speak the Shabad, the True Word of God, with natural peace and poise.

column2: sabh kichh terai naal hai satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
column3: Everything is with you; the True Guru will show you this.

column2: aap pachhaaneh preetam milai vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
column3: So understand your own self, and meet your Beloved; His Grace shall rain down in torrents.

column2: jhim jhim a(n)mrit varasadhaa tisanaa bhukh sabh jai ||
column3: Drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down softly and gently; thirst and hunger are completely gone.

column2: kook pukaar na hoviee jotee jot milai ||
column3: Your cries and screams of anguish have ceased; your light shall merge into the Light.

column2: naanak sukh savani(h) sohaaganee sachai naam samai ||56||
column3: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they are absorbed in the True Name. ||56||

column2: dhurahu khasam bhejiaa sachai hukam paThai ||
column3: The Primal Lord and Master has sent out the True Hukam of His Command.

column2: ei(n)dh varasai dhiaa kar gooR(h)ee chhahabar lai ||

column2: baabeehe tan man sukh hoi jaa(n) tat boo(n)dh muh pai ||
column3: The body and mind of the rainbird are happy. only when the rain-drop falls into its mouth.

column2: an dhan bahutaa upajai dharatee sobhaa pai ||
column3: The corn grows high, wealth increases, and the earth is embellished with beauty.

column2: anadhin lok bhagat kare gur kai sabadh samai ||
column3: Night and day, people worship the Lord with devotion, and are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

column2: aape sachaa bakhas le kar kirapaa karai rajai ||
column3: The True Lord Himself forgives them, and showering them with His Mercy, He leads them to walk in His Will.

column2: har gun gaavahu kaamanee sachai sabadh samai ||
column3: O brides, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and be absorbed in the True Word of His Shabad.

column2: bhai kaa sahaj seegaar karih sach rahahu liv lai ||
column3: Let the Fear of God be your decoration, and remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

column2: naanak naamo man vasai har dharageh le chhaddai ||57||
column3: O Nanak, the Naam abides in the mind, and the mortal is saved in the Court of the Lord. ||57||

column2: baabeehaa sagalee dharatee je fireh uoodd chaReh aakaas ||
column3: The rainbird wanders all over the earth, soaring high through the skies.

column2: satigur miliaai jal paieeaai chookai bhookh piaas ||
column3: But it obtains the drop of water, only when it meets the True Guru, and then, its hunger and thirst are relieved.

column2: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sabh kichh tis kai paas ||
column3: Soul and body and all belong to Him; everything is His.

column2: vin boliaa sabh kichh jaanadhaa kis aagai keechai aradhaas ||
column3: He knows everything, without being told; unto whom should we offer our prayers?

column2: naanak ghaT ghaT eko varatadhaa sabadh kare paragaas ||58||
column3: O Nanak, the One Lord is prevading and permeating each and every heart; the Word of the Shabad brings illumination. ||58||

column3: O Nanak, the season of spring comes to one who serves the True Guru.

column2: har vuThaa man tan sabh parafaRai sabh jag hareeaaval hoi ||59||
column3: The Lord rains His Mercy down upon him, and his mind and body totally blossom forth; the entire world becomes green and rejuvenated. ||59||

column3: The Word of the Shabad brings eternal spring; it rejuvenates the mind and body.

column3: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, which has created everyone. ||60||

column2: naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jinaa gurmukh vasiaa man soi ||
column3: O Nanak, it is the spring season, for those Gurmukhs, within whose minds the Lord abides.

column2: har vuThai man tan parafaRai sabh jag hariaa hoi ||61||
column3: When the Lord showers His Mercy, the mind and body blossom forth, and all the world turns green and lush. ||61||

column2: vaddaRai jhaal jhalu(n)bhalai naavaRaa lieeaai kis ||
column3: In the early hours of the morning, whose name should we chant?

column2: naau lieeaai paramesarai bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||62||
column3: Chant the Name of the Transcendent Lord, who is All-powerful to create and destroy. ||62||

column2: harahaT bhee too(n) too(n) kareh boleh bhalee baan ||
column3: The Persian wheel also cries out, ""Too! Too! You! You!"", with sweet and sublime sounds.

column2: saahib sadhaa hadhoor hai kiaa uchee kareh pukaar ||
column3: Our Lord and Master is always present; why do you cry out to Him in such a loud voice?

column2: jin jagat upai har ra(n)g keeaa tisai viTahu kurabaan ||
column3: I am a sacrifice to that Lord who created the world, and who loves it.

column2: aap chhoddeh taa(n) sahu milai sachaa eh veechaar ||
column3: Give up your selfishness, and then you shall meet your Husband Lord. Consider this Truth.

column2: haumai fikaa bolanaa bujh na sakaa kaar ||
column3: Speaking in shallow egotism, no one understands the Ways of God.

column2: van tiran tirabhavan tujhai dhiaaidhaa anadhin sadhaa vihaan ||
column3: The forests and fields, and all the three worlds meditate on You, O Lord; this is the way they pass their days and nights forever.

column2: bin satigur kinai na paiaa kar kar thake veechaar ||
column3: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord. People have grown weary of thinking about it.

column2: nadhar kareh je aapanee taa(n) aape laih savaar ||
column3: But if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then He Himself embellishes us.

column2: naanak gurmukh jin(h)ee dhiaaiaa aae se paravaan ||63||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord; blessed and approved is their coming into the world. ||63||

column2: jog na bhagavee kapaRee jog na maile ves ||
column3: Yoga is not obtained by wearing saffron robes; Yoga is not obtained by wearing dirty robes.

column2: naanak ghar baiThiaa jog paieeaai satigur kai upadhes ||64||
column3: O Nanak, Yoga is obtained even while sitting in your own home, by following the Teachings of the True Guru. ||64||

column2: chaare ku(n)ddaa je bhaveh bedh paReh jug chaar ||
column3: You may wander in all four directions, and read the Vedas throughout the four ages.

column2: naanak saachaa bheTai har man vasai paaveh mokh dhuaar ||65||
column3: O Nanak, if you meet with the True Guru, the Lord shall come to dwell within your mind, and you shall find the door of salvation. ||65||

column2: naanak hukam varatai khasam kaa mat bhavee fireh chal chit ||
column3: O Nanak, the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master, is prevailing. The intellectually confused person wanders around lost, misled by his fickle consciousness.

column2: manmukh sau kar dhosatee sukh k puchheh mit ||
column3: If you make friends with the self-willed manmukhs, O friend, who can you ask for peace?

column2: gurmukh sau kar dhosatee satigur sau lai chit ||
column3: Make friends with the Gurmukhs, and focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

column2: ja(n)man maran kaa mool kaTeeaai taa(n) sukh hovee mit ||66||
column3: The root of birth and death will be cut away, and then, you shall find peace, O friend. ||66||

column2: bhuliaa(n) aap samajhaisee jaa kau nadhar kare ||
column3: The Lord Himself instructs those who are misguided, when He casts His Glance of Grace.

column2: naanak nadharee baaharee karan palaeh kare ||67||
column3: O Nanak, those who are not blessed by His Glance of Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||67||

column2: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

column2: vaddabhaageeaa sohaaganee jin(h)aa gurmukh miliaa har rai ||

column2: a(n)tar jot paragaaseeaa naanak naam samai ||1||

column2: jit miliaai tikh utarai tan man seetal hoi ||

column3: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the True Primal Being, who looks upon all alike.

column2: vaahu vaahu satigur niravair hai jis ni(n)dhaa usatat tul hoi ||
column3: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who has no hatred; slander and praise are all the same to Him.

column2: vaahu vaahu satigur sujaan hai jis a(n)tar braham veechaar ||
column3: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the All-knowing True Guru, who has realized God within.

column2: vaahu vaahu satigur nira(n)kaar hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
column3: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the Formless True Guru, who has no end or limitation.

column2: vaahu vaahu satiguroo hai j sach dhiraRaae soi ||
column3: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who implants the Truth within.

column2: naanak satigur vaahu vaahu jis te naam paraapat hoi ||2||
column3: O Nanak, Blessed and Great is the True Guru, through whom the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received. ||2||

column2: har prabh sachaa sohilaa gurmukh naam govi(n)dh ||

column2: anadhin naam salaahanaa har japiaa man aana(n)dh ||

column2: vaddabhaagee har paiaa pooran paramaana(n)dh ||
column3: By great good fortune, they find the Lord, the Embodiment of perfect, supreme bliss.

column2: jan naanak naam salaahiaa bahuR na man tan bha(n)g ||3||
column3: Servant Nanak praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no obstacle will block his mind or body. ||3||

column2: moo(n) pireeaa sau neh kiau sajan mileh piaariaa ||

column2: hau ddooddedhee tin sajan sach savaariaa ||
column3: I seek that friend, who is embellished with Truth.

column2: satigur maiddaa mit hai je milai ta ih man vaariaa ||
column3: The True Guru is my Friend; if I meet Him, I will offer this mind as a sacrifice to Him.

column2: dhe(n)dhaa moo(n) pir dhas har sajan sirajanahaariaa ||
column3: He has shown me my Beloved Lord, my Friend, the Creator.

column2: naanak hau pir bhaalee aapanaa satigur naal dhikhaaliaa ||4||
column3: O Nanak, I was searching for my Beloved; the True Guru has shown me that He has been with me all the time. ||4||

column2: hau khaRee nihaalee pa(n)dh mat moo(n) sajan aave ||
column3: I stand by the side of the road, waiting for You; O my Friend, I hope that You will come.

column2: ko aan milaavai aj mai pir mel milaave ||
column3: If only someone would come today and unite me in Union with my Beloved.

column2: hau jeeau karee tis viTau chau kha(n)neeaai jo mai piree dhikhaave ||

column2: naanak har hoi dhiaal taa(n) gur pooraa melaave ||5||

column2: a(n)tar jor haumai tan maiaa kooRee aavai jai ||

column2: satigur kaa furamaiaa ma(n)n na sakee dhutar tariaa na jai ||
column3: If someone does not obey the Command of the True Guru, he cannot cross over the treacherous world-ocean.

column2: nadhar kare jis aapanee so chalai satigur bhai ||
column3: Whoever is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

column2: satigur kaa dharasan safal hai jo ichhai so fal pai ||
column3: The Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan is fruitful; through it, one obtains the fruits of his desires.

column2: jinee satigur ma(n)niaa(n) hau tin ke laagau pai ||

column2: naanak taa kaa dhaas hai j anadhin rahai liv lai ||6||

column2: jinaa piree piaar bin dharasan kiau tirapateeaai ||

column2: naanak mile subhai gurmukh ih man rahaseeaai ||7||
column3: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meet Him with ease, and this mind blossoms forth in joy. ||7||

column3: Even after listening to the word of the Guru in holy congregation if some body is still lost in the calculations, he goes astray in the world.

column2: kapaT saneh kheh muh kaale ||18||
column3: Ashes are thrown on the face of fake lover and his countenance is blackened.

column3: Even after listening to the Word of the Guru in the holy congregation those who toss between the feelings of loss and profit.

column2: kapaT saneh na theh jaRa(n)dhe ||19||
column3: Their false love cannot reach any place.

column3: He, who even listening to the word of Guru in the holy congregation does not adopt the teachings of Guru in his heart.

column2: 2 : oho hee

column2: abigat gat kiv alakh lakhaiee ||2||

column2: kirat virat parakirat bahu saas giraas nivaas sa(n)jaare|

column2: lekh alekh asa(n)kh apaare ||3||

column3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

column2: baanee bhaiee gurdhaas bhale kee ||
